chapters.title: Chapter 1601: Eigth Soul Challenge
paragraphs: "Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled. ’Behind the gate is another Tower of Eternity located in the Zhanlu Domain of the Ancient Realm, Senior.’
Dugu Yuanshen was shocked to hear that. "Are you serious about that, Young Lady? Where did you hear that from?"
"Empress Huo."
"As I recalled, Empress Huo had reached the third floor in the past, but she was unable to open the gate."
"Senior, Empress Huo is different from other cultivators, including us. I can’t say anything about her true nature, but my husband and I trust her completely, so we don’t doubt her information."

"I see." Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly. "Although I’ve heard her name often in the past, I’ve never truly known her. Since she once declared that she would protect your domain and sect, you guys should have a special relationship with her, right?"

"Empress Huo is my husband’s fiancée, Senior." A ridiculous reaction appeared on Dugu Yuanshen’s face after Luo Yunxiao mentioned that matter, as did the cultivators who were not undergoing their challenges on that floor, including Li Guangyu. "They are not officially married yet, but her parents in this life have already agreed to their relationship, and they are waiting for the right time to make it official."
"Is that true?"

"Absolutely." Luo Yunxiao nodded seriously. "Since many years ago, Empress Huo’s parents have always addressed my husband as their son-in-law. In fact, they are outside the tower and training with my other sisters right now, and they will enter the tower after they adapt to their new powers after breaking through."

"I didn’t expect that your husband would have that kind of relationship with Empress Huo, Young Lady. It’s no wonder she decided to protect your sect, and it would really be stupid if those people thought of doing something to you guys." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "Besides, the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race is also one of his future wives, right?"

"That’s right, Senior Dugu." Tianshi Shengjie no longer has any problems declaring his relationship with Zhang Fei. "I am indeed one of Zhang Fei’s future wives, and we will get married in the future when the situation in this realm is much calmer."
Tianshi Shengjie’s confession shocked all the cultivators present, including Li Guangyu, who had no idea that Zhang Fei also had such a relationship with the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race.

Li Guangyu immediately rethought his plan to attack Zhang Fei, and he also informed Liang Huizhong about his relationship with Tianshi Shengjie. ’Tch! That brat is so lucky! Not only did he win Empress Huo’s heart, but he also managed to win the heart of that female dragon.’
Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly as he stole a glance at Yue Xuelian, thinking that she was also one of Zhang Fei’s future wives. ’Is that young man considering opening the gate?’
’He hasn’t thought about it because the situation behind the gate is too dangerous, and he wants to focus on all the challenges on the second floor first.’
’Can you tell me about the situation in that domain and the danger, Young Lady?’

Luo Yunxiao thought for a moment before telling Dugu Yuanshen about those shadowy creatures that invaded the ancient realm, causing him to frown. ’Unfortunately, no one knows how those shadowy creatures appeared there or where they came from, including Empress Huo.’
’Does that mean that young man and Empress Huo have found a way to go to the Ancient Realm?’
’Yes.’ Luo Yunxiao nodded. ’There is a domain called the Ancient Desolation Domain, and we can go to the Ancient Realm through that domain.’
’I’ve never heard of the Ancient Desolation Domain before.’
’All the cultivators in the Paradise Realm have never heard of that domain before, and my husband got the information about that domain from Empress Huo.’
’Can you tell me the location of the Ancient Desolation Domain?’

Luo Yunxiao answered him with a shake of her head. ’The portal to that domain used to be located far behind those gates, Senior. However, we don’t know its current location, especially after the great changes that occurred in this Paradise Realm many years ago.’

"Sigh." Dugu Yuanshen let out a soft sigh. "I’ve wasted your time, Young Lady. Since you still have plenty of soul power, you should follow your husband to the eighth challenge, and I believe you won’t have any trouble passing it."
"Hehe, you flatter me, Senior." Luo Yunxiao walked to the next area. "I’ll begin now, Senior."

"Yes." After Luo Yunxiao began his eighth challenge, Dugu Yuanshen closed his eyes and thought about their conversation just now. ’Sigh! I must talk about the domain with that young man after he completes all the challenges on this floor.’

Tianshi Shengji, Nalan Wangzi, Helian Xun’er, and Yue Xuelian did not immediately proceed with their challenge. They waited until their soul powers recovered first; otherwise, they would fail the challenge.
Meanwhile, Li Guangyu was thinking to himself as his gaze continued to shift from Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao, and Dugu Yuanshen.

’What exactly are they talking about? Are they talking about the gate on the third floor? Ancestor Ningxue once said that no one has ever succeeded in opening the gate, but that old man is confident that that brat will be able to open it.’ Li Guangyu once again contacted Liang Huizhong, informing him of the matter. ’Ancestor Ningxue will probably arrive in two weeks or sooner, so I’ll wait for her first. Moreover, those demons from the three races are on the first floor, and I can’t possibly protect my disciples alone with several grand elders from all three races in this tower.’

Two soul swords were in Zhang Fei’s hands, and his expression was extremely serious as he looked around the area filled with darkness. "What kind of creatures dwell in this darkness? They can see me, but I can’t see or sense them. Their attacks just now were so powerful, and they were also trying to absorb my soul power."
*Screech... Screech...*

Zhang Fei increased his vigilance after he heard the sound, signaling that those mysterious creatures were about to attack him again. He tried to use his light element, but the darkness around him swallowed the light.
*Swoosh*
"Shit!" Zhang Fei swung his two swords towards the sound, but his attack hit empty air. The next second, a powerful impact struck his chest and sent him flying quite far back. "It hurts!"

Zhang Fei immediately stood up and spun around, examining the surrounding area. After thinking about it, he took out the white lotus from within his soul, expanded it, and enveloped himself with it. Despite its white color, the lotus didn’t illuminate the darkness, and the light only focused on the area closest to it.

Zhang Fei himself had seen a lot of darkness, but he had never witnessed such darkness before. "Damn it! If I can’t see or feel those creatures, I won’t be able to fight them, and my soul power will continue to be absorbed by them until it runs out."
*Screech... Screech...*

"Gah!" Another powerful blow struck Zhang Fei and sent him flying out of the white lotus, but he caught a glimpse of those creatures, making him realize their identity. "Fuck! They are those shadowy creatures that appeared in the Ancient Realm!"

After Zhang Fei spoke, the shadowy creatures immediately attacked him all at once, overwhelming him. He tried to counterattack them, but they disappeared before his soul swords could strike their bodies.

"Gah!" Those shadowy creatures’ attacks became faster and stronger, and they also absorbed Zhang Fei’s soul power every time they attacked him. "Think! I have to do something about them, or I’ll run out of soul power and die here."

Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao was facing many enemies who shouldn’t have appeared in her challenge. The enemies who appeared before her were all her family members, including her mother and all of Zhang Fei’s wives. "This challenge is a little weird! Why are they my enemies in this challenge?"

"Yunxiao, oh Yunxiao," Huang Xiaoyi spoke as her eyes glowed black. "I told you to leave Zhang Fei, but you didn’t listen to me, and you insisted on marrying him. Since you are a disobedient daughter, I must punish you severely."
"I hate you, Yunxiao!" Zhang Yue shouted as a white, blue, and black aura enveloped her body. "Fei’er was mine, but you snatched her from me!"
"Big Sis Yunxiao, I’ve always treated you well, but you betrayed me by snatching my big brother from me." Zhang Lin’s body was enveloped in a blue-black aura, and both hands turned into claws.

A green whirlwind appeared around Qing Yi’s body, and she stared at Luo Yunxiao with hatred. "You shouldn’t have come close to my son, Yunxiao. You were like my own daughter, but you betrayed my trust in you."

Zhang Chen was already in her dragon form, but her current form was different from usual, and a pitch-black aura enveloped her body. "A disobedient child like you is not worthy of being by Fei’er’s side, Yunxiao. You should leave him, or I will swallow you alive."
*Swoosh*

Luo Yunxiao jumped back as a blackish-gold sword shot towards her, piercing the floor in front of her. Xu Ling’er appeared in front of her in her past form, clad in her radiance equipment. "You won’t be able to fight me, Big Sis Yunxiao. I hate you for stealing Big Brother Fei from me, and I will give you the harshest punishment."

All the women who appeared before Luo Yunxiao also expressed their hatred for her, but she didn’t pay any attention to their words because she knew the real them. "Since you guys are illusions, I don’t need to be merciful to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1602: Three Days Later
paragraphs: Despite her soul being in the soul challenge, Luo Yunxiao’s body activated her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, and her soul received its effects. She attacked all the woman’s illusions, starting from Xu Ling’er.
"You guys won’t be able to do anything to me!" Luo Yunxiao’s palm struck Xu Ling’er’s chest. "Illusions are just illusions! I am a master of Yin and Yang thanks to my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique!"

Zhang Chen and the others attacked Luo Yunxiao simultaneously, but the Yin-Yang symbol suddenly enveloped her soul. Black and white light shot out from her soul, forming a pillar that instantly blocked their attacks.
Luo Yunxiao looked at Xu Ling’er, who was trying to attack her with the radiance sword. She smirked and blasted her back, enveloping her enemy with her Yin-Yang aura. "Begone!"
*Boom*
A small explosion rang out, and Xu Ling’er quickly disappeared. Luo Yunxiao didn’t stop there and moved towards Zhang Chen, who had already opened his dragon snout to attack her.
As Zhang Chen shot her black and white dragon breath, Luo Yunxiao dodged it and moved above her head.
"Please forgive me, Grandma Chen." Luo Yunxiao struck Zhang Chen’s dragon head with full force, causing him to crash on the ground with a loud bang.
*Boom*

Luo Yunxiao didn’t stop there and took an archery stance, with a bow and arrow in both hands. She fired the arrow at Zhang Chen, and it instantly shattered into several pieces before piercing her dragon body.
*Roar*
Zhang Chen released a loud dragon roar, and she gradually disappeared from that place.

Luo Yunxiao looked at Huang Xiaoyi and the others with a light smirk. She raised her hands and enveloped them with her Yin-Yang aura. "Unfortunately, you guys are just illusions, and you’ll never be able to do anything to me. As long as I have my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, I have complete control over Yin and Yang, and it’s time for you guys to disappear! Reversal!"
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Huang Xiayoi and all the women slowly disappeared one by one before disappearing completely, making Luo Yunxiao feel a little relieved.

Luo Yunxiao looked around because her soul had not been sent back into her body. While she was thinking that, two giant figures appeared in front of her, which were the white ten-tailed fox and the black ten-tailed fox. "I guess this challenge still has a long way to go! If that’s the case, I’ll fight you two now."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei decided to remove his soul swords, even though his soul was a bit messy due to the attacks of those shadowy creatures. He remembered Hu Tianlang and Dugu Yuanshen’s words that the challenge was based on his fear, and all the illusions that appeared there were equal in power to his.

Zhang Fei calmed himself down and looked at the surrounding area calmly, even though he still couldn’t see the shadowy creatures. He focused his senses, especially his hearing, to track their movements. Although faint, he began to hear their movements, and he concentrated more on listening for changes in the surrounding area.
*Screech... Screech...*

Zhang Fei moved to the side as one of them attacked him, but the others immediately attacked him at the same time. Unlike before, he was able to dodge their attacks, especially after he overcame his fear of them.
Even though their first attack failed, the shadowy creatures did not stop attacking Zhang Fei; Instead, they attacked him faster than before, but he managed to dodge them all.

Zhang Fei released the white lotus from within his soul again and expanded it, reaching as far as possible. He also activated his soul domain to strengthen his soul defense while waiting for an opportunity to counterattack them. ’I couldn’t see or hear their movements before because I was too afraid of them, but I can sense them now.’
*Screech... Screech...*

Zhang Fei dodged their attacks again as he absorbed their soul power, and his soul slowly recovered. For a while, he continued his actions until the shadowy creatures stopped attacking him, but he knew they hadn’t disappeared yet, and they were waiting for him to lower his guard.

’Where are you hiding? What are you guys planning?’ Zhang Fei suddenly sensed a shift in his surroundings and realized that those shadowy creatures had gathered in one place. He felt a chill in his soul and jumped away from the source. ’They decided to merge into one, huh? I can’t let them, or they will become even stronger than before.’

Zhang Fei dashed towards them, created a sword soul, and attacked them directly. Those shadowy creatures split apart and fled in several different directions, confusing him. He chased the one closest to him and slashed it straight away.
Zhang Fei felt his soul absorb its soul fragment, which meant his attack had been successful. He wasted no time and immediately pursued the other shadowy creatures.

High above Zhang Fei, the mysterious man who previously met Feng Yao watched him fight those shadowy creatures and kill them one by one. "This kid has everything he needs to complete all these challenges easily, but he is often too afraid of his enemies. If he can get rid of his fears like the original me, he will become a terrifying cultivator in the future, and no one won’t be able to do anything to him, including the original me."
As Zhang Fei continued to hunt and kill those shadowy creatures, absorbing their soul fragments, screams echoed throughout the place.

After some time, the darkness in the area completely disappeared, which made Zhang Fei feel relieved. However, he was confused because his soul hadn’t been sent back into his body, even though he had killed and absorbed all the shadowy creatures.
"Is this challenge still not over?" Since the next challenge hadn’t appeared yet, Zhang Fei sat there and waited. "I hope I can complete this challenge soon so I can move on to the ninth challenge."

Unbeknownst to Zhang Fei, another three days had passed since he began his challenge. Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian, who had recovered their souls, immediately went to the eighth area and began their challenge.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi had already completed their first challenge, and they immediately went to the second area to start it.
Just like them, several core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, such as Wang Tieshan and Hua Liuying, had also moved to the second area and begun their challenges.
More and more cultivators filled the second floor, but their numbers were not as numerous as on the previous floors because many of them failed to face all the challenges there.

Many of those cultivators also decided to give up due to the presence of demons from the three demon races, who were clearly targeting them and intending to capture them. They could challenge the tower whenever they wanted, so they decided to give up rather than be captured by the demons.

Some people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Spring Zenith Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Celestial Moon Sect, and the Divine Samsara Sect had also reached the second floor. They did not immediately begin their first challenge on that floor; instead, they chose to wait and prepare themselves.

Li Guangyu was pleased with the success of several other disciples from his sect in reaching the second floor, but he couldn’t rest assured because the demons of the three demon races were still on the first floor.

Although their progress was slow due to the presence of Feng Yao and the others, Li Guangyu was confident that they would reach the second floor, especially their grand elders, which would make the situation on that floor become chaotic. ’I hope our Sect Master and the others will arrive at this tower soon because I can’t face those demons alone.’

Dugu Yuanshen didn’t care much about those cultivators, and he only cared about his disciples, who were still having difficulty completing their challenges. He raised an eyebrow slightly when he saw Luo Yunxiao open his eyes. "As expected, you’ve easily passed your eighth challenge, Young Lady."

"Haha," Luo Yunxiao laughed softly. "My eighth challenge wasn’t as easy as the previous ones, Senior. Although I was able to defeat my opponents there, I had to work quite hard to do so. Is the ninth challenge even more difficult?"

"It can be difficult, but it can also be easy, Young Lady." Luo Yunxiao was curious about that, but she didn’t rush to the next challenge. "The eighth challenge is a battle, right? The ninth challenge is not a battle with enemies but something else, and not all cultivators can pass it. You will surely understand the difficulties once your soul enters that challenging place, but I am sure that it will not be a significant obstacle for you."
"I understand, Senior." Luo Yunxiao looked at Zhang Fei and smiled to herself, seeing him so calm. "It seems he still needs some time to complete his eighth challenge."

Dugu Yuanshen nodded at her. "Three days have passed since you two entered the eighth challenge, and I previously thought he would fail this time. My guess was wrong, as he managed to regain his composure, and calm is the main key to completing all the challenges on this second floor."
"Yes," Luo Yunxiao walked into the ninth challenge area. "Since my husband has calmed down, I don’t need to worry about him anymore, and I will start the next challenge, Senior."
"Go on."
After Luo Yunxiao sat down in the ninth area, her soul was immediately transported to the next challenge area.
Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly and looked at Zhang Fei. "Don’t give up and show me what you’re capable of, Young Man."

Even though their first attack failed, the shadowy creatures did not stop attacking Zhang Fei; Instead, they attacked him faster than before, but he managed to dodge them all.
Zhang Fei released the white lotus from within his soul again and expanded it, reaching as far as possible.

He also activated his soul domain to strengthen his soul defense while waiting for an opportunity to counterattack them. ’I couldn’t see or hear their movements before because I was too afraid of them, but I can sense them now.’
*Screech...
Screech...*
Zhang Fei dodged their attacks again as he absorbed their soul power, and his soul slowly recovered.
For a while, he continued his actions until the shadowy creatures stopped attacking him, but he knew they hadn’t disappeared yet, and they were waiting for him to lower his guard.
’Where are you hiding?
What are you guys planning?’ Zhang Fei suddenly sensed a shift in his surroundings and realized that those shadowy creatures had gathered in one place.
He felt a chill in his soul and jumped away from the source. ’They decided to merge into one, huh?
I can’t let them, or they will become even stronger than before.’
Zhang Fei dashed towards them, created a sword soul, and attacked them directly.
Those shadowy creatures split apart and fled in several different directions, confusing him.
He chased the one closest to him and slashed it straight away.
Zhang Fei felt his soul absorb its soul fragment, which meant his attack had been successful.
He wasted no time and immediately pursued the other shadowy creatures.
High above Zhang Fei, the mysterious man who previously met Feng Yao watched him fight those shadowy creatures and kill them one by one.
"This kid has everything he needs to complete all these challenges easily, but he is often too afraid of his enemies.
If he can get rid of his fears like the original me, he will become a terrifying cultivator in the future, and no one won’t be able to do anything to him, including the original me."
As Zhang Fei continued to hunt and kill those shadowy creatures, absorbing their soul fragments, screams echoed throughout the place.
After some time, the darkness in the area completely disappeared, which made Zhang Fei feel relieved.
However, he was confused because his soul hadn’t been sent back into his body, even though he had killed and absorbed all the shadowy creatures.
"Is this challenge still not over?" Since the next challenge hadn’t appeared yet, Zhang Fei sat there and waited.
"I hope I can complete this challenge soon so I can move on to the ninth challenge."
Unbeknownst to Zhang Fei, another three days had passed since he began his challenge.
Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian, who had recovered their souls, immediately went to the eighth area and began their challenge.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi had already completed their first challenge, and they immediately went to the second area to start it.
Just like them, several core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, such as Wang Tieshan and Hua Liuying, had also moved to the second area and begun their challenges.
More and more cultivators filled the second floor, but their numbers were not as numerous as on the previous floors because many of them failed to face all the challenges there.
Many of those cultivators also decided to give up due to the presence of demons from the three demon races, who were clearly targeting them and intending to capture them.
They could challenge the tower whenever they wanted, so they decided to give up rather than be captured by the demons.
Some people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Spring Zenith Sect, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Celestial Moon Sect, and the Divine Samsara Sect had also reached the second floor.
They did not immediately begin their first challenge on that floor; instead, they chose to wait and prepare themselves.

Li Guangyu was pleased with the success of several other disciples from his sect in reaching the second floor, but he couldn’t rest assured because the demons of the three demon races were still on the first floor.

Although their progress was slow due to the presence of Feng Yao and the others, Li Guangyu was confident that they would reach the second floor, especially their grand elders, which would make the situation on that floor become chaotic. ’I hope our Sect Master and the others will arrive at this tower soon because I can’t face those demons alone.’
Dugu Yuanshen didn’t care much about those cultivators, and he only cared about his disciples, who were still having difficulty completing their challenges.
He raised an eyebrow slightly when he saw Luo Yunxiao open his eyes.
"As expected, you’ve easily passed your eighth challenge, Young Lady."
"Haha," Luo Yunxiao laughed softly.
"My eighth challenge wasn’t as easy as the previous ones, Senior.
Although I was able to defeat my opponents there, I had to work quite hard to do so.
Is the ninth challenge even more difficult?"
"It can be difficult, but it can also be easy, Young Lady." Luo Yunxiao was curious about that, but she didn’t rush to the next challenge.
"The eighth challenge is a battle, right?
The ninth challenge is not a battle with enemies but something else, and not all cultivators can pass it.
You will surely understand the difficulties once your soul enters that challenging place, but I am sure that it will not be a significant obstacle for you."
"I understand, Senior." Luo Yunxiao looked at Zhang Fei and smiled to herself, seeing him so calm.
"It seems he still needs some time to complete his eighth challenge."
Dugu Yuanshen nodded at her.
"Three days have passed since you two entered the eighth challenge, and I previously thought he would fail this time.
My guess was wrong, as he managed to regain his composure, and calm is the main key to completing all the challenges on this second floor."
"Yes," Luo Yunxiao walked into the ninth challenge area.
"Since my husband has calmed down, I don’t need to worry about him anymore, and I will start the next challenge, Senior."
"Go on."
After Luo Yunxiao sat down in the ninth area, her soul was immediately transported to the next challenge area.
Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly and looked at Zhang Fei.
"Don’t give up and show me what you’re capable of, Young Man."

chapters.title: Chapter 1603: Ninth Soul Challenge
paragraphs: In his eighth challenge, Zhang Fei opened his eyes as he sensed the presence of someone or something inside. He was slightly surprised to see the old man from the sixth challenge. "Hmm? Old man? How did you get in here?"
"I’ve told you that I’ve existed in this tower since it was built, right?" Zhang Fei nodded and stood up. "It took you so long to realize your weakness and fear, young man."
"I—" Zhang Fei stopped talking when the old man shot something into his soul, causing his soul power to surge quite significantly. "Soul fragments."

"That’s right," The old man nodded. "You have passed this challenge since you defeated those shadowy creatures, and those soul fragments are the reward of this challenge. I deliberately kept you here to help you calm down; otherwise, you would not have been able to pass the ninth challenge. Since you’ve calmed down now, I’ll send you out, and you can move on to the next challenge."
"Wait a second." Zhang Fei looked at the old man as he guessed his identity. "Since you can do all that, I assume you’re the spirit of this tower, right, old man?"

"You realized it too late, young man. Your wife is much better than you because she is calm and fearless, and she was able to see everything clearly from the moment she first entered the sixth challenge."
"Luo Yunxiao, right?"

The old man nodded at him. "That little girl had everything to complete all the challenges on the second floor, but she deliberately slowed herself down for your sake. You are lucky to have a wife like her, so you must not waste her, and she will always be your strength because she inherited the physique of the ten-tailed fox."
"You are right, old man. I am indeed lucky to have Luo Yunxiao as my wife, and I will never waste her."
"I will send you out now and continue to the ninth challenge, and we will meet again on the third floor."
"Thank you, old man."

When he returned to his body, Zhang Fei saw Luo Yunxiao undergoing her ninth challenge. Meanwhile, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian were undergoing their eighth challenges.
[Master, six days have passed since you started your eighth challenge, and Luo Yunxiao started his ninth challenge three days ago.]

’Six days, huh? I didn’t expect it to take me that long just to complete my eighth challenge.’ Zhang Fei looked at the other cultivators, but there weren’t as many as there were three days ago. ’I guess many of them failed their first challenge.’

[Those cultivators do have high cultivation, but they don’t have enough confidence and soul power to face all the challenges on this second floor. Moreover, most of them were wary of the presence of demons from the three demon races, and they were worried about being captured by them, so they decided to give up.]

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh before looking at Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi, who were still trying to complete their second challenge. Beside them, he saw the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, but he didn’t pay much attention to them.

Zhang Fei was satisfied to see that several elders from the Moonlit Passion Temple had already reached the second floor, such as Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Chen Yuefeng, Ling Yao, Qiu Yue, and several others.

Zhang Fei wasn’t surprised to see Nong Qinwei, Lan Xuening, and Dongfang Yuechan manage to reach the second floor fairly quickly, but he was surprised when he couldn’t find Yin Chang among them. Of the people from the Spring Zenith Sect, only Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei had reached that floor.
From the Celestial Moon Sect, Zhang Fei saw Yue Qianrou, Yue Yuling, and several other women, who had never previously reached the second floor.
A frown appeared on Zhang Fei’s forehead when his gaze met Li Guangyu’s, and he immediately activated his demon eyes.
’I guess almost all the higher-ups of the Divine Samsara Sect are like him, huh?’ Zhang Fei ignored Li Guangyu and went to the area for the ninth challenge.

Li Guangyu stared intently at Zhang Fei. "How could he complete all the challenges so quickly? Back then, it took us so long to complete the first seven challenges, and we ultimately failed the eighth, but he passed the first eight challenges so easily."
Although others saw that Zhang Fei looked like he had easily completed all the challenges, Li Guangyu did not know what he had gone through in all those challenges.

Li Guangyu contacted the members of the Divine Samsara Sect who were still on the first floor to confirm the position of the demons of the three demon races. After they informed him that the demons were still far from the second floor due to the presence of Feng Yao and the others, he decided to take on his first challenge, especially since all the disciples who had come with him were currently undergoing their second challenges.
Dugu Yuanshen opened his eyes after Li Guangyu initiated his first challenge, and his eyes flashed golden for a brief moment.

’I think a major battle will occur in this tower soon, and the cause will be the people from the Divine Samsara Sect. Their targets were obviously Zhang Fei, Yue Xuelian, and those demons.’ Dugu Yuanshen looked at his disciples before sighing inwardly, as they were still having difficulty facing their challenges. ’I hope you guys will successfully complete all the challenges before the people from that sect arrive at this tower, and I will take you to the third floor to avoid the fight between them.’
In the forest, Zhang Fei [1] gathered all his wives and asked them to go to the second area, led by Yao Qilin and Fei Lian.
"Are you sure you want to stay here alone, Master?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded at Fei Lian. "Yue Ningxue will arrive in this domain in a week or so, and I will prevent her from reaching the tower. Moreover, I’m not alone, and my second clone is here, so I’m confident in dealing with her."

"Yue Ningxue is skilled in the ice element, but I don’t think that’s a big deal for you. After all, you possess the ice element, and you also understand the ice elemental laws, both of which have reached the peak stage. Most importantly, she is an ordinary woman, and you are a lust demon, so I believe you can handle her easily."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed at Yao Qilin’s last sentence. "Alright, you two can lead the way to the next area and protect them well, or I will punish you both."

Yao Qilin and Fei Lian laughed loudly before leading all the women away with them. Feng Jiu and Feng Tian walked to Zhang Fei [1]’s side. "Are you sure you can face a cultivator as powerful as Yue Ningxue, Son?"

"Don’t worry, I can handle her, so you two should go to the next area. After those demons climb to the second floor, I will take you all to the tower, and you can improve yourselves by facing all the challenges there."
"Be careful, okay?"
"I will."
Feng Tian patted his shoulder. "I know you’re stronger than us, but you can call us if you need our help."
"Yes."
After Feng Tian and Feng Jiu caught up with the others, Zhang Fei [1] jumped onto one of the trees and waited there for Yue Ningxue’s arrival.
[Hehe! I think that woman would be a good match for you, and her Yin Qi would be very useful in helping you, Master.]

Zhang Fei [1] didn’t think about that, and he was more concerned about something else. "I wonder how strong that woman is, and I’ll fight her to gauge the strength of the other ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect. For now, we can only wait for her to arrive at this domain, and I will never let her go to the tower. However, Liang Huizhong and several elders from the sect are also on their way here, and their presence will be troublesome."

[You have Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, and the two dragons by your side, so I think the arrival of those people will not affect you, Master. Furthermore, they should be targeting those demons so you don’t need to fight with them.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly. "Let’s wait for their arrival first, and I’ll think of other plans after they get here."
In the ninth challenge, Zhang Fei arrived at a vast, empty field.

"What exactly is the purpose of this challenge? Why is there nothing here?" Zhang Fei muttered as he looked around, and he could sense many soul fragments in the air. "Do I just need to absorb them to complete this challenge? That’s impossible, right? The previous challenge was really troublesome, so I don’t believe this one will be that easy."

Just as Zhang Fei was thinking about the challenges he would have to face in the ninth challenge, the soul fragments in the air emitted a powerful pressure and pressed down on him, causing him to fall to the ground.

"Damn it!" Zhang Fei tried to fight back against the pressure using his soul power, but the pressure became several times stronger as soon as he released his soul power, and the ground beneath him immediately caved in from the intense pressure. "Shit! I’ve never faced such intense soul pressure."

Zhang Fei kept trying to fight against the incoming pressure, but the pressure kept getting stronger every time he tried to fight back. In the end, he decided to withdraw his soul power, allowing the pressure to suppress his soul. "I hope my guess is correct."

chapters.title: Chapter 1604: Luo Yunxiao - The Old Man
paragraphs: Unlike Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao sat leisurely in front of a small house as she absorbed the soul fragments in the ninth challenge. "This challenge isn’t difficult, but it’s not easy either. If my husband hadn’t realized it and tried to resist the pressure, he would have had a hard time passing this challenge. He would have to allow the pressure to suppress him and adapt to it, and everything would go smoothly after that."
"You are indeed smart, little girl. You realized the purpose of this challenge from the moment you entered this place."
Luo Yunxiao smiled at the old man. "Can you tell me whether my husband has entered the ninth challenge, Senior?"

"That kid is already in his ninth challenge, and he already realizes that he made a stupid mistake by trying to fight back against the pressure on his soul." Luo Yunxiao breathed a sigh of relief. "The purpose of the ninth challenge is to test the patience and increase the soul strength of the cultivators, and the pressure will become more intense if they fight back."

"The eighth challenge is a battle to test our physical strength, and the ninth challenge is a pressure to test our soul strength. If so, I believe that the final challenge is to test our mental strength, right?"

The old man nodded. "All living beings have three aspects: mental, soul, and physical strengths. They must improve all three to become better cultivators, but not all living beings possess the patience and meticulousness. Many of them are overconfident in their abilities, which leads to their failure."
"Can you tell me about the tenth challenge, Senior?"

"Haha," The old man laughed at Luo Yunxiao’s curious expression. "I shouldn’t have told you this, but I’ve been watching you ever since you entered this tower. You have incredible foresight to see through all those challenges, so I’m no longer surprised if the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique chooses you as its master. The final challenge is our past, present, and future."

Luo Yunxiao furrowed her brows. "Our past should be based on all events in our past, and our present should be based on all events that have recently happened. No one has the ability to see into the future, so I think it’s all based on our dreams and hopes."

"Yes." The old man smiled and explained to her. "To become a better living being, we must be able to accept and overcome our past, and we must also be able to overcome everything that happens in the present. As you said, no one has the ability to see their future, and the challenges that will arise before them are based on their dreams and hopes. Everything that will appear before them is only an illusion of their dreams and hopes, and they will fail if they choose to embrace that false future."

"They would be truly stupid if they couldn’t see through that false future and chose to embrace it." Luo Yunxiao clenched her fist. "We can only realize our dreams and hopes for our future using our strength and hard work."
"Do you think your husband will succeed in passing the final challenge?"

Luo Yunxiao smiled confidently. "Senior, my husband has long since made peace with his past, so he won’t have any trouble seeing through the test. As for his present, he does have some fears about things like Yuan Xiajie, Qian Yan, and a few others, but I believe he will successfully pass the test. As for his future, he is fully aware that he can only make his future come true with his hard work, so he will not be lulled by that false future."
"Since you have so much confidence in your husband, I will see for myself how he will face his tenth challenge."
"Senior, I have one question for you, and I hope you’re willing to answer it."
"Please ask me, little girl."
"Can the gate on the third floor be opened?"
The old man thought for a moment before nodding. "As long as your husband manages to find the key to unlock the gate, it will open for the first time in millions of years."
"What about the seal on the tower in the Zhanlu Domain?"
"Haha! Don’t you already have the answer to your question, little girl?"
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "The key will not only open the gate but also open the formation that is blocking us from passing through."

"That’s right." The old man nodded. "I always wondered why the universe sealed the gate and left the key to open it in this tower, but I began to understand its purpose after I saw you and your husband. Your husband is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and you inherited his Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. If the two of you work together, I believe you will succeed in opening the gate and crossing to the Zhanlu Domain on the other side. However, the situation in that domain is really bad now, and—"
"Shadowy creatures."

"Yes." The old man was not surprised to hear Luo Yunxiao mention the shadowy creatures because he had already witnessed Zhang Fei face them during the eighth challenge. "Those creatures suddenly appeared out of thin air, and they controlled all the beasts and demons in the Zhanlu Domain, but I don’t understand their purpose in doing that. They attempted to enter the Tower of Eternity in that domain, but they have not succeeded to this day."

"I think those shadowy creatures’ goal is the destruction of this universe, and they can only do that by defeating my husband." The old man looked at Luo Yunxiao seriously. "My husband is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and Hu Tianlang was born of Yin and Yang. If my husband evolves into the next ten-tailed fox, he will have the ability to stop them, so they are trying to prevent that from happening. I heard that they are targeting the old fox’s two souls hidden in the Ancient Realm, so I am sure of my guess."
"If your husband goes to the Zanlu Domain, those creatures will probably kill him straight away."
"I don’t think they want to kill my husband, Senior."
"Then?"
"Rather than killing my husband, they probably want to control him. If they control him, they can travel to every corner of this universe with ease, and they’ll control everything."

"That makes sense." The old man nodded. "The ten-tailed fox possesses extraordinary abilities, and it can easily control yin and yang, both of which are the foundations of this universe. If they control your husband, and he evolves into the next ten-tailed fox, they can use him to do anything."

Luo Yunxiao exhaled softly. "Even though going to the Ancient Realm is too risky for my current husband, he has no choice but to go there because he needs the old fox’s two souls to evolve into the next ten-tailed fox, and I will accompany him to retrieve those two souls."

"You and your husband are one because he is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and you are the inheritor of his Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. Therefore, you must accompany him to the Ancient Realm to help retrieve those two souls and assist him in facing the shadowy creatures."
"Yes," Luo Yunxiao sighed. "How long will it take me to complete this challenge, Senior?"
"You will complete this challenge after you absorb all the soul fragments here."

"Huh?" Luo Yunxiao sensed the area around him, discovering a large number of soul fragments there. "I don’t think I’ll be able to finish in a week, but it’s not a big deal since they’re useful for increasing my soul power."
"Hahaha! Be patient, little girl."
"Yes."
Thereafter, the old man disappeared from her sight, and Luo Yunxiao focused on absorbing all the soul fragments in that place.

After adapting to his ninth challenge, Zhang Fei was finally able to move freely. He sat down in an empty space and looked around; a faint smile appeared on his face after discovering so many soul fragments. "Although there are many of them, they won’t be able to help me break through to the immortal soul level. However, they will strengthen my soul even more, so I must absorb them all to complete this challenge."
"Haha," Zhang Fei looked at the old man. "I thought it would take you longer to realize the purpose of this challenge, young man."

Zhang Fei sighed. "I was previously overconfident in my abilities and soul power, so I tried to fight back against the pressure. After trying for a while, I realized that I just needed to surrender and allow the pressure to suppress my soul, especially since it would strengthen it."

"You’re right." The old man nodded. "Not all challenges in this tower can be overcome by strength, and you must be willing to accept some of them. The soul fragments in this challenge are useful for strengthening your soul, so you must absorb all of them, and you will complete this challenge afterward."
"So, what is the tenth challenge that awaits me? The eighth challenge is a physical challenge, and the ninth challenge is a soul challenge."
The old man grinned. "You’ll know about that after you complete this challenge, but I think the tenth challenge won’t be a problem for you; at least that’s what your wife thinks."

"Luo Yunxiao is still in the ninth challenge, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "She entered the challenge three days earlier than me, so I need more time than that to absorb all these soul fragments."
"For now, you just need to be patient and absorb everything."
"Alright."

sentences.text: Unlike Zhang Fei, Luo Yunxiao sat leisurely in front of a small house as she absorbed the soul fragments in the ninth challenge.
"This challenge isn’t difficult, but it’s not easy either.
If my husband hadn’t realized it and tried to resist the pressure, he would have had a hard time passing this challenge.
He would have to allow the pressure to suppress him and adapt to it, and everything would go smoothly after that."
"You are indeed smart, little girl.
You realized the purpose of this challenge from the moment you entered this place."
Luo Yunxiao smiled at the old man.
"Can you tell me whether my husband has entered the ninth challenge, Senior?"
"That kid is already in his ninth challenge, and he already realizes that he made a stupid mistake by trying to fight back against the pressure on his soul." Luo Yunxiao breathed a sigh of relief.
"The purpose of the ninth challenge is to test the patience and increase the soul strength of the cultivators, and the pressure will become more intense if they fight back."
"The eighth challenge is a battle to test our physical strength, and the ninth challenge is a pressure to test our soul strength.
If so, I believe that the final challenge is to test our mental strength, right?"
The old man nodded.
"All living beings have three aspects: mental, soul, and physical strengths.
They must improve all three to become better cultivators, but not all living beings possess the patience and meticulousness.
Many of them are overconfident in their abilities, which leads to their failure."
"Can you tell me about the tenth challenge, Senior?"
"Haha," The old man laughed at Luo Yunxiao’s curious expression.
"I shouldn’t have told you this, but I’ve been watching you ever since you entered this tower.
You have incredible foresight to see through all those challenges, so I’m no longer surprised if the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique chooses you as its master.
The final challenge is our past, present, and future."
Luo Yunxiao furrowed her brows.
"Our past should be based on all events in our past, and our present should be based on all events that have recently happened.
No one has the ability to see into the future, so I think it’s all based on our dreams and hopes."
"Yes." The old man smiled and explained to her.
"To become a better living being, we must be able to accept and overcome our past, and we must also be able to overcome everything that happens in the present.
As you said, no one has the ability to see their future, and the challenges that will arise before them are based on their dreams and hopes.
Everything that will appear before them is only an illusion of their dreams and hopes, and they will fail if they choose to embrace that false future."
"They would be truly stupid if they couldn’t see through that false future and chose to embrace it." Luo Yunxiao clenched her fist.
"We can only realize our dreams and hopes for our future using our strength and hard work."
"Do you think your husband will succeed in passing the final challenge?"
Luo Yunxiao smiled confidently.
"Senior, my husband has long since made peace with his past, so he won’t have any trouble seeing through the test.
As for his present, he does have some fears about things like Yuan Xiajie, Qian Yan, and a few others, but I believe he will successfully pass the test.
As for his future, he is fully aware that he can only make his future come true with his hard work, so he will not be lulled by that false future."
"Since you have so much confidence in your husband, I will see for myself how he will face his tenth challenge."
"Senior, I have one question for you, and I hope you’re willing to answer it."
"Please ask me, little girl."
"Can the gate on the third floor be opened?"
The old man thought for a moment before nodding.
"As long as your husband manages to find the key to unlock the gate, it will open for the first time in millions of years."
"What about the seal on the tower in the Zhanlu Domain?"
"Haha!
Don’t you already have the answer to your question, little girl?"
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding.
"The key will not only open the gate but also open the formation that is blocking us from passing through."
"That’s right." The old man nodded.
"I always wondered why the universe sealed the gate and left the key to open it in this tower, but I began to understand its purpose after I saw you and your husband.
Your husband is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and you inherited his Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
If the two of you work together, I believe you will succeed in opening the gate and crossing to the Zhanlu Domain on the other side.
However, the situation in that domain is really bad now, and—"
"Shadowy creatures."
"Yes." The old man was not surprised to hear Luo Yunxiao mention the shadowy creatures because he had already witnessed Zhang Fei face them during the eighth challenge.
"Those creatures suddenly appeared out of thin air, and they controlled all the beasts and demons in the Zhanlu Domain, but I don’t understand their purpose in doing that.
They attempted to enter the Tower of Eternity in that domain, but they have not succeeded to this day."
"I think those shadowy creatures’ goal is the destruction of this universe, and they can only do that by defeating my husband." The old man looked at Luo Yunxiao seriously.
"My husband is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and Hu Tianlang was born of Yin and Yang.
If my husband evolves into the next ten-tailed fox, he will have the ability to stop them, so they are trying to prevent that from happening.
I heard that they are targeting the old fox’s two souls hidden in the Ancient Realm, so I am sure of my guess."
"If your husband goes to the Zanlu Domain, those creatures will probably kill him straight away."
"I don’t think they want to kill my husband, Senior."
"Then?"
"Rather than killing my husband, they probably want to control him.
If they control him, they can travel to every corner of this universe with ease, and they’ll control everything."
"That makes sense." The old man nodded.
"The ten-tailed fox possesses extraordinary abilities, and it can easily control yin and yang, both of which are the foundations of this universe.
If they control your husband, and he evolves into the next ten-tailed fox, they can use him to do anything."
Luo Yunxiao exhaled softly.

"Even though going to the Ancient Realm is too risky for my current husband, he has no choice but to go there because he needs the old fox’s two souls to evolve into the next ten-tailed fox, and I will accompany him to retrieve those two souls."
"You and your husband are one because he is the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and you are the inheritor of his Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
Therefore, you must accompany him to the Ancient Realm to help retrieve those two souls and assist him in facing the shadowy creatures."
"Yes," Luo Yunxiao sighed.
"How long will it take me to complete this challenge, Senior?"
"You will complete this challenge after you absorb all the soul fragments here."
"Huh?" Luo Yunxiao sensed the area around him, discovering a large number of soul fragments there.
"I don’t think I’ll be able to finish in a week, but it’s not a big deal since they’re useful for increasing my soul power."
"Hahaha!
Be patient, little girl."
"Yes."
Thereafter, the old man disappeared from her sight, and Luo Yunxiao focused on absorbing all the soul fragments in that place.
After adapting to his ninth challenge, Zhang Fei was finally able to move freely.
He sat down in an empty space and looked around; a faint smile appeared on his face after discovering so many soul fragments.
"Although there are many of them, they won’t be able to help me break through to the immortal soul level.
However, they will strengthen my soul even more, so I must absorb them all to complete this challenge."
"Haha," Zhang Fei looked at the old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1605: A Week Later
paragraphs: A week passed quickly.
Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei were still in the ninth challenge, and they showed no signs of finishing yet.

Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian had just completed their eighth challenge after ten days. At first, they thought it would be easy to complete, but they struggled to overcome the enemies blocking their path.
The four women did not immediately start their ninth challenge, and they chose to recover their soul power first because the previous fight drained a lot of their soul power.
"Did you guys also struggle with the previous challenge?"

Helian Xun’er nodded to Tianshi Shengjie. "The enemies that appeared before me were too terrifying, and I briefly considered giving up on the challenge. However, retreating would have left me far behind, so I persisted until I finally passed it."
"Me too," Nalan Wangzhi sighed. "I didn’t expect to encounter Mo Shentian and several other demon gods in the previous challenge, and they beat me until I was completely helpless."
"How did you finally get through it?"

"Him." Nalan Wangzi pointed to Zhang Fei. "I don’t know how it happened, but he appeared in my challenge and helped me through it. Otherwise, I would definitely fail to pass it, and I would have to do it all over again in the future."
Tianshi Shengjie and the others looked at Zhang Fei, wondering how he could appear in Nalan Wangzi’s challenge.

"You guys don’t need to be confused by that." They looked at Dugu Yuanshen. "That young man didn’t actually appear in her challenge, but he appeared there because of her trust in him. You’re truly fortunate that you have such strong trust in him; otherwise, you would have failed the previous challenge."
Nalan Wangzi smiled at him. "Senior, he is my husband, and he has helped me a lot over the past years, so I have full trust in him."

"However, the ninth challenge is more difficult than the previous ones, and the tenth challenge will be even more difficult, so you should prepare yourself better before starting it." Dugu Yuanshen pointed at Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao. "That young lady has been in her challenge for ten days, and that young man has been there for seven days."

Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, and Tianshi Shengjie sighed to themselves because Luo Yunxiao was the best among them since they entered the tower, and she had previously managed to complete all the challenges in front of her much faster than anyone else, including Zhang Fei.
"You guys should rest first and restore your soul power before you start the ninth challenge."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior."
"No problem."
Tianshi Shengjie turned her head to Yue Xuelian, who was watching the people from the Celestial Moon Sect who had already begun their first challenge. "What are you thinking, Sect Master Yue?"
"Three weeks have passed since Yue Ningxue departed from the Divine Samsara Sect, and she’s probably already arrived in this domain by now." Yue Xuelian sighed.

Tianshi Shengjie understood Yue Xuelian’s worries, and she embraced her shoulders. "Sect Master Yue, you don’t need to worry about that woman, okay? Zhang Fei’s two clones are out there, and I know his abilities very well, so I’m sure he can stop her. Moreover, all your sect members are already on the second floor, and it will not be easy for her to reach this place."

"You don’t know the strength and abilities of Yue Ningxue, Princess Tianshi." Yue Xuelian looked at her. "Do you think she’s just an ordinary woman? She managed to reach the third floor of this tower when she wasn’t that strong yet, and I’m sure her strength has increased even higher than at that time."

Tianshi Shengjie nodded in understanding and spoke to her again. "I’m not underestimating Yue Ningxue, but I believe in Zhang Fei. In fact, I’m not the only one who believes in his abilities, but my emperor and my father also believe in him. Therefore, you don’t need to worry about that woman and leave everything to him, and I believe he can handle her."
"I hope you’re right, Princess Tianshi."
"Alright, let’s not think about that woman anymore, okay? We should focus on recovering our soul power to proceed to the ninth challenge."
"Yes."

Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng stood in front of the first-floor stairs, with their attention focused on the demons of the three demon races.
The cultivators who had previously challenged the tower had vanished; some had successfully reached the second floor, while others had failed.
"Do we need to fight them here? If we let these demons climb to the second floor, they will attack the people undergoing the challenge there, and they won’t be able to escape."

Feng Yao shook her head at Long Xukong. "They are experienced cultivators, so they should be aware of their situation. We’ve already protected them on the first floor, so we won’t be protecting them anymore on the second floor, and we’ll only be protecting the people from the Twin Flames Domain. If they feel the situation is too dangerous for them, they should surrender, and the tower will send them out like the previous cultivators."
"Are the people from the Twin Flames Domain the only ones who matter to you, Empress Huo?"

Feng Yao looked at Long Xukong. "Why should I care about other cultivators? They’ve been cultivating for so long, and many of them have caused trouble throughout the domains, especially those from the Divine Samsara Sect. If they can’t handle a situation like this on their own, they should just cripple their cultivation and live as ordinary humans."
"You—"
Long Wuzhao grabbed Long Xukong’s shoulder. "You don’t need to argue with her, Brother Xukong. If Empress Huo isn’t willing to protect them, the three of us will protect them ourselves."
Feng Yao didn’t say anything else, leading Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng to the second floor directly.

"She never changes, Brother Wuzhao." Tianshi Bailong looked at the demons still in the middle of the first floor. "I think we don’t need to fight them here, and we should face them at the door of the second floor."
Long Wuzhao glanced at the demons for a moment before leading Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong to the second floor. "Let’s go, Brothers."

"Damn it! This task should have been easy, but their arrival ruined everything." Ku Yu looked at the two grand elders. "What should we do now? Many cultivators have already surrendered and have been sent out by the tower, and we won’t be able to attack the remaining cultivators as long as those three damn dragons are protecting them."

Ku Shan sighed. "I’ve discussed this matter with my demon god, and he asked us to do our best to capture as many cultivators as possible. He also told me that he’s already sent additional reinforcements, but they’ll still need a few days to arrive, and they’ll also have to overcome all the challenges on this first floor."
"Instead of thinking about that, we should reach the second stair quickly because we’ve wasted too much time here." Ku Yin said.
"Let’s go!"
"What do you think about this situation, Grand Elder Kuang?"

Qian Kuang could only shake his head at Qian Yu. "We must remain restrained ourselves, Prince. The strength of Empress Huo, Long Wuzhao, and the two dragons is equal to, or even superior to, my demon god. If we force ourselves like those of the Torture Demon Race, we will face great trouble, and we might even die here."
"We contacted our demon god several days ago, but he has not given any instructions to this day." Qian Hufeng said.

Unlike Ku Yu, Qian Yu was much more patient and understanding of the situation, so he didn’t force himself to attack those people. "If I think about it, all the cultivators who were sent out of this tower should still be out there, right? Instead of forcing ourselves to go to the second floor, I think we should capture those who are outside."

"I’m not sure about that, Prince." Qian Hufeng looked at the entrance. "If those people are smart, they won’t stay any longer in this domain, and they will return to their respective domains directly."

"In that case, we should head to the second floor as soon as possible, but we won’t make a move right away, and we’ll assess the situation first. If we act recklessly, Long Wuzhao and the two dragons will definitely attack us directly." The two grand elders agreed with Qian Yu. "How’s your situation, Sister?"
Qian Qin shook her head at her brother. "I’m fine, Brother. You don’t need to think too much about me, and we can continue our challenge."
"Let’s go then."
The demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race were much calmer than those of the other two demon races.

Sha Huo had already contacted his father, and Sha Mo asked him to abandon their plans if the situation became too dangerous. "Grand Elder Huoran, we will surrender if the situation is not in our favor, and we will return to our domain."
"Yes, Prince."
"What about you, Qingge?" Sha Huo asked his sister.

"Hehe," Sha Qingge laughed. "I felt overwhelmed at first, Brother. However, I’ve gotten used to all the challenges on this first floor, and I’m increasingly enjoying myself as I complete every one of them."
Sha Huo nodded smilingly. "We’re not in a hurry to go to the second floor because the situation there is too dangerous, so you can enjoy your time and complete all the challenges."
"Yes, Brother."

chapters.title: Chapter 1606: Yue Ningxue’s Arrival
paragraphs: After three weeks of traveling, Yue Ningxue finally entered the Glazed Heaven Domain, moving at high speed toward the outermost area of the forest.

Yue Ningxue wasn’t surprised to see the quiet atmosphere outside, as Liang Huizhong had already informed her of the arrival of demons from the three demon races in the domain. She looked towards the Tower of Eternity. "According to Li Guangyu, Yue Xuelian and the elders of the Celestial Moon Sect have already reached the second floor, and she has just completed her eighth challenge. However, I didn’t expect that they would come to the domain with the entourage from the Moonlit Passion Temple, and Empress Huo’s presence beside them is truly troublesome."

Yue Ningxue wasted no time and entered the first area of the forest, but she stopped as soon as she saw Zhang Fei [1] blocking her path. She couldn’t recognize him because he was using a disguise, but she was slightly relieved to learn that his cultivation was only at the 1-Star Celestial Emperor Realm. "Who are you? What do you mean by stopping me?"
"I know your purpose in coming to this domain, but I won’t let you reach the tower."
"Do you know who I am? Do you think you can stop me with your current cultivation?"

"Of course, I know your identity! You are Yue Ningxue, one of the ancestors of the Celestial Moon Sect, but you abandoned them by joining the Divine Samsara Sect." Yue Ningxue frowned at Zhang Fei [1], but her expression changed once her cultivation soared and was at the same level as hers. "Now, both of our cultivations are the same, so it’s not a problem for me to stop you, right?"

"Heh," Yue Ningxue snorted. "Even if you can raise your cultivation that high using your technique, your strength isn’t permanent, and it will return to your original level once your technique wears off."
"Are you sure about that?"

Yue Ningxue raised her guard as soon as Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from her sight, but a swift and powerful punch suddenly shot toward her. However, she was a cultivator with a lot of experience, and she immediately formed an ice shield around her body.
*Crack... Crack...*
Yue Ningxue’s expression changed as many cracks appeared on her ice shield, and she hurriedly reinforced it with her ice qi.
"Shatter for me!"
*Boom*

"I had expected that you could recognize my golden crow flames."
Yue Ningxue took a deep breath as four more flames appeared around Zhang Fei [1], and she immediately recognized them. "Phoenix flames, dragon flames, vermillion flames, and dark phoenix flames."
Even so, Zhang Fei [1] still held himself back by not using his other flames, such as the Eternal Flames.

"Even if you have the ice element and understand the ice elemental law, both of them will be useless against me." Yue Ningxue was shocked as a bluish-white aura enveloped Zhang Fei [1], and an ice phoenix figure appeared behind him. "Because I myself have the ice element and ice elemental law."

"Impossible! How—" Yue Ningxue stopped speaking and moved from her spot as the ice spears shot toward her, causing them to stick in her previous spot. ’How could this be? How could he possess those flames and ice? That means he has the phoenix, flame dragon, vermillion, dark phoenix, and ice phoenix bloodlines in his body.’

"Are you surprised?" Yue Ningxue immediately jumped up and attacked Zhang Fei [1] with numerous ice feathers, but they instantly evaporated as soon as they came into contact with his golden crow flames. "Your ice element is strong, but it’s just child’s play in front of my flames."

Zhang Fei [1] raised his right hand, and the appearance of the ice-flame spear shocked Yue Ningxue. After all, fire and ice were two opposing elements, and the two would never merge with each other, yet he was able to do something she thought impossible.
"Try blocking my ice-flame spear." The spear quickly shot toward Yue Ningxue as Zhang Fei [1] swung his right hand forward.

Yue Ningxue wasn’t so crazy as to block the ice-flame spear, especially with Zhang Fei [1]’s golden crow flames forming the spear along with his ice-phoenix ice. She hurriedly escaped from his attack radius, and the spear immediately plunged into her previous spot.
*Boom*
A massive explosion occurred in the area, followed by the ground and trees rapidly freezing, turning it into an ice forest.

Yue Ningxue was already standing on a tree a little away from Zhang Fei [1], but her expression changed again when she saw several domains enveloping the entire first area of the forest. She knew all cultivators could master domains because she herself also possessed an ice domain, but she had never encountered someone who could use multiple domains at once before, as using one already drained one’s strength.
Yue Ningxue looked around to check Zhang Fei [1]’s domains, but she could only recognize a few of them.

’A soul domain? Does that mean he is also a soul cultivator? What about his other domains?’ As Yue Ningxue thought about it, countless swords appeared and surrounded her with their tips pointed at her. ’A sword domain!’

"Have you ever heard the saying that age can’t determine everything?" Yue Ningxue was furious and attacked Zhang Fei [1], but her attacks passed right through him. "Even though I am much younger than you, I am no less experienced than you, and you have been in my grasp since I activated some of my domains. If you don’t believe me, you can try to activate your ice domain."

Yue Ningxue wouldn’t do something so stupid, especially with Zhang Fei [1]’s flame and ice domains already active. She would just be wasting her qi for nothing if she did that; instead, he used his best technique to freeze all of his domains.

"Useless." Zhang Fei [1] activated his golden flame domain, and the flames coming out of it instantly evaporated Yue Ningxue’s ice. "The golden crow flame is the strongest flame, and the only thing that can match it is the ice phoenix’s ice, which you don’t have."

In her entire life, Yue Ningxue had never felt so helpless before. She could always defeat all her enemies easily by relying on her ice element, but it was completely useless against Zhang Fei [1] because he possessed the golden crow flames and several other mythical beast flames. Worst of all, he also possessed the ice phoenix bloodline, rendering her ice element completely useless.

"Since my ice element is useless against you, I will use my physical strength to fight you." Yue Ningxue drew her sword and flew toward Zhang Fei [1], but her movements suddenly became sluggish, allowing him to dodge her attacks without much difficulty.

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [1] clamped the tip of Yue Ningxue’s sword with both of his fingers. "I thought I would gain impressive combat experience by fighting you, but you are no different from other reckless cultivators, and you attacked me without knowing the effects of my other domains. Inside my speed domain, I can control everyone’s speed, so your attacks will never be useful as long as you are trapped within it."
Zhang Fei [1] smashed Yue Ningxue’s hand, snatched her sword, and slashed it at her several times.
*Slash... Slash...*

"Argh!" Yue Ningxue screamed in pain after she could move again, and she hurriedly moved away from Zhang Fei [1]. However, she turned furious when her white dress shattered into pieces, revealing her naked body. She felt humiliated by it, and she wanted to take a replacement dress from her storage ring, but several tree roots shot straight at her, binding her. "You bastard! I will definitely kill you and dismember your body!"
"What a lovely sight," Zhang Fei [1] praised, looking at her body. "Your naked body is beautiful, but I have many women who have bodies much more beautiful than yours."

Zhang Fei [1] removed the tree roots, allowing Yue Ningxue to take a replacement dress and get dressed. After she got dressed, he activated his soul domain, forced her soul out of her body, and duplicated it.
Yue Ningxue panicked when she saw that. "What would you do? I will definitely kill you one day!"

"Unfortunately, you won’t have the chance to do that, and you will help me destroy the Divine Samsara Sect from within." Zhang Fei [1] released his soul, merged Yue Ningxue’s duplicate soul with his, and returned her original soul into her body. "Even though it’s only your duplicate soul, I can use it to control you or even kill you. If you don’t want to die, you have to listen to me, or you will know the consequences."

"You—" Zhang Fei [1] removed all his domains and freed Yue Ningxue, but Feltia [2] immediately appeared beside him with equal power. She took a deep breath to calm herself because she knew she wouldn’t be able to face both of them at once. "What do you want from me?"

"Nothing much." Yue Ningxue frowned. "For your information, Yue Xuelian and the Celestial Moon Sect are under the protection of me and Empress Huo. I know you tried to pressure her before, so I want you to stop that and never bother them again; otherwise, I will crush your soul and kill you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1607: Talk With Yue Ningxue
paragraphs: Yue Ningxue walked beside Zhang Fei [1] to go to the second area. "What is your relationship with Yue Xuelian? Why are you and Empress Huo protecting her and her sect?"
"Even though our relationship is not official yet, Yue Xuelian is my woman."
"Huh?" Yue Ningxue was shocked by the news because she was familiar with Yue Xuelian’s character. "You must be bragging! She will never fall in love with any man!"
Zhang Fei [1] looked at her. "Do you know why she never replied to your messages? Why are she and her sect members in this domain with me?"
"Why?"
"Yue Xuelian has moved the Celestial Moon Sect to my domain, so her old sect in the Celestial Moon Domain has been abandoned now."
"Who exactly are you? Where is your domain?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] removed his disguise, causing her to frown. "I’m sure that Liang Huizhong has already told you all about me, so you should be able to recognize me."
Yue Ningxue was truly shocked after seeing his face. "You are Zhang Fei, the person who transformed the Moonlit Passion Temple several years ago."
"That’s right," Zhang Fei [1] nodded. "You don’t need to try to tell Liang Huizhong and the others about me because you will never be able to, as I have full control of your soul."
Yue Ningxue’s face turned ugly when he mentioned that. "Why are you doing this to me?"

"I know your purpose in coming to this domain, and Yue Xuelian is my woman, so I must protect her from you." Zhang Fei [1] stopped walking and faced her. "I’ve long heard of the Divine Samsara Sect, and I already know what Li Guangyu is thinking. Honestly, I don’t care if you want to do all those things to other sects or clans, but I will never allow you to do anything to the people closest to me, especially any of my women. That’s why I did that to you, and you will be my weapon to destroy them from within if they think of bothering us."
Yue Ningxue was furious upon hearing this, and she tried to attack Zhang Fei [1]. However, her body refused to move, and her qi disappeared as soon as she released it.

"I told you that I control your soul, which is the main part of our bodies. As long as your soul is under my control, you won’t be able to do anything to me, but I can do anything to you." Zhang Fei [1] embraced Yue Ningxue’s waist and kissed her lips, leaving her stunned in shock. She trembled strongly as his hands groped her body, especially her breasts. "I could force you to dual cultivate with me right now, but you don’t have to worry because I won’t do that, and I will make you surrender yourself to me voluntarily."
"Tch!" Yue Ningxue slapped his hand away, wiped her lips, and shouted at him. "Keep dreaming! I will never surrender myself to you!"

"Let’s see in the future," Zhang Fei [1] said with a playful smile before walking forward again. "You don’t need to follow me, and you can go directly to the tower to help them deal with those demons. However, you don’t need to attack the members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race because they are under my control like you, and I need them to keep an eye on Sha Mo from afar."
"What are you going to do about the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race?"

"You should know that the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Asura Demon Race, the Torture Demon Race, and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race have ambitions to rule all the domains in this Paradise Realm, right?"

"Yes," Yue Ningxue nodded. "For a long time, those four demon races and the Celestial Demon Race have been the most ambitious to rule this Paradise Realm. However, they never succeeded due to the interference of Long Wuzhao and the two dragons. Unfortunately, the situation in this realm has changed since those gates disappeared, and the three of them can no longer protect all the domains from them."

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [1] looked at the tower. "People from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Torture Demon Race, and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race arrived in the domain long ago, and they captured many cultivators to further their goal of overthrowing Mo Shentian and the Celestial Demon Race."
"Do they really intend to overthrow Mo Shentian and the Celestial Demon Race?" Yue Ningxue asked in shock.

Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "Mo Shentian and the Celestial Demon Race are the main obstacles in their ambitions, so they want to destroy him and his demon race. They don’t dare to attack him openly because of his ability to bend reality, so they want to sacrifice those people to deal with him, and their main target is the people from the Divine Samsara Sect. However, they haven’t been able to do anything against your sect’s people due to the presence of Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong in the tower. If my guess is correct, they will attack your sect after they defeat him and his demon race, and they will target the others after that."

Yue Ningxue understood this situation because the demon race had long been targeting the Divine Samsara Sect, especially since people from her sect had always hindered their plans to invade other domains for the sake of their sect’s interests.

In the past, the Divine Samsara Sect was able to protect some other domains thanks to the existence of those gates, but all of them disappeared several years ago, and they still haven’t managed to map their locations. Even if they did, they couldn’t possibly protect those domains from the demons because the distances were too vast, and they would have to divide their forces to protect them.

Zhang Fei [1] continued. "As I said before, I’m not concerned about the fate of those people or domains, but I can’t stay silent about this matter either. If those demons manage to find my domain, they will definitely attack us, so I have to do something to protect them. I haven’t done anything to the demons of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race, but I have done something to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race."
"What about the other demon races, especially the Celestial Demon Race?"
"You must have heard that my sect accepts demon races, right?"
"Yes."

"For me, all races are no different—be they human, demon, beast, natural, or demihuman. I will accept them as long as they have no ill intentions toward my sect and its people." Yue Ningxue raised an eyebrow slightly after Zhang Fei [1] said that. "For now, six of the ten demon races are on my side, including the Celestial Demon Race."
"What?" Yue Ningxue screamed. "How? How can they be on your side?"
Zhang Fei [1] touched Yue Ningxue’s forehead and shared some things with her, especially about her relationship with the six demon races. "You can see everything for yourself."

Yue Ningxue closed her eyes and watched all of this, but her face turned into a mixture of anger and embarrassment when she saw Zhang Fei [1] dual cultivating with Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu. She was utterly shocked by the revelation, and she didn’t expect that he had such a relationship with the two female demon gods.

In another memory, Yue Ningxue saw Zhang Fei [1] in the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain speaking with Nalan Shizhe, but what shocked her the most was him addressing the female demon god as his mother-in-law. She also saw him talking with Wu Mian, and the Faceless Demon God shared something with him, which proved their excellent relationship.

Then, Yue Ningxue saw the incident when Zhang Fei [1] did something to Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, and both of them became loyal to him since then. In the last memory, she saw him and Mo Zainan lying in bed hugging each other, and she naturally knew that the female demon was Mo Shentian’s wife, which shocked her further.

However, all those memories suddenly disappeared from Yue Ningxue’s mind, and she immediately opened her eyes as she stared at Zhang Fei [1]. "How could you have that kind of relationship with them, especially Mo Zainan?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed. "I won’t explain the details to you, and you just need to know that six of the ten demon races are already on my side. For now, I still haven’t done anything to the Heavenly Fiend Demon God, Sha Mo, but I will act against him soon. Alright, I think we’ve talked enough, and you should head to the tower now. However, you should be careful when you get there because demons of the three demon races are still on the first floor, and they might attack you if you go alone."

Yue Ningxue looked at Zhang Fei [1] for a while, but she didn’t say anything to him and went straight to the next area. On the way there, she saw many women training in the second area, and she believed that they were his women; otherwise, he wouldn’t have wasted time in that area and gone straight to the tower.
"Have you done anything to that woman, Fei’er?"

Zhang Fei [1] looked at Zhang Chen and hugged her waist. "Grandma, that woman is one of the powerful ancestors of the Divine Samsara Sect, and she will be useful in helping me deal with that sect. Anyway, you don’t need to think about her and focus on your training, and I will take you all to the tower after those demons go to the second floor."

"We will try to capture more cultivators on the second floor to make our demon god’s plan a success, and we will escape from this tower if we cannot control the situation."

"Young Lord, you don’t need to worry about us; they won’t be able to stop us if we want to escape."
