"Does that mean the black mark is part of his middle eye’s ability?"

"This black mark is directly related to Qian Yan’s middle eye. Qian Qin immediately contacted her brother, and Qian Yu landed in front of her a few minutes later. "What happened to you? How did you get here? I’ve been trying to find you, but I couldn’t sense your aura before."
"I don’t know how I got here, brother."

He immediately took out his flying artifact and brought his sister aboard it. "We have to return to our domain now, and our father will check your memories."
Qian Qin didn’t say anything and the two immediately left the Glazed Heaven Domain to return to their own domain, which required two weeks of travel.

On the second floor of the tower, Zhang Fei’s entire entourage had already begun their first challenge. Feng Yao, Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng did not join them, but instead, they were protecting them.
Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong stood guard at the entrance to prevent the demons from ascending to the second floor.

"Your daughter is making rapid progress, Brother Bailong." Long Xukong looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who was resting with the other three women. "She’s already completed the eighth challenge, and she’ll be taking on the ninth soon."

"If that happens, they will immediately attack you, and you will die in their hands. If you die, the situation in this Paradise Realm will change greatly, and those demon gods will no longer hold back."

"Don’t you already know the answer?" Long Wuzhao couldn’t help but sigh. "As long as they don’t attack my domain and the Twin Flames Domain, I won’t bother with them because it would just be a waste of my time."
"You are truly heartless!" Long Xukong shouted.

"As I said before, they are cultivators, and many of them are strong enough to fight those demons, so they must be responsible for their lives and the lives of the people in their domain. Feng Yao smiled. "It seems you already know quite a bit about him, little boy."

Li Guangyu and the others on the second floor were flabbergasted by Feng Yao’s statement, but Dugu Yuanshen reacted differently, responding with a relaxed smile. "You’re right, Empress Huo. I already know a few things about him, and I can’t wait for him to complete the last two challenges so we can go up to the third floor together."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Does that mean you’ve decided to side with him, little boy?"

"Empress Huo, you should remember that I never side with any party, right?" Dugu Yuanshen looked at Zhang Fei. "He is different from the other cultivators, including me, and I am curious about his talents. I will not side with him, and I only wish to observe him from the sidelines."

"I won’t say anything for now, and I’ll wait for him to go up to the third floor first."
"Don’t worry, he will definitely go to the third floor."

paragraphs: After ten days, Luo Yunxiao finally completed the ninth challenge. She immediately opened her eyes as soon as her soul returned to her body. She saw that Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, Yue Xuelian, and Helian Xun’er had already started the ninth challenge.

Dugu Yuanshen turned his gaze to Zhang Fei, who had just opened his eyes.

Dugu Yuanshen looked at his disciples, who still hadn’t managed to complete their challenges, and sighed inwardly. He also observed the other cultivators, but many of them were having difficulty with their challenges. He ignored them and closed his eyes again, waiting for his disciples to finish.

Li Guangyu already knew that Yue Ningxue was already on the first floor of the tower, and she informed him that the princes and princesses of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race had left the tower, but their grand elders were still there.

Li Guangyu was confused as to why the demons of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race chose to stay behind, and Yue Ningxue had no intention of attacking them. Besides, she informed him that the group from the War God Pavilion was also already on the first floor.

Li Guangyu tried to contact Liang Huizhong, and his sect master told him that their group would soon arrive at the Glazed Heaven Domain. ’Phew! They will arrive tomorrow! They still have to pass the challenges on the first floor, but that’s not a problem for them because they have already reached this floor many times, so they should be able to get here quickly.’
Li Guangyu breathed a sigh of relief, looked at the core disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect, and continued with his next challenge.
In the tenth challenge, Zhang Fei was faced with all the events of the past. He was unperturbed and unconcerned by everything that appeared before him.
As Luo Yunxiao told the old man, Zhang Fei had long since made peace with his past, so they were no obstacle to him. "Begone!"
After everything disappeared, several people Zhang Fei knew in the present appeared before him, including Yuan Xiajie, Qian Yan, and Taotie.

"If I hadn’t faced you guys before, I would definitely be afraid of you all. I no longer fear you all, as you are merely illusions created by the tower to test me. "Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at both areas alternately. "I’ve always felt that I enjoyed my life as a lust demon, and my demon form has helped me achieve many things in my life to this day, especially all the beautiful wives by my side."
Zhang Fei’s words made his lust demon and calamity demon dragon forms grin uncontrollably, and they tempted him to choose the pitch black area, which would lead him to true darkness.

"You two thought I would choose you two, huh? I’m grateful to have you both inside me, but I will never embrace the darkness. I’m not a savior, but I’m not a destroyer either. I am me, and I will continue to live as myself." Zhang Fei’s lips curled up as he saw their furious expressions, but he ignored them and looked at the ten-tailed fox in the bright area. "Old fox, you know I’ve always been grateful to you, and I’m trying hard to be a worthy heir for you. As I said before, I’m not a savior, and I live for myself and the people around me. Light and darkness are part of my life, and both are beneficial to me, so I won’t choose one over the other."

Zhang Fei exhaled softly, looked at his three forms, and sat between the two areas. He closed his eyes and smiled. "You three are part of me, and none of you is more important than the others. Come to me and be my strength forever! I will use the power of you three to bring peace to this universe, whether it is light or darkness."
After Zhang Fei said that, his three forms immediately moved towards him and entered his body. The light and dark areas mixed together, forming a giant Yin Yang symbol.

High above Zhang Fei, the old man observed him thoughtfully, nodding several times. "That little girl was right about him, wasn’t she? He didn’t choose light or darkness, but he chose to embrace both of them because they are the natural elements of Yin Yang, which also form this universe and everything in it. Light and darkness are part of him, and both have always been his strength. I think he will be the second person to successfully complete this challenge in a short time, and his wife will also complete it soon."
Soon, the old man disappeared from the scene, and the Yin Yang symbol began to spin rapidly. Light and darkness enveloped Zhang Fei’s body, absorbing all the soul fragments within the area.

The old man appeared at Luo Yunxiao’s place, and he found her sitting leisurely on a sofa as she absorbed the soul fragments around her. He didn’t know whether to laugh or cry seeing her like that. All the challenges in the tower were used to test all cultivators, but they seemed pointless to her, which was thanks to her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
Luo Yunxiao looked up after sensing the old man’s presence. "How’s my husband, Senior? Did his last challenge go smoothly?"

The old man sighed as he landed in front of Luo Yunxiao. "As you said before, the last challenge is useless for that young man. He has long since made peace with his past, and he has come to terms with his present. As for his future, he doesn’t dwell on things that haven’t happened yet, and he wants to create the best future for all of you with his own strength."
"Hehe! Told ya!" Luo Yunxiao giggled. "As long as the challenge concerns the past, present, and future, they won’t be able to hinder my husband."
The old man exhaled. "You’re right, they won’t be able to stop your husband, but I’m curious about you. How can you control your physique so well without the ten-tailed fox bloodline?"

"Hu Tianlang’s benevolent soul was with me before, and he taught me many things, including how to control and maximize my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. We were together for several hundred years before he fused with my husband’s soul, so I can use the abilities of my physique without limits."

"I see." The old man nodded in understanding. "I didn’t expect that the ten-tailed fox’s soul would teach you himself. Furthermore, your husband is his sole heir, and his presence by your side helps you maximize your physique."

Luo Yunxiao nodded at him. "In the past, my physique wasn’t active, but Hu Tianlang taught me a lot. When my husband arrived in this Paradise Realm and our bodies became one, my physique was active by itself, and I could immediately control it. So, how long will it take us to complete this challenge?"
"Just wait and absorb all the soul fragments here." The old man immediately disappeared from Luo Yunxiao’s sight.

Luo Yunxiao sighed softly, but a faint smile appeared on her face. "Husband, we’ll go to the third floor together, and you must open the gate to go to the Zhanlu Domain. Those shadowy creatures are indeed dangerous, but I will always be by your side, and I believe the two of us can deal with them."

Another day passed in the outside world. Liang Huizhong and his entourage from the Divine Samsara Sect finally arrived at the Glazed Heaven Domain. He immediately put away his flying artifact and hurriedly led the elders into the forest area, but they stopped in the second forest area after they saw Zhang Fei [1] and all the women.
Zhang Fei [1] also looked at them, but he wasn’t afraid of them. A notification suddenly appeared in his mind, making him smile.
[Ding.]
[The system upgraded to level 9.]
’Should we capture him now, Sect Master?’ A male elder asked, glancing at Zhang Fei [1].

chapters.title: Chapter 1612: Enemies Meet
paragraphs: [The Qi storage has been upgraded to level 5 (Max). Limit: 2,000,000,000 Qi.]
[The Qi Amplifier has been upgraded to Level 5 (Max). Effect: tenfold.]
[The Soul Resonance has been upgraded to Level 3. Effect: sixfold.]
[The Healing Chamber has been upgraded to Level 3. Effect: Sixfold.]
[The shop system has been upgraded.]
[New items are available in all shops.]

Liang Huizhong thought about capturing Zhang Fei [1], but his calmness gave him a bad feeling. Besides, all his women showed no concern about their presence, as if they were confident in their husband’s abilities.

Liang Huizhong glanced at Feng Jiu and Feng Tian, who were a little further away, and he remembered for sure that they were Feng Jiu’s parents. The two phoenixes also glanced at him, but they did not speak or move, waiting for Zhang Fei [1]’s decision.

’Sect Master, we—’ The male elder stopped talking as soon as Feltia [2], followed by Yao Qilin and Fei Lian, appeared on three different tree branches, surrounding them. ’Evil beasts? Why are they siding with him?’

Liang Huizhong and the other elders also recognized Yao Qilin and Fei Lian’s identities, and they did not expect their presence in the forest. Furthermore, they were clearly siding with Zhang Fei [1], which meant they would have to fight both evil beasts if they wanted to capture him.

Liang Huizhong looked at Feltia [2], but he couldn’t recognize that he and Zhang Fei [1] were Zhang Fei’s clones because they were different from ordinary clones. Moreover, Feltia [2] was not in his human form, but he was in his calamity dragon form, and his cultivation was on par with Yao Qilin and Fei Lian’s thanks to the soul link. ’What kind of evil beast is he? Why have I never seen his race before?’

Zhang Fei [1] summoned the demon extermination sword and pointed it at them. "I know you guys are so eager to capture me, but I’m not afraid of you all. If you want to fight, let’s do it now. If you don’t dare to fight, then scram now."

Liang Huizhong and his group were not intimidated by Zhang Fei [1], but they had to carefully consider the possibility of capturing him, particularly given the presence of three evil beasts by his side. Furthermore, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu were also in the forest, which confirmed the rumors of his relationship with Feng Yao.

Offending Feng Yao would be their worst nightmare, especially after her subordinates killed so many cultivators when she returned to the Paradise Realm. Liang Huizhong and his group faced an additional problem as the demons from the three demon races were targeting their sect members in the tower, so he led his group to the next area while they continuously glanced at Zhang Fei [1] and the others.
After they left, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian landed beside Zhang Fei [1]. "Why did you choose not to fight them, Master?"
"Wouldn’t it be better for us if you captured them, Master?"

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at them. "Liang Huizhong is the sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect, remember? Do you think their ancestors would leave him unattended? If we make a move against them, those old people will find out about our actions, and they will try hard to search our domain. Besides, the grand elders of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race are in the tower, so I want to use them to fight those demons."
"So, you plan to pit those people against demons from both demon races?"

"If I make them fight each other, I won’t have to bother fighting them, right?" Zhang Fei [1] looked at the tower in the distance. "Moreover, those demons are clearly targeting the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, so I hope they will harm each other, and I will laugh at their misery."
"So cunning!"

"Forget about them." Zhang Fei [1] looked at the people with him, and he could see that the beasts in the second area didn’t mean much to them, especially after they had trained in the training space for decades. "I think I’ll take them to the third area soon, and I want you two to focus on protecting them."
"Yes, Master."
After that, Zhang Fei [1] jumped onto one of the trees and lay there, checking out the new features of the level 9 system, especially items in all system shops.
"Sect Master, we—"

"Enough." Liang Huizhong looked at the tower. "I want to capture Zhang Fei, but he has such a close relationship with Empress Huo. Even our ancestors didn’t dare to fight that barbaric woman, so we don’t need to mess with her. Furthermore, those demons from the three demon races are in the tower right now, and our sect will be in big trouble if they manage to capture our people, so we should focus on this matter first."
"Yes, Sect Master."

With their speed and cultivation, Liang Huizhong and the others arrived at the first floor of the Tower of Eternity quickly. They couldn’t find Yue Ningxue there, making them think that she was sent somewhere else to undergo a challenge. They saw people from the God of War Pavilion there, but they were focused solely on themselves and didn’t bother with the demons.
"Sect Master, they are here." A male elder looked at Ku Shan and the others.
"Which of them should we target first?"

Liang Huizhong looked at Ku Shan, Ku Yin, Qian Kuang, and Qian Hufeng in turn. "We will target the demons of the Torture Demon Race first, and we must kill them without anyone remaining. Let’s move now! They have almost reached the second floor!"
"Yes."
Ku Shan and Ku Yin frowned as Liang Huizhong and the others moved into their area. "They want to target us."
"Yes," Ku Shan nodded and told his subordinates to gather. "Since they’re targeting us, we must teach them a lesson, and we will capture them."
Ku Yin grinned. "They are overconfident in their strength, but we don’t need to fear them because they are not their ancestors."
"Even so, we still have to be careful because Yue Ningxue is here, and she will definitely help them against us."
"Yeah."
"They don’t seem to dare target us."

Qian Kuang nodded. "They should be aware of our demon god’s true abilities, and they’re probably afraid he’ll decide to come out and attack their sect. Although our people haven’t managed to locate their domain, our demon god can easily find them with the ability of his middle eye."
"What should we do now? Should we leave? Their presence makes the situation in this tower even more complicated, especially with Empress Huo and the three dragons on the second floor."
"Let’s observe their next actions first, and we will leave this tower if the situation does not favor us. Our demon god may punish us, but the punishment will not be too severe."
"Yeah," Qian Hufeng nodded.
Sha Huo exhaled heavily as he looked at the Divine Samsara Sect group. "Grand Elder Huoran, they’re targeting the Torture Demon Race now, but I’m sure they’ll target us next."
"Brother, I think we should leave this tower now," Sha Qingge said in a trembling voice, afraid of being caught by the Divine Samsara Sect members.

Sha Huo looked at his sister and contacted their father, who immediately asked them to leave the tower and return to their domain. "Grand Elder Huoran, my father asked us to go out and return right now."

Sha Huoran was not surprised to hear that because he knew Sha Mo’s character by heart, and his demon god would never sacrifice his two children. However, they couldn’t move on their own because they were in Zhang Fei’s control.

Sha Huo and Sha Huoran suddenly heard Zhang Fei’s voice in their minds, and he asked them to leave the tower directly. They tried to find him on the first floor, but they couldn’t find him because he used his invisibility ability.

Without thinking any further, Sha Huo and the others decided to give up, and the tower immediately sent them to the outermost area. The people of the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race were surprised with their decision, but they did not follow them and continued with their plans.

When Sha Huo and the others arrived at the outermost area, Feltia [2] was already waiting for them there. "Why did you choose to save us? You could have ordered us to stay there and fight with them, and we would probably have died at their hands."

"Why should I let you die in their hands if you’re still useful to me?" Feltia [2] moved beside Sha Qingge and embraced her, making her annoyed and embarrassed. "Your sister is quite pretty, and I like her, so I won’t let her die."
"Ahh! Let me go, you bad lust demon!" Shan Qingge slapped his hand and ran behind her brother. "Don’t ever touch me again! Otherwise... I will bite you to death!"
"Hahaha," Feltia [2] burst into laughter upon hearing that. "Princess, you can bite me if you want, and I won’t fight back."
"Shameless!" Sha Qingge furiously shouted.
Sha Huo and Sha Huoran exchanged glances for a moment. "In that case, we will return to our domain now."

After they left, Feltia [2] let out a soft sigh. "I hope Liang Huizhong and the others will fight with the two demon races inside the tower, and I will secretly help those demons to fight them, so my burden will be slightly reduced."

"Why did you choose to save us?
You could have ordered us to stay there and fight with them, and we would probably have died at their hands."
"Why should I let you die in their hands if you’re still useful to me?" Feltia [2] moved beside Sha Qingge and embraced her, making her annoyed and embarrassed.
"Your sister is quite pretty, and I like her, so I won’t let her die."
"Ahh!
Let me go, you bad lust demon!" Shan Qingge slapped his hand and ran behind her brother.
"Don’t ever touch me again!
Otherwise...
I will bite you to death!"
"Hahaha," Feltia [2] burst into laughter upon hearing that.
"Princess, you can bite me if you want, and I won’t fight back."
"Shameless!" Sha Qingge furiously shouted.
Sha Huo and Sha Huoran exchanged glances for a moment.
"In that case, we will return to our domain now."
After they left, Feltia [2] let out a soft sigh.
"I hope Liang Huizhong and the others will fight with the two demon races inside the tower, and I will secretly help those demons to fight them, so my burden will be slightly reduced."

chapters.title: Chapter 1613: Pit The Enemies
paragraphs: Yue Ningxue, who had just completed her challenge, looked at Liang Huizhong’s group. "Did you guys just arrive?"

"Yes, Ancestor Ningxue." Liang Huizhong looked at the demons from the Torture Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race. "Ancestor, the demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race have already fled, so I think we should target Ku Shan and the others."
Yue Ningxue raised an eyebrow and looked at those demons, thinking about their next move. She knew Ku Shenzu was powerful because she had fought him in the past, but he was not as strong as Qian Yan.

After all, Qian Yan was a demon beast god, and he had support from the four perils. Besides, his middle eye ability was so terrifying that it made Yue Ningxue think twice about attacking his subordinates. If she attacked them, she was afraid that he and the four perils would retaliate against the Heavenlight Domain and the Divine Samsara Sect, resulting in excessive casualties.

The Divine Samsara Sect still had several powerful ancestors who hadn’t appeared in a long time. However, Yue Ningxue wasn’t confident their combined strength would be enough to defeat Qian Yan and the four perils, so she chose to avoid clashing with them, and the demons of the Torture Demon Race were her best option.
*Swoosh*
Several black fireballs suddenly shot towards Liang Huizhong and the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect, and their source came from the Torture Demon Race’s group.
Liang Huizhong and the others hurriedly parried those black fireballs, but they were blown back as soon as their counterattack clashed with those black fireballs.

"Cough." Liang Huizhong coughed slightly as he wiped away a bit of blood that came out of his mouth. He glared at Ku Shan and Ku Yin, who looked baffled by the appearance of those black fireballs, as they had never used such a technique. "Damn it! Those attacks just now were really strong."

Yue Ningxue raised an eyebrow as she realized something. She searched around the first floor, and she was sure that it was Zhang Fei who attacked Liang Huizhong and the others just now, but she couldn’t find his three clones there. ’What does he want? Does he intend to pit us against those demons?’
*Swoosh*

Once again, several black fireballs shot towards Liang Huizhong and the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect, but this time they came from the area where the Thousand Eyes Demon Race entourage was located, and the black fireballs were more powerful than the previous ones.

Liang Huizhong and the others tried to block the black fireballs, but they were knocked back once again until they reached the entrance by the impact of their attacks, causing some of them to vomit blood. "Shit! Those attacks just now are more powerful than before."

Qian Kuang and Qian Hufeng were also shocked by it because they and his subordinates did not attack Liang Huizhong and the others, making them realize that there were some people hiding on the first floor and trying to provoke a fight between them.
They tried searching the area around the first floor, but they also found no one there. ’Whoever attacked those people has excellent hiding abilities!’

Yue Ningxue tried to contact Zhang Fei, and his reply made her frown and become furious. However, she herself was already under his control after their souls merged into one, leaving her powerless to stop him. ’Tch! He’s really too much!’
Zhang Fei’s three clones thought about attacking the demons of both demon races, but they abandoned their plans because they needed them to deal with Liang Huizhong and the others.

Liang Huizhong looked at those demons while clutching his chest, feeling the pain from the previous attack. He was sure that the attack just now did not belong to the demons, and another person attacked them while hiding his or her presence. ’Who exactly attacked us? The power of that attack just now was equivalent to that of a cultivator at the Three-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm or even higher."
*Tap... Tap...*

All of them looked towards the entrance to the second floor and saw Feng Yao standing there with a faint smile. "You guys are getting so impatient, huh? All of you can fight if you want, and I’ll be watching your fight from here."
"Empress Huo, please help us get rid of those demons."

"Why should I help you and your sect members? Compared to other cultivators, I know the rottenness within the Divine Samsara Sect, but you’re lucky that I’m not concerned about your affairs; otherwise, I would have eliminated you all long ago." Feng Yao’s answer made Liang Huizhong’s expression ugly, but he himself knew that he never cared about other people who had no relationship with him. "Besides, you guys are targeting my husband, right? That makes me even lazier to help you, and the people in the Paradise Realm will be grateful if you all die at the hands of the demons."
Liang Huizhong and the elders stiffened as they stared at Feng Yao, not expecting her to know about their plan to capture Zhang Fei.
Ku Shan looked at Feng Yao. "Are you really not going to interfere in our fight, Empress Huo?"
"Are you deaf?" Huo Ling appeared behind Feng Yao. "You demons are just trash and disgusting creatures, and I will burn you alive if you dare doubt her words."

Ku Yan and the other grand elders swallowed their saliva as the eternal flame appeared behind Huo Ling. ’What kind of flame is that? The heat doesn’t feel hot at all, but we can sense a dreadful threat from it.’

"Ling’er." Huo Ling removed the eternal flame after Feng Yao called out to her. "Like I said before, I don’t care if you all want to fight here, and I think it would be good if you could kill a few of them, especially Liang Huizhong."
’This bitch!’ Liang Huizhong cursed in his heart.
Yue Ningxue sighed. "Empress Huo, you—"

"Shut up, little girl." Yue Ningxue wrinkled her forehead. "If you’re truly capable of saving your sect’s people, you can try to save them from these demons yourself. The moment they target my husband, they are my enemies, but I won’t personally kill them, at least not now. If these demons can’t kill them, I might have to step in and do it myself. As for now, I just want to watch a good show, so don’t disappoint me, guys."

Ku Shan and Ku Yin exchanged a brief glance before returning to their demon forms, followed by Qian Kuang and Qian Hufeng. Their subordinates did the same, immediately moving towards Liang Huizhong and the others.

Liang Huizhong and the elders immediately activated their powers and drew their weapons to fight the demons. Unlike the demons, who could move more freely on the first floor, they could only advance or retreat outside because they hadn’t completed many challenges.

Yue Ningxue couldn’t stand by as the demons intended to attack her sect members, and she immediately mobilized her strength. However, her strength suddenly vanished, and Huo Ling was already behind her. "Don’t interfere."

"You—" Yue Ningxue hadn’t finished speaking, but Huo Ling had already brought her to Feng Yao’s side, which shocked her. After all, she hadn’t completed her challenge, and no cultivator could fly to the stairs leading to the second floor without completing all the challenges. ’How could she bypass those challenges and bring me here?’
Yue Ningxue had long realized that Feng Yao was not an ordinary cultivator, but she did not expect that Huo Ling was as unusual as her.
"Are you surprised?"
"Who exactly are you two?"
Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "A weakling like you doesn’t need to know."

Yue Ningxue was annoyed by this because she was one of the strongest cultivators in the Paradise Realm, but Feng Yao called her a weakling. However, she had to accept the fact that she and Huo Ling could restrict her movements, making her unable to move or use her powers.
"Let’s watch their battles, shall we?"
Yue Ningxue sighed inwardly. "Are you really going to let those demons kill Liang Huizhong and the others?"

"You guys have suppressed so many domains and sects to strengthen the Divine Samsara Sect, so you should be prepared for the coming retribution, right?" Yue Ningxue chose not to comment on that. "Besides, they can escape from this tower if they can’t handle those demons, so you shouldn’t need to worry about them."

Yue Ningxue still didn’t say anything to answer Feng Yao, but she sent a voice message to Liang Huizhong and those elders to leave the tower for now; at least they should wait until those demons go to the second floor.

After receiving Yue Ningxue’s orders, Liang Huizhong hurriedly led the elders out of the tower, feeling humiliated. He was furious and frustrated with their situation, but they couldn’t face four demon grand elders and their subordinates at once.
"Hahaha! They’re just cowards!" Ku Yin’s laughter echoed throughout the first floor after the men fled.

"Even so, we shouldn’t be happy because they might summon their other ancestors, and we’ll be dead if they all come to this tower." Ku Shan looked toward the second-floor gate, but Feng Yao and Yue Ningxue had already disappeared from there. "How did Empress Huo manage to bring that woman there without going through all those challenges?"
"No one knows." Qian Kuang shook his head. "Empress Huo has always been mysterious since the past, and none of our demon gods dared to go against her."
"Are we going to chase those people?" Qian Hufeng asked.
Ku Shan shook his head. "If we leave this tower now, we’ll have to repeat all the challenges here, so we shouldn’t do that and head to the second floor as soon as possible."
"Let’s go then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1614: Two New Pill Recipes
paragraphs: "Hmm?" Long Wuzhao and the two dragons were surprised to see Feng Yao bringing Yue Ningxue with her. "Since when have you been in this tower?"
"Yesterday."

Long Wuzhao remembered that Yue Ningxue had already reached the third floor, but she shouldn’t have been able to complete all the challenges on the first floor in just one day. He looked at Feng Yao and thought that she was the one who brought her through all the challenges on the first floor.
Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong also thought the same, and they thought that Long Wuzhao’s past guess about Feng Yao’s identity was indeed correct.

"The people from the Divine Samsara Sect are already on the first floor, and we will use them to fight those demons." Feng Yao waved her hand at the entrance, and crimson flames immediately enveloped it. "You don’t need to worry about the safety of these people, and you can begin your challenges."
"Why is that?"
"Don’t you guys want to go to the Zhanlu Domain?"
Yue Ningxue and the three dragons were shocked again. "Does that mean Zhang Fei will succeed in opening the stone gate on the third floor?"
"Just wait and see."
Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Yue Ningxue immediately began their challenge on the second floor.
Feng Yao looked at Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng. "You guys also start now, and I will protect our people."
"Alright."

Li Guangyu and the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect looked at Feng Yao, but she didn’t care about them and stood casually right in front of the entrance. ’What exactly is that barbarian woman planning? Why did she ask them all to undergo their challenges? Why is Ancestor Ningxue with them? Did she betray us? I have to tell our sect master and the others about her.’
Outside the Tower of Eternity, Liang Huizhong was still furious with Feng Yao for refusing to help them and capturing Yue Ningxue.

Liang Huizhong was confused about how Feng Yao could bring his ancestor directly to the second floor when Yue Ningxue hadn’t completed all the challenges on the first floor. He had challenged the tower several times in the past, and he had once tried to fly to the second-floor stairs, but he was penalized that time. In the end, he worked hard to complete all the challenges on the first floor before he went to the second floor.

A male elder asked him. "What are we going to do now, Sect Master? Those black fireballs don’t belong to the demons of either race, so I’m sure someone is hiding inside and trying to pit us against each other."

"Yes." Liang Huizhong had suspected that from the start, but he couldn’t track the three Zhang Fei clones on the first floor while he was using his invisibility ability. "That mysterious person and Empress Huo clearly want us to be caught by those demons or even die in their hands. If we go in now, that mysterious person and those demons will attack us again, so we should wait for the situation inside to be calmer."
"Should we contact the other ancestors?"

"Even if we contact them, it would take them three weeks to a month to arrive at this domain, and the situation might have already turned bad for our people by then." Liang Huizhong looked towards the entrance, frowning. "The best solution is for them to give up the challenge, and the tower will send them out of there so they don’t have to face those demons. Li Guangyu just informed me that Ancestor Ningxue and the three dragons have already started their challenges on the second floor, so they won’t be able to protect our people."
"I’m still confused by how Empress Huo brought Ancestor Ningxue to the second floor without passing all the challenges on the first floor, Sect Master."

"I don’t have an answer to that, but I’m sure Ancestor Ningxue didn’t betray us, and Empress Huo forced her that way. Even though she was powerful, she wouldn’t be able to defeat that barbaric woman; even Long Wuzhao and the two dragons were beaten black and blue by her in the past." Liang Huizhong contacted Li Guangyu, ordering him to tell their elders and disciples to surrender if the demons of both races reached the second floor. "Let’s wait for now."
"What new items are suitable for us, Mei?"
[Master, the general items have not changed, but there are three new pills in the dual cultivation store.]
"Three pills?" Zhang Fei [1]’s eyes lit up.
[Yes, Master. Extreme Yang Pill, Extreme Yin Pill, and Yin-Yang Harmonization Pill.]
"Oh? What do the three pills do?"
[Wait.]
[Extreme Yang Pill: The Yang Qi produced by the body is 5 times purer; the quantity increases by 5 times.]
[Extreme Yin Pill: The Yin Qi produced by the body is 5 times purer; the quantity increases by 5 times.]
[Yin-Yang Harmonization Pill: The pill harmonizes the Yin and Yang Qi in the body, allowing both to reach equilibrium faster.]
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] calculated the effects of the pill, the Qi Amplifier, and the formation within the pavilion. "Hey! Our cultivation will be much faster with those pills and feature upgrades, Mei."
[Well, that’s true, Master.]
"What else?"
[There are two new beast pills, Master. The Beast Evolution Pill and the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill.]
"Show me."
[The Beast Evolution Pill: Not all beasts can evolve into humans, and this pill forces them to evolve. Note: Extremely painful.]

[The Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill: When consumed, the pill unleashes violent arcs of tribulation lightning within the body, tempering flesh, bones, and meridians as if the cultivator is undergoing a miniature heavenly tribulation.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] rubbed his chin. "Since I am a heavenly fox and the calamity demon dragon, I should be able to swallow the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill. However, I won’t do that now, and I will wait to return to my sect first. As for the Beast Evolution Pill, I think it will be useful for You Bai, Hu Yi, Hu Er, Jui Shui, and Tianguo, especially since they don’t have human forms. Mei, buy the pill now, and I will give it to them."
[Alrighty.]
{You obtained 5x the Beast Evolution Pill.}
{100,000,000 beast essences have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei [1] didn’t mind the deducted beast essences much because he had a large amount of them, and he hadn’t bought any beast items in the shop since he obtained Yao Qilin and Fei Lian. He entered the beast space and gave the pills to the five beasts before coming out again. "What else, Mei?"
[The rest are alchemy recipes and blacksmith blueprints, Master.]
"Hmm? Show me those new alchemy recipes, Mei."

[The Celestial Soul Ascension Pill: A pill that targets the most elusive aspect of cultivation—the soul. Once swallowed, the pill dissolves into a stream of radiant soul light and directly enters the soul world. The cultivator’s soul is enveloped in a heavenly aura, undergoing refinement, expansion, and purification. Faint visions of the heavens and Dao patterns may appear, guiding the soul toward a higher state of existence.]
Zhang Fei [1] fell into a daze for a moment before turning overjoyed. "Do you think that pill can help me break through to the immortal soul stage, Mei?"

[I don’t have an answer for that, Master. Moreover, you don’t have all the ingredients, so you won’t be able to concoct the pill. If my guess is correct, you can only find them in the Ancient Realm, so you’ll have to go there to look for them.]
"Are there any other new pill recipes besides that?"
[There’s another new pill, but you can’t concoct it right now either, and it will be useful for you in facing your lightning tribulation, Master.]
"Show it to me."

[The Heaven Tribulation Conqueror Pill: A legendary pill created for one purpose—to dominate and survive the wrath of Heavenly Tribulation. When taken, the pill creates a bright protective shield inside the user’s body, covering the meridians, dantian, and soul with a tribulation-resistant aura that can resist the heavenly lightning.]

Zhang Fei [1] clenched both his fists as he held back his excitement. Ever since he broke through to the Earth Realm, the only thing he feared most was his lightning tribulations, and he had repeatedly suffered severe injuries every time he broke through. Moreover, the heavens hadn’t sent down his lightning tribulations in his last few breakthroughs, and the last time he faced one was when he broke through to the Celestial Lord Realm years ago.

Zhang Fei [1] felt afraid and horrified that one day the heavens would bring down all his lightning tribulations when he broke through, and he was not sure that he would be able to face such powerful lightning tribulations at once. Unfortunately, he didn’t have the ingredients to concoct the pills, and he had to go to the Ancient Realm to look for them.

The problem was that the situation in the Ancient Realm was in chaos due to the appearance of those shadowy creatures, and they had spread across various domains in that realm. According to the Will of the Universe, they targeted the two souls of the ten-tailed fox there, convincing Zhang Fei [1] that they would attack him as soon as he set foot in that realm.

[Master, I know you want to obtain both the soul of the ten-tailed fox and the ingredients for those pills, but I don’t recommend you go to the Ancient Realm too early. We don’t have clear information about the strength of those shadowy creatures, and I’m afraid that you won’t be able to defeat them.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed. "You’re right, Mei."

Why is Ancestor Ningxue with them?
Did she betray us?
I have to tell our sect master and the others about her.’
Outside the Tower of Eternity, Liang Huizhong was still furious with Feng Yao for refusing to help them and capturing Yue Ningxue.
Liang Huizhong was confused about how Feng Yao could bring his ancestor directly to the second floor when Yue Ningxue hadn’t completed all the challenges on the first floor.
He had challenged the tower several times in the past, and he had once tried to fly to the second-floor stairs, but he was penalized that time.
In the end, he worked hard to complete all the challenges on the first floor before he went to the second floor.
A male elder asked him.
"What are we going to do now, Sect Master?
Those black fireballs don’t belong to the demons of either race, so I’m sure someone is hiding inside and trying to pit us against each other."
"Yes." Liang Huizhong had suspected that from the start, but he couldn’t track the three Zhang Fei clones on the first floor while he was using his invisibility ability.
"That mysterious person and Empress Huo clearly want us to be caught by those demons or even die in their hands.
If we go in now, that mysterious person and those demons will attack us again, so we should wait for the situation inside to be calmer."
"Should we contact the other ancestors?"

"Even if we contact them, it would take them three weeks to a month to arrive at this domain, and the situation might have already turned bad for our people by then." Liang Huizhong looked towards the entrance, frowning.
"The best solution is for them to give up the challenge, and the tower will send them out of there so they don’t have to face those demons.
Li Guangyu just informed me that Ancestor Ningxue and the three dragons have already started their challenges on the second floor, so they won’t be able to protect our people."
"I’m still confused by how Empress Huo brought Ancestor Ningxue to the second floor without passing all the challenges on the first floor, Sect Master."
"I don’t have an answer to that, but I’m sure Ancestor Ningxue didn’t betray us, and Empress Huo forced her that way.

Even though she was powerful, she wouldn’t be able to defeat that barbaric woman; even Long Wuzhao and the two dragons were beaten black and blue by her in the past." Liang Huizhong contacted Li Guangyu, ordering him to tell their elders and disciples to surrender if the demons of both races reached the second floor.
"Let’s wait for now."
"What new items are suitable for us, Mei?"
[Master, the general items have not changed, but there are three new pills in the dual cultivation store.]
"Three pills?" Zhang Fei [1]’s eyes lit up.
[Yes, Master.
Extreme Yang Pill, Extreme Yin Pill, and Yin-Yang Harmonization Pill.]
"Oh?
What do the three pills do?"
[Wait.]
[Extreme Yang Pill: The Yang Qi produced by the body is 5 times purer; the quantity increases by 5 times.]
[Extreme Yin Pill: The Yin Qi produced by the body is 5 times purer; the quantity increases by 5 times.]
[Yin-Yang Harmonization Pill: The pill harmonizes the Yin and Yang Qi in the body, allowing both to reach equilibrium faster.]
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] calculated the effects of the pill, the Qi Amplifier, and the formation within the pavilion.
"Hey!
Our cultivation will be much faster with those pills and feature upgrades, Mei."
[Well, that’s true, Master.]
"What else?"
[There are two new beast pills, Master.
The Beast Evolution Pill and the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill.]
"Show me."
[The Beast Evolution Pill: Not all beasts can evolve into humans, and this pill forces them to evolve.
Note: Extremely painful.]

[The Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill: When consumed, the pill unleashes violent arcs of tribulation lightning within the body, tempering flesh, bones, and meridians as if the cultivator is undergoing a miniature heavenly tribulation.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] rubbed his chin.
"Since I am a heavenly fox and the calamity demon dragon, I should be able to swallow the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill.
However, I won’t do that now, and I will wait to return to my sect first.
As for the Beast Evolution Pill, I think it will be useful for You Bai, Hu Yi, Hu Er, Jui Shui, and Tianguo, especially since they don’t have human forms.
Mei, buy the pill now, and I will give it to them."
[Alrighty.]
{You obtained 5x the Beast Evolution Pill.}
{100,000,000 beast essences have been deducted from your balance.}
Zhang Fei [1] didn’t mind the deducted beast essences much because he had a large amount of them, and he hadn’t bought any beast items in the shop since he obtained Yao Qilin and Fei Lian.
He entered the beast space and gave the pills to the five beasts before coming out again.
"What else, Mei?"
[The rest are alchemy recipes and blacksmith blueprints, Master.]
"Hmm?
Show me those new alchemy recipes, Mei."
[The Celestial Soul Ascension Pill: A pill that targets the most elusive aspect of cultivation—the soul.
Once swallowed, the pill dissolves into a stream of radiant soul light and directly enters the soul world.
The cultivator’s soul is enveloped in a heavenly aura, undergoing refinement, expansion, and purification.
Faint visions of the heavens and Dao patterns may appear, guiding the soul toward a higher state of existence.]
Zhang Fei [1] fell into a daze for a moment before turning overjoyed.
"Do you think that pill can help me break through to the immortal soul stage, Mei?"
[I don’t have an answer for that, Master.
Moreover, you don’t have all the ingredients, so you won’t be able to concoct the pill.
If my guess is correct, you can only find them in the Ancient Realm, so you’ll have to go there to look for them.]
"Are there any other new pill recipes besides that?"
[There’s another new pill, but you can’t concoct it right now either, and it will be useful for you in facing your lightning tribulation, Master.]
"Show it to me."
[The Heaven Tribulation Conqueror Pill: A legendary pill created for one purpose—to dominate and survive the wrath of Heavenly Tribulation.
When taken, the pill creates a bright protective shield inside the user’s body, covering the meridians, dantian, and soul with a tribulation-resistant aura that can resist the heavenly lightning.]
Zhang Fei [1] clenched both his fists as he held back his excitement.
Ever since he broke through to the Earth Realm, the only thing he feared most was his lightning tribulations, and he had repeatedly suffered severe injuries every time he broke through.
Moreover, the heavens hadn’t sent down his lightning tribulations in his last few breakthroughs, and the last time he faced one was when he broke through to the Celestial Lord Realm years ago.

Zhang Fei [1] felt afraid and horrified that one day the heavens would bring down all his lightning tribulations when he broke through, and he was not sure that he would be able to face such powerful lightning tribulations at once.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have the ingredients to concoct the pills, and he had to go to the Ancient Realm to look for them.
The problem was that the situation in the Ancient Realm was in chaos due to the appearance of those shadowy creatures, and they had spread across various domains in that realm.
According to the Will of the Universe, they targeted the two souls of the ten-tailed fox there, convincing Zhang Fei [1] that they would attack him as soon as he set foot in that realm.
[Master, I know you want to obtain both the soul of the ten-tailed fox and the ingredients for those pills, but I don’t recommend you go to the Ancient Realm too early.
We don’t have clear information about the strength of those shadowy creatures, and I’m afraid that you won’t be able to defeat them.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed.
"You’re right, Mei."

chapters.title: Chapter 1615: Third Floor
paragraphs: Time passed quickly, and a week passed swiftly. The demons of both demon races had already reached the stairs to the second floor, but Feng Yao’s crimson flames prevented them from proceeding.
Ku Yin and Ku Shan tried to break through the blockade, but Feng Yao’s crimson flames immediately counterattacked them, severely injuring them.

Qian Kuang and Qian Hufeng wanted to try attacking, but they abandoned their plan after examining Ku Yin and Ku Shan’s injuries. Their injuries were quite severe even from a small counterattack, and they would face the same fate as the two if they forced their way through.

Behind them, Dugu Qingshu and the people from the War God Pavilion were slightly surprised by the incident. They guessed that Feng Yao was preventing the demons from ascending to the second floor, especially since their presence there would bring trouble to everyone undergoing their challenges.
Dugu Qingshu and the others thought about attacking those demons, but Dugu Yuanshen ordered them not to make a move against them and focus on their challenges, so they abandoned their intentions.

After they checked their injuries, Ku Yin and Ku Shan decided to take their men to leave the tower. Qian Kuang and Qian Hufeng also did the same, as they couldn’t possibly face the cultivators with their group alone, rendering the three demon races’ plans futile. Even so, they had previously captured many human cultivators in the forest, so their purpose for going to the Glazed Heaven Domain was not entirely in vain.

After learning of the demons’ departure, Liang Huizhong and the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect decided to enter the tower. However, their goal of entering the tower failed miserably as they failed to kill the demons, which all happened because of Zhang Fei’s actions a week ago. Since the situation was safe, they did not leave the tower and underwent all the challenges on the first floor.

The people from the War God Pavilion could see that Feng Yao’s crimson flames disappeared from the entrance to the second floor, and they immediately quickened their pace to complete all the challenges on the first floor.

Li Guangyu had also received information from Liang Huizhong about the demons’ departure from the tower, which relieved him and meant he no longer needed to worry about the disciples of their sect. He focused entirely on all the challenges on the second floor, hoping to reach the third floor this time.
Another week passed.

The people from the War God Pavilion who were previously on the first floor had made it to the second floor, where quite a few cultivators were undergoing their challenges, except for Feng Yao. Although Dugu Yuanshen had informed them, they were still quite surprised to see so many people manage to reach the ninth area.

The situation on the second floor was completely safe without the presence of the demon races, and the cultivators there weren’t concerned about each other’s presence. The cultivators were preoccupied with their own challenges, which posed significant difficulties for them.
Two weeks have passed since they began their challenges, but Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, Yue Xuelian, and Helian Xun’er still haven’t managed to complete their ninth challenge.
Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, Yue Ningxue, and the three dragons faced no difficulty in any of their challenges. It only took them two weeks to reach the eighth area.
The people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Celestial Moon Sect, and Spring Zenith Sect encountered significant difficulties in their challenges.
Some of them decided to give up and return outside the forest, and Zhang Fei [1] sent them back to the Twin Flames Domain.
The remaining people from their entourage were Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Lu Shaqing, Gong Wei, Yue Qianrou, Yue Qingyi, Nong Qinwei, Lan Xuening, Dongfang Yuechan, and a few others.

Meanwhile, the disciples of the Divine Samsara Sect struggled to complete their third challenge, as did Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng. However, they felt reassured after learning that the demons had disappeared from the tower, so they didn’t need to feel pressured to continue.
After two weeks, Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao finally completed their tenth challenge, leaving them smiling with joy. "How was your last challenge, Husband? Did you have any difficulties?"

"No," Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "I’ve long since made peace with my past, so the first test wasn’t difficult for me. I’ve also met Yuan Xiajie, Qian Yan, and Taotie before, so I was able to pass them straight away. As for those fake futures, they don’t affect me because my future is in my hands, but it took me a long time to absorb those soul fragments. Unfortunately, their number was too small for my soul power to break through to the immortal soul level."

"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao hugged and kissed him. "I already guessed that the final challenge wouldn’t be difficult for you, but the number of those soul fragments was too many, so we needed a long time to absorb everything."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked back and smiled at Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, Yue Xuelian, and Helian Xun’er. He swept his gaze over the others, not expecting Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, Yue Ningxue, and the three dragons to complete their first seven challenges so quickly.
Zhang Fei was a little disappointed because only a few people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Celestial Moon Sect, and Spring Zenith Sect were left on the second floor.

Zhang Fei didn’t expect Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng to still have difficulty facing all the challenges on the second floor, even though they had both challenged the tower several times in the past. He wasn’t concerned about the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, and he hoped that they would fail or die, but it was all in vain because the demons had already left the tower.

"You can go to the third floor now, and I will protect them here." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao in the distance. "I don’t know whether you can open the gate on the third floor or not, but you shouldn’t go straight to the Zhanlu Domain if you do, and you should wait for the others."
Zhang Fei simply nodded and lifted Luo Yunxiao to his feet. "Would you like to join us on the third floor, Senior?"

"Yes." Dugu Yuanshen rose from his seat and looked at his disciples. "The situation in the tower has calmed down now, and my disciples will definitely be able to pass their challenges, so I will go to the third floor with you two."
"Let’s go, Senior."
[Quest II: Clear the second floor.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Complete.]
[Reward: Eternity gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
When the three of them arrived at the second floor, they saw two people from the natural races meditating there.
"Husband, don’t those two come from the giant and druid races?" Luo Yunxiao whispered.

The woman looked so young, and she had blonde hair that flowed down to the floor, with bangs covering her forehead. Her ears were pointy like an elf’s, but she wasn’t an elf, and her lips looked sensual. Even though she looked young, like a girl in her twenties, she had a mature and alluring figure, and her body exuded a sensual aura that could captivate the hearts of men. Her figure was quite tall, around 6’3". She had perfect hourglass curves and beautiful long legs. The sexy green dress accentuated her smooth, fair complexion, highlighting her prominent E-Cup breasts beneath.
As for the man, Zhang Fei was not surprised by him because his appearance was similar to the members of the giant race who had sworn allegiance to him, such as Ju Tan and the others.
"Yes," Zhang Fei observed the two of them. ’Scan their status, Mei.’
[Alrighty.]
Name: Ju Jushen
Age: ???
Race: Giant
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm
Element:
- Earth [Peak Stage]
Elemental law:
- Earth [Perfection Stage]
Core:
- Earth [Peak Rank]
Physique: Giant
Special Physique: Earth Dragon
Special Bloodline: Earth Dragon
Partner: Ju Fengrou
Name: Lu Wangyi
Age: ???
Race: Druid
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Wood [Peak Stage]
Elemental laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Wood [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Light [Peak Rank]
- Wood [Peak Rank]
Physique: Druid
Special Physique: Wood Dragon
Special Bloodline: Wood Dragon
Partner: None

Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he read their statuses. ’So, they’re the two people Tianshi Shengjie was referring to back then, eh? The male giant is already so powerful, but the female druid is even stronger than him, and her cultivation is on par with Qing Qiu’er’s.’
"Do you two know them?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Dugu Yuanshen. "This is my first time seeing them, and the female druid is just as powerful as you, Senior."
"I’ve never met them before either." Luo Yunxiao answered him.
Hearing their voices, Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi opened their eyes, but their attention was solely focused on Zhang Fei.
*Boom*

In an instant, Ju Jushen disappeared from their sight, but Zhang Fei immediately moved, and their fists clashed moments later. Both of them were pushed back a few steps, but they quickly stabilized themselves.
Dugu Yuanshen wanted to help Zhang Fei, but Luo Yunxiao stopped him. "Don’t interfere, Senior."
"Why?"

"This is their private matter, and my husband must face that male giant himself to prove his strength." Dugu Yuanshen raised his eyebrows slightly, looking at Luo Yunxiao’s confident smile. "Don’t worry, my husband won’t lose to him."
Ju Jushen and Zhang Fei dashed toward each other, and their fierce fists collided once again, causing both of them to stagger a few steps back.
*Boom*
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as several tree roots moved toward him, but he immediately used his Tree Control and Plant Manipulation abilities to control them before dispelling them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1616: Fighting Lu Wangyi - Ju Jushen
paragraphs: Lu Wangyi was momentarily surprised when Zhang Fei removed her tree roots so easily, but she didn’t know that he possessed the wood element and his demon abilities were mimicked by Lillea and Janette. She didn’t stop there, and a wooden dragon emerged from behind her and shot towards him.
Meanwhile, Ju Jushen dashed toward Zhang Fei with both hands covered in earth elements, and the silhouette of an earth dragon roared behind him.

Dugu Yuanshen stood in front of Luo Yunxiao to protect him, but his gaze never left Zhang Fei’s figure, waiting for his action to deal with the attacks of the two people. Even though their attacks were so powerful, he could feel that there was no killing intent in them, proving that they had no intention of killing him. ’Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen seem to be testing his strength.’

"Earth dragon and wood dragon! You two are amazing because you can obtain their physique and bloodline." Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen looked at Zhang Fei, who was trying to dodge their attacks, with raised eyebrows. "Unfortunately, you two don’t know me, and you’re overconfident in your abilities, so let me show you the power of real beasts."
Zhang Fei transformed into his heavenly fox form, which grew in size after he broke through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, with nine tails dancing behind him.
Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen were not surprised to see Zhang Fei’s heavenly fox form, but Dugu Yuanshen was truly shocked to see his enormous body size.

Zhang Fei also activated all his bloodlines, except his calamity demon dragon bloodline. Soon, figures of a golden crow, a phoenix, a vermilion bird, a dark phoenix, a flame dragon, a mythical deer, an azure emperor roc, a rainbow-shelled tortoise, an azure dragon, and a white tiger appeared around him.

This time, Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen were completely shocked to see all those mythical beast figures, wondering how Zhang Fei could get them. Dugu Yuanshen stood stupidly, and his eyes widened as he stared at them.

Zhang Fei didn’t stop there and summoned eight out of ten heavenly flames, making the air temperature on the third floor scorching hot. Phoenix flame, soul flame, dragon flame, earth flame, sky flame, blood flame, moon flame, and eternal flame revolved around him.
"Haha," Huo Yan, the flame spirit, came out of Zhang Fei’s body, followed by the lightning spirit, Lei, and the darkness spirit, the dark fairy. "You two are not worthy of testing our master."
’Fire, darkness, and lightning spirits!’ Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen screamed in their hearts.

Dugu Yuanshen was utterly speechless at the sight, and he could no longer gauge the depth of Zhang Fei’s strength. From the beginning, he had known that he was different from other cultivators, but he had no idea about the extent of his strength.
"Attack them!" At Zhang Fei’s command, all the mythical beasts opened their mouths, attacking Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen directly.

"Shit!" Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen cursed after their wood and earth dragons were shattered by the attacks of those mythical beasts, followed by an attack of eight heavenly flames that shot toward them. Of all Zhang Fei’s attacks, they feared the eternal flame the most. Although they didn’t know what kind of flame it was, they could sense the deadly aura radiating from it.
Huo Yan, Lei, and the dark fairy did not remain silent and attacked Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen as well.
Huo Yan, Lei, and the dark fairy did not remain silent and attacked Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen as well.
*Crack."

Huo Yan, Lei, and the dark fairy also descended and hovered behind Zhang Fei. "Are you two satisfied after seeing my strength?"

Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen lowered their hands and opened their eyes, staring at Zhang Fei in disbelief. They had heard about his feat of defeating the former fairy king single-handedly, but they were still shocked after seeing his strength. They knew his strength was not his own but borrowed, but they were still shocked that it could surpass theirs.

"Hahaha," Ju Jushen laughed out loud before cupping his hands towards Zhang Fei. "I admit that I underestimated you, the heir of the ten-tailed fox. Although your strength is only borrowed, it is still yours. If you had targeted all your attacks just now at us, we would have definitely suffered heavy injuries or even died."

"That’s true." Lu Wangyi wiped the sweat from her forehead. "I didn’t expect you to be able to borrow such a tremendous amount of power without experiencing backlash! I’ve met some cultivators who used such methods to increase their strength, but their bodies couldn’t endure the backlash, which resulted in them being severely injured."
"Hey! Don’t compare my master with those idiots!" Huo Yan shouted at him. "If my master were an ordinary cultivator, I would never acknowledge him as my master!"

The darkness spirit, the dark fairy, didn’t say anything to them, but her expression showed pride in her master.

"Hahaha! You three are right! No cultivator in this universe can underestimate your master, including Long Wuzhao. "Yes," Zhang Fei nodded to her. "Luo Yunxiao comes from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and she is the heir of the old fox’s special physique."

"I see." Lu Wangyi nodded in understanding. "You two are destined to be together. You are the heir to the ten-tailed fox, and she inherited its physique. If you two fight together, no cultivator in this Paradise Realm can defeat you two, including the four perils."
Zhang Fei turned to Luo Yunxiao, who immediately walked beside him. "They are Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen."
"Nice to meet you both, Seniors."
Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "Our task here is to find the key to open the stone gate, but we must be careful when opening it because we don’t know what lies behind it."

"The gate connects this tower to the Tower of Eternity in the Zhanlu Domain, one of the domains in the Ancient Realm." Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen exchanged shocked glances. "I heard that from Empress Huo, and I’m sure she wouldn’t tell me anything wrong. Unfortunately, the situation in that domain is unstable, and many shadowy creatures appeared there, controlling many beasts and demons."
"What are shadowy creatures?"
Zhang Fei shook his head. "I don’t have much information about them, but someone told me that they emerged from the core of this universe."
"I didn’t expect we would meet here, Senior Jushen and Senior Wangyi." They turned to Dugu Yuanshen, who was walking towards them.

"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed. "We both came here specifically to wait for him, but I didn’t expect you to be with him, little boy. Moreover, your cultivation has now reached our level, and you also possess extraordinary techniques that are comparable to those of the Asura Demon Race."
Dugu Yuanshen smiled upon hearing this. "Senior Jushen, I was able to reach this stage through hard work. As for my technique, I didn’t create it, but it’s a legacy from my ancestors."

"Haish," Ju Jushen hissed. "I remember Dugu Zhentian’s strength very well, and I almost lost when we fought in the past. Unfortunately, he didn’t live long, and he died too quickly. If he were still alive now, I’m sure his strength would already surpass ours, and I wouldn’t be able to match him in battle."
"Everything is predestined, Senior Jushen."

chapters.title: Chapter 1617: Zhang Fei - The Mysterious Man
paragraphs: ’Can you detect the metal elemental seed, Mei?’
[Master, the metal elemental seed is on this floor, but I can’t pinpoint its location. It’s invisible to the naked eye because it’s blocked by something, but I don’t know what’s blocking it.]
Zhang Fei looked at Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi. "What exactly are the challenges on the third floor? Why don’t I see anything here but empty space?"

Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen exchanged glances for a moment. "This third floor is called the Transcendent Floor, and only cultivators who have successfully completed the challenges on the lower two floors can ascend here."
"The challenges on the third floor are different from the previous two floors, and they will appear once in a while. We will face various challenges, but mostly, we will face many battles."
"If we manage to pass each challenge, we will get rewards that are useful for us, such as technique books, weapons, equipment, useful consumable items, and many other things."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "How long is the time interval for each challenge?"
"I can’t say that for sure, and you can wait for your first challenge to appear."
"Sigh." Zhang Fei sighed softly and walked towards the stone gate, followed by Luo Yunxiao and the others. As soon as he touched the gate, he suffered a heavy headache that made him vomit. "Bleurgh!"
"Husband!" Luo Yunxiao hurriedly supported him and asked. "What happened? Why did you suddenly vomit like this?"
"Did you see something, Master?" Huo Yan asked as he floated beside him. Lei and the dark fairy didn’t say anything, but they were also worried about their master.

"I’m fine." Zhang Fei wiped his mouth. "Even though this door is tightly sealed, I can feel the aura of those shadowy creatures, and they are much stronger than I previously expected. Many of them have already reached the top of the tower in the Zhanlu Domain, and they should be able to feel my presence here. If we succeed in finding the key and opening the gate, they will invade this realm immediately, and many cultivators will fall under their control."
"How strong are those shadowy creatures, young man?"

"They are strong! I can’t describe their strength! No one in this Paradise Realm can face them, including Long Wuzhao." Dugu Yuanshen, Lu Wangyi, and Ju Jushen were shocked to hear that. "Empress Huo is the most powerful cultivator in this realm, but I’m not sure she can defeat them. However, she has Huo Ling by her side, and I’m sure that hot-headed woman can help her."
"Who is Huo Ling? Why have I never heard of her?" Lu Wangyi asked.

"I can’t tell you her true identity, but I can tell you that she’s powerful. I’m sure she can fight those shadow creatures, but I’m not certain that she will act, especially with her character like that." Zhang Fei asked the three spirits to return to his body, which they immediately complied with. "I want to go to the Ancient Realm, but I’m not sure I can get there with those shadowy creatures in the tower."
"Why are you so eager to go to the Ancient Realm?"

Zhang Fei sighed and answered Ju Jushen. "The two last souls of the old fox are in the Ancient Realm, so I must go there to meet them. Without them, the ten-tailed fox will never return to this universe, and peace will never come."

"I see." Ju Jushen nodded in understanding, but his vision suddenly blurred, and he fell unconscious a moment later. Lu Wangyi and Dugu Yuanshen experienced the same thing, except for Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao.
Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao frowned at the sight, but a man appeared above the gate and spoke to them. "You two don’t need to worry about them. I need to talk to you, so I put them to sleep."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao looked up. "Who exactly are you? How did you suddenly appear in this place?"
"Hahaha," The man laughed. "I have no name, and I am the will of my true self. He accidentally created this universe, and he didn’t realize he left me here when it happened."
"Husband." Luo Yunxiao hugged his arm tighter.
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Do you have a relationship with that young woman?"
"No." The man shook his head. "That young woman came from another universe, and she came here to find a way to free her father from the core of their universe."
Zhang Fei took a deep breath after he realized the identity of the young woman who accidentally killed him and brought him back to life.
The man spoke. "I didn’t come to you to talk about that young woman, but I wanted to talk to you about those shadowy creatures."
"Where did they come from? Why did they suddenly appear in this universe? What is their real purpose?" Zhang Fei asked.

"As you already know, this universe was born from Yin and Yang—good and evil, and those shadowy creatures are the incarnation of the evil side hidden in this universe." Zhang Fei frowned. "They have existed since the birth of this universe, but they were locked away deep in the core, and they were finally freed after the core of this universe manifested itself. They had never moved before, and they took advantage of the damage and chaos in this universe to strengthen themselves. They were strong now, so they decided to appear on the surface, and they intended to destroy this universe."
"The core of this universe? Who is that person?"
"Don’t you already have the answer?"
"Is that person Feng Yao?" The man didn’t nod or shake his head, but Zhang Fei already knew his guess was correct. "How are we going to stop those shadowy creatures? Can you stop them?"

"I am merely the will born from my true self, and I possess no power whatsoever, so I can’t stop them." The man pointed at him. "You can stop them, but you’re still too weak to fight them, and they will devour you alive if you encounter them now. Besides, they are only pawns, and the core creature has not yet surfaced. To stop the chaos in this universe, you must kill it, and those shadowy creatures will disappear forever."
"Where is the location of the core creature? How can I stop it?"

"Unfortunately, the core creature escaped due to her mistake, and I haven’t managed to find it yet, so I can’t tell you about its location." Zhang Fei was disappointed. "To stop the core creature, you must evolve into the ten-tailed fox first, and you must gather allies who can help you. Some of them are already by your side, including this little girl. She inherited the old ten-tailed fox’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, so you must always bring her wherever you go because you will never be complete without her."
Zhang Fei looked at Luo Yunxiao, who smiled at him. He returned his gaze to the man. "Who are the others?"

"Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race. This way, you only need to find representatives from the demihuman race and the demon race, and they will be your strength to defeat the core creature."

"Is the representative of the demihuman race already by my side?" The man shook his head at Zhang Fei. "I can’t think of the representative of the demihuman race for now, but I have an idea of the representative of the demon race."
"Those ten demon gods can’t help you deal with those shadowy creatures and their main core."
"The people I mean are not them."
"Who are you referring to, Husband?"

"The woman inside the Lotus Limbo World," Luo Yunxiao remembered. "She wanted to imprison the old fox there in the past, but she couldn’t stop him because he possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. If my guess is correct, she should be the representative of the demon race."
"Does that mean you’re going into the Lotus Limbo World to meet her? What if she won’t let you leave that place?" Luo Yunxiao worriedly asked.

The man spoke directly. "As I said before, the two of you must always be together, and you will be his strength because you inherited the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. He won’t be able to leave that place if he enters alone, but the story will be different if you join him, so you have to help him to meet that woman."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "He is my husband, and I am the inheritor of the old fox’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, so I will assist him to the best of my ability."
"That’s good."

Zhang Fei asked the man. "Do you know the locations of the possessors of the Immortal Sacred Physique, the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique, the Universe Tree Physique, the Heavenly Calamity Physique, and the Void Emperor Physique?"
"Hmm?" The man raised an eyebrow before nodding to Zhang Fei. "They are in the Ancient Realm, except for the owner of the Void Emperor Physique."
"Where is that person located?"

"Inside the void core." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "If you want to meet that person, you’ll have to wait for Bing Xingying to break through to the Celestial God Realm first, but she won’t be able to do so anytime soon. I think I’ve talked too much with you, and it wouldn’t be good for you if you knew more now, so I have to go now. I hope you’ll succeed in stopping the core creature and restoring peace to this universe, or it will be destroyed because of them."
