She inherited the old ten-tailed fox’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, so you must always bring her wherever you go because you will never be complete without her."
Zhang Fei looked at Luo Yunxiao, who smiled at him.
He returned his gaze to the man.
"Who are the others?"

"Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race.
This way, you only need to find representatives from the demihuman race and the demon race, and they will be your strength to defeat the core creature."
"Is the representative of the demihuman race already by my side?" The man shook his head at Zhang Fei.
"I can’t think of the representative of the demihuman race for now, but I have an idea of the representative of the demon race."
"Those ten demon gods can’t help you deal with those shadowy creatures and their main core."
"The people I mean are not them."
"Who are you referring to, Husband?"
"The woman inside the Lotus Limbo World," Luo Yunxiao remembered.
"She wanted to imprison the old fox there in the past, but she couldn’t stop him because he possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
If my guess is correct, she should be the representative of the demon race."
"Does that mean you’re going into the Lotus Limbo World to meet her?
What if she won’t let you leave that place?" Luo Yunxiao worriedly asked.
The man spoke directly.
"As I said before, the two of you must always be together, and you will be his strength because you inherited the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
He won’t be able to leave that place if he enters alone, but the story will be different if you join him, so you have to help him to meet that woman."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding.
"He is my husband, and I am the inheritor of the old fox’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, so I will assist him to the best of my ability."
"That’s good."
Zhang Fei asked the man.

"Do you know the locations of the possessors of the Immortal Sacred Physique, the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique, the Universe Tree Physique, the Heavenly Calamity Physique, and the Void Emperor Physique?"
"Hmm?" The man raised an eyebrow before nodding to Zhang Fei.
"They are in the Ancient Realm, except for the owner of the Void Emperor Physique."
"Where is that person located?"
"Inside the void core." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.
"If you want to meet that person, you’ll have to wait for Bing Xingying to break through to the Celestial God Realm first, but she won’t be able to do so anytime soon.
I think I’ve talked too much with you, and it wouldn’t be good for you if you knew more now, so I have to go now.
I hope you’ll succeed in stopping the core creature and restoring peace to this universe, or it will be destroyed because of them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1618: Demon God Qian Yan
paragraphs: Zhang Fei fell into deep thought after the mysterious man disappeared, and his reappearance raised many questions in his heart. Now, he knew about the multiverse, and the young girl had come from another universe. However, the main question was the mysterious man’s identity, mainly because his real body was the creator of his universe and the others, even though he did so by accident.
Luo Yunxiao asked him directly. "Are you thinking about the mysterious man’s identity, husband?"

"The mysterious man’s true identity and the existence of other universes disturb my mind, especially about how that young girl managed to cross into our universe. I want to meet her, but I don’t know where she is or how to contact her." Zhang Fei sighed. "Forget it; we should focus on the problem at hand for now, particularly the emergence of those shadowy creatures. Even if I manage to find the key to open this gate, I will have to think twice about going to the Ancient Realm. If I force myself to go there with my current strength, they will probably possess me and take over my body, like they take over the bodies of those beasts and demons."
"What if we enter the Lotus Limbo World and meet that woman?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.

Luo Yunxiao spoke to him again. "As the mysterious man said, you need the help of one person from all races, and four are already by your side. We still don’t know the identity of the representative from the demihuman race, and you guessed that woman is a representative from the demon race, so I think we should meet her first."

Zhang Fei wanted to go to the Lotus Limbo World, but he remembered the warnings from the two souls of the giant yin-yang lotus and Su Yuangu. After all, his cultivation had only reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, and he wasn’t sure he could face that woman even if Luo Yunxiao helped him with her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. If their abilities were not enough to defeat her, they would die there, and everyone close to them would also die because of that shadowy creature.

Luo Yunxiao hugged him and kissed him. "I understand your considerations, Husband. However, you must realize that we cannot let this matter slide, and we must do something to deal with those shadowy creatures. The only solution to dealing with them is for you to go to the Ancient Realm to meet the old fox’s greed and envy souls, and you can meet his wrath soul after you obtain both souls. That way, you will evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and you will be unrivaled in this universe."
"Let me think about it first, Yunxiao."
"Alright."
Zhang Fei wanted to awaken Dugu Yuanshen, Lu Wangyi, and Ju Jushen, but the first challenge suddenly appeared, sending him and Luo Yunxiao to another place.
Meanwhile, Qian Yu and Qian Qin had arrived at their domain, and both of them went straight to their father’s room.

Inside the room, Qian Yan was sleeping in her demon beast form. However, his form was not as big as the one faced by Zhang Fei in the second soul challenge, as he deliberately shrank his body to the size of a normal beast. He slowly opened his eyes and looked at his two children, especially his daughter, Qian Qin.
Qian Qin trembled when Qian Yan’s middle eye opened and stared at her, but he closed it again not long after and returned to his human form.

Qian Yan’s human form was no different from an ordinary human, but his body was very tall—around two meters or more. His body was large and filled with muscles that protruded from beneath his skin. His face appeared furious as he questioned them. "What happened in that tower? Why did you two come back so quickly?"

"There’s been a lot of trouble in the tower, Father." Qian Yan frowned at his son. "Empress Huo, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, Emperor Long, Tianshi Bailong, and Long Xukong were present at the tower to protect those humans."
"Hmm?" Qian Yan was slightly surprised to hear that. "How did they appear there?"

"Empress Huo, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng protected the group from the Twin Flames Domain, and the three dragons came after we entered the tower. Apart from them, Yue Ningxue, people from the Divine Samsara Sect, and people from the War God Pavilion were also there, so we were all forced to flee from there." Qian Yu created several qi screens, allowing his father to observe the situation in the Tower of Eternity himself. "Before we entered the tower, we captured many human cultivators, but I don’t know if there are enough of them to use as sacrifices."

Qian Yan didn’t answer his son and watched all the images that appeared on those qi screens, but he trembled when he saw Feng Yao’s face, remembering their fight in the past, which ended with his crushing defeat. "What about the people from those two demon races?"
"They also escaped from the tower, and they are on their way back to their respective domains."
Qian Yan nodded slightly. "Go back and rest, Qin’er."
"Yes, Father." Qian Qin hurriedly left the room.

Qian Yu remembered Zhang Fei and brought up his image on one of the qi screens. "Father, I heard his name is Zhang Fei, and he has a close relationship with Empress Huo. Tianshi Bailong also seems to be close to him, especially since his daughter was with him at the tower."

"Hmm?" Qian Yan looked at Zhang Fei’s image for some time before opening his middle eye to examine the tower, but he couldn’t find him anywhere. As he thought that, a powerful aura attacked him, forcing him to close his middle eye. "Damn it! That woman is still as terrifying as ever! She even knew that I was checking the tower with my middle eye!"
Qian Yu was stunned for a moment, but he immediately realized the woman his father was referring to was Feng Yao. He was the only cultivator in the Paradise Realm who could still fear his father.

"That woman seems to have a close relationship with Zhang Fei; otherwise, she wouldn’t have protected him like that." Qian Yu agreed with his father. "Go back first! I will contact Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu."
"Yes, Father."
After his son left, Qian Yan contacted Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu, discussing the results of their children in the Glazed Heaven Domain as well as their next plans.
"Hmm? That Heavenly Fiend Demon God seems to have other plans, but he’s still hiding them from us." Qian Yan returned to his beast form and continued his hibernation.
"Qin." Qian Qin looked at her brother. "Do you really not remember anything that happened to you back then?"

Qian Qin shook her head. "I don’t remember anything, Brother. By the way, thank you for not telling our father about that matter; otherwise, he would have used every means to investigate, and I would have suffered just like our big sister."
"Sigh." Qian Yu sighed and hugged his sister from behind. "I know you’re uncomfortable with your situation, but there’s nothing I can do to get you out of it."

Qian Qin leaned back against his chest. "Don’t worry, Brother. I’m not comfortable with my situation, but I will face everything steadfastly. You should go now and see my sister-in-law because we’ve been gone for a long time, and she must miss you."
"Alright."

After her brother left, Qian Qin clutched her chest and thought about something. Although Zhang Fei had altered her memories, her body remembered his touch and their intimate actions, which confused her. "Did something happen when I disappeared that time?"
"What are you thinking about?"

Sha Mo looked at his wife, Sha Yuan, who had just arrived. "Qian Yan just contacted me, and he told me about the chaos at the tower. Empress Huo and the others’ arrival there disrupted all our plans, and our men were unable to reach our target."
"What about our two children? Have they made their way back to our domain?" Sha Yuan worriedly asked.
"They were on their way back two weeks ago, and they will arrive here in two to three weeks." Sha Yuan was relieved to hear that. "Qian Yan told me about a male human named Zhang Fei."
"Hmm? What’s so special about him? Why does Qian Yan care about him?"

"Do you remember our son’s story about the mysterious person behind the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple and the news about Empress Huo?" Sha Yuan nodded to Sha Mo. "Judging from Zhang Fei’s closeness to Empress Huo and the three dragons, I think that he is the one behind the changes in the sect."
"Oh? Are you sure about that?"
"That’s just my guess."
Sha Yuan sat on his lap. "Since our plans at the Tower of Eternity failed due to the appearance of Empress Huo and the three dragons, how about we start with your plans against the Asura Demon Race?"

"Hmm?" Sha Mo thought for a moment. "Even if I use Shang Zhanluo now, we still haven’t found the location of the Slaughter Blood Domain, the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and the Radiance Domain, so I think there’s no point in doing so. By the way, I’m going to the Torture Demon Domain to meet Ku Shenzu, so you have to protect our domain."
"Leave everything to me." After Sha Mo left, Sha Yuan contacted their two children to check on them. "Sigh! Thank goodness my two children are fine."

chapters.title: Chapter 1619: Metal Elemental Seed
paragraphs: [Master, that mysterious man seems to have met Zhang Fei.]

Feng Yao nodded slightly as she looked towards the third floor. Since her avatar and consciousness were within Zhang Fei’s body, she naturally knew about their previous encounter. "Who exactly is the representative of the demihuman race? Long Xiaolian is their princess, and I think no other demihuman is better than her, but she doesn’t seem to have the qualifications to accompany him."
[Could that demihuman woman be in the Ancient Realm, Master? As I recall, there were still thousands of demihumans there, so I thought that woman was in their group.]
"Your guess is probably correct." Feng Yao thought about the demihuman race in the Ancient Realm. "Looks like we have to go to that realm early, Ling’er."

[Do you want to find that woman for Zhang Fei? If the people from the Divine Samsara Sect and those demons knew about your departure, they would probably immediately focus their attention on him, especially Qian Yan. Anyways, do you intend to tell him about your true identity? Since that mysterious man had already spoken with Zhang Fei before, I’m sure he has realized the truth, Master.]

"He may be naive at times, but he’s not a fool, and he should have already realized my true identity." Feng Yao sighed because the mysterious man had already ruined her plans by telling Zhang Fei about her true identity. "I’ll talk to him after he comes back from this tower."
[Are you going to hand over the key and the metal elemental seed to him?]
Feng Yao sighed again. "I don’t have any other choice, right? Even if I don’t hand those two over to him, he will definitely find them with the help given by that young girl."
[What will happen next, Master? Zhang Fei shouldn’t have known your true identity this early on, but he already knows everything.]

"Whatever happens, it will all depend on his decisions and plans. I just hope he doesn’t think about going to the Ancient Realm too early, and he should settle all his matters in this realm first, especially regarding those demon gods." Feng Yao fell into a pensive state, thinking about the Lotus Limbo World. "He might be able to get in and out of that place with Luo Yunxiao’s help, so I think he should go there and meet that woman first."
[Do you really think he can get out of that place, Master?]

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded confidently. "Zhang Fei is different from Hu Tianlang, and he has a wealth of experience with women. He should be able to subdue her, and he’ll be able to enter and exit that place as he pleases if he can do that."
[I hope you’re right, Master. If he dies at the hands of that woman, all your efforts will be in vain, and this universe will be destroyed by the appearance of that core creature.]
"Yeah."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was facing off against a giant beast—a mix of several other beasts. Unlike all the challenges on the second floor, he used his body to face the beast, allowing him to use all his abilities.
With his soul link, Zhang Fei had no trouble dealing with the beast, and he could kill it in a matter of minutes. A silver item drops from the top of the room after the beast dies.
[Master, that is the peak-grade metal elemental seed.]

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow and caught the metal elemental seed directly. He was happy to be able to get his target in one try, but he also didn’t expect to get it so quickly. "It seems she did it on purpose."
[Who?]
"Who else but Feng Yao, Mei? She is the embodiment of this universe core, remember?"

[I still find it difficult to believe that Feng Yao is the embodiment of the core of this universe, Master. No wonder she knows so much, and she can also do whatever she pleases. The first time we met her in the Sky Jade Realm, she was no different from other mythical beasts, except for her Immortal Reincarnation Physique. After we left that realm, we began to learn many things about her that no one else, including her parents, knew. Doesn’t that mean you will fuck this universe if you fuck her?]
Zhang Fei stumbled after hearing that. "Mei, why are you becoming more and more lewd? I never stopped hoping that you would have a real body, and I will fuck you until I am satisfied."
[Humph! Keep dreaming! Even if I have a real body, I will never show it to you, or you will fuck me to death!]
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed before being sent out of the place.
When he returned to the third floor, Zhang Fei saw that Luo Yunxiao was already there. He also saw that Dugu Yuanshen, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi had awakened.
"What exactly happened to the three of us? Why did we suddenly lose consciousness?" Dugu Yuanshen asked.
"Someone or something deliberately put us to sleep." Lu Wangyi looked at Zhang Fei. "Do you know anything about it?"
Zhang Fei nodded. "Someone came here to see me, but he didn’t want you three to know of his presence, so he deliberately put you guys to sleep."

"If that person can make cultivators at our level fall asleep so easily, he must be a strong cultivator and stronger than Emperor Long," Dugu Yuanshen and Lu Wangyi agreed with Ju Jushen. "Can you tell us about his purpose in coming to see you?"

"He just told me about those shadowy creatures." The three of them became serious after Zhang Fei said that. "To get rid of them, I have to find and get rid of the core creature, but he doesn’t know about its whereabouts because it’s well hidden. Besides, I have to evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and I also need the help of six people to stop him. Four of them are already by my side, including Luo Yunxiao."
"Four?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race. This way, I only need to find representatives from the demihuman race and the demon race, and they will be my strength to defeat the core creature."
"Why are demons included among those people?"
"Who are the representatives of the demihuman race and the demon race?"

"I don’t know their identities yet," Zhang Fei said, transformed into his lust demon form. "Even though so many people of all races hate demons, not all of them are evil, okay? As you three can see, I myself am a demon, but I never thought of suppressing others, and I only protect those closest to me. Some demon races do have great ambitions to dominate this universe, but some of them are like me, such as the Soul-Devouring Demon God, Nalan Shizhe, the Eternal Night Demon God, Ye Mingran, the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu, and the Faceless Demon God, Wu Mian."
"Are you related to those four demon gods, young man?" Dugu Yuanshen asked.

"Nalan Shizhe is my mother-in-law, and her two daughters are my wives. As for Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran, they are my wives." Dugu Yuanshen, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi instantly fell dumbstruck, with their mouths wide open. "The reactions of the three of you are funny, you know?"

"Young man, everyone who hears of your relationship with the three female demon gods will surely be as shocked as we are," Dugu Yuanshen said with a shake of his head. "The three of them are demon gods, and people should look up to them because they are so powerful. Even with my cultivation now, I’m not confident I can defeat them unless I use my secret technique."
Lun Wangyi nodded in agreement. "I’m not surprised by your relationship with demons, but your relationship with the three female demon gods shocked me."
"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed. "I’m sure no cultivator in this Paradise Realm would dare oppose you if they knew about your relationship with the three female demon gods."

Zhang Fei returned to his human form. "You may be right about that, Senior. However, I have no ambition to suppress other cultivators, and I only want to protect those around me. Whoever comes to harm them, I will eliminate them and all their descendants, so they won’t keep coming and giving me trouble."

Dugu Yuanshen inwardly sighed. "I’m glad you think that way, young man. Even if we become too powerful, we should not use our power to oppress others; however, we have the right to kill those who attack the people closest to us."

"Senior, I will never kill anyone for no apparent reason, but I will kill them if they dare to touch those closest to me, regardless of whether they are humans, beasts, winged races, or others." Zhang Fei then sat cross-legged and took out the peak-grade metal elemental seed, which shocked the three people.
"Metal elemental seed!"
"Did you get it from the challenge just now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded. "I don’t know if I’ll be able to obtain the metal element, but I’ll use it now."
Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi moved in front of and behind Zhang Fei. "We’ll protect you if those cultivators manage to ascend to this floor."
"Thank you."
[Ding]
[A peak-grade metal elemental seed was detected.]
[The process of absorbing the metal elemental seed begins.]
[The chance for the host to get the metal element is 100%.]

"He may be naive at times, but he’s not a fool, and he should have already realized my true identity." Feng Yao sighed because the mysterious man had already ruined her plans by telling Zhang Fei about her true identity.
"I’ll talk to him after he comes back from this tower."
[Are you going to hand over the key and the metal elemental seed to him?]
Feng Yao sighed again.
"I don’t have any other choice, right?
Even if I don’t hand those two over to him, he will definitely find them with the help given by that young girl."
[What will happen next, Master?
Zhang Fei shouldn’t have known your true identity this early on, but he already knows everything.]
"Whatever happens, it will all depend on his decisions and plans.

I just hope he doesn’t think about going to the Ancient Realm too early, and he should settle all his matters in this realm first, especially regarding those demon gods." Feng Yao fell into a pensive state, thinking about the Lotus Limbo World.
"He might be able to get in and out of that place with Luo Yunxiao’s help, so I think he should go there and meet that woman first."
[Do you really think he can get out of that place, Master?]
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded confidently.
"Zhang Fei is different from Hu Tianlang, and he has a wealth of experience with women.
He should be able to subdue her, and he’ll be able to enter and exit that place as he pleases if he can do that."
[I hope you’re right, Master.
If he dies at the hands of that woman, all your efforts will be in vain, and this universe will be destroyed by the appearance of that core creature.]
"Yeah."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was facing off against a giant beast—a mix of several other beasts.
Unlike all the challenges on the second floor, he used his body to face the beast, allowing him to use all his abilities.
With his soul link, Zhang Fei had no trouble dealing with the beast, and he could kill it in a matter of minutes.
A silver item drops from the top of the room after the beast dies.
[Master, that is the peak-grade metal elemental seed.]
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow and caught the metal elemental seed directly.
He was happy to be able to get his target in one try, but he also didn’t expect to get it so quickly.
"It seems she did it on purpose."
[Who?]
"Who else but Feng Yao, Mei?
She is the embodiment of this universe core, remember?"
[I still find it difficult to believe that Feng Yao is the embodiment of the core of this universe, Master.
No wonder she knows so much, and she can also do whatever she pleases.
The first time we met her in the Sky Jade Realm, she was no different from other mythical beasts, except for her Immortal Reincarnation Physique.
After we left that realm, we began to learn many things about her that no one else, including her parents, knew.
Doesn’t that mean you will fuck this universe if you fuck her?]
Zhang Fei stumbled after hearing that.
"Mei, why are you becoming more and more lewd?
I never stopped hoping that you would have a real body, and I will fuck you until I am satisfied."
[Humph!
Keep dreaming!
Even if I have a real body, I will never show it to you, or you will fuck me to death!]
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed before being sent out of the place.
When he returned to the third floor, Zhang Fei saw that Luo Yunxiao was already there.
He also saw that Dugu Yuanshen, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi had awakened.
"What exactly happened to the three of us?
Why did we suddenly lose consciousness?" Dugu Yuanshen asked.
"Someone or something deliberately put us to sleep." Lu Wangyi looked at Zhang Fei.
"Do you know anything about it?"
Zhang Fei nodded.
"Someone came here to see me, but he didn’t want you three to know of his presence, so he deliberately put you guys to sleep."
"If that person can make cultivators at our level fall asleep so easily, he must be a strong cultivator and stronger than Emperor Long," Dugu Yuanshen and Lu Wangyi agreed with Ju Jushen.
"Can you tell us about his purpose in coming to see you?"
"He just told me about those shadowy creatures." The three of them became serious after Zhang Fei said that.
"To get rid of them, I have to find and get rid of the core creature, but he doesn’t know about its whereabouts because it’s well hidden.
Besides, I have to evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and I also need the help of six people to stop him.
Four of them are already by my side, including Luo Yunxiao."
"Four?"
Zhang Fei nodded.

"Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race.
This way, I only need to find representatives from the demihuman race and the demon race, and they will be my strength to defeat the core creature."
"Why are demons included among those people?"
"Who are the representatives of the demihuman race and the demon race?"
"I don’t know their identities yet," Zhang Fei said, transformed into his lust demon form.
"Even though so many people of all races hate demons, not all of them are evil, okay?
As you three can see, I myself am a demon, but I never thought of suppressing others, and I only protect those closest to me.

Some demon races do have great ambitions to dominate this universe, but some of them are like me, such as the Soul-Devouring Demon God, Nalan Shizhe, the Eternal Night Demon God, Ye Mingran, the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu, and the Faceless Demon God, Wu Mian."
"Are you related to those four demon gods, young man?" Dugu Yuanshen asked.
"Nalan Shizhe is my mother-in-law, and her two daughters are my wives.
As for Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran, they are my wives." Dugu Yuanshen, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi instantly fell dumbstruck, with their mouths wide open.
"The reactions of the three of you are funny, you know?"
"Young man, everyone who hears of your relationship with the three female demon gods will surely be as shocked as we are," Dugu Yuanshen said with a shake of his head.
"The three of them are demon gods, and people should look up to them because they are so powerful.
Even with my cultivation now, I’m not confident I can defeat them unless I use my secret technique."
Lun Wangyi nodded in agreement.
"I’m not surprised by your relationship with demons, but your relationship with the three female demon gods shocked me."
"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed.
"I’m sure no cultivator in this Paradise Realm would dare oppose you if they knew about your relationship with the three female demon gods."
Zhang Fei returned to his human form.
"You may be right about that, Senior.
However, I have no ambition to suppress other cultivators, and I only want to protect those around me.
Whoever comes to harm them, I will eliminate them and all their descendants, so they won’t keep coming and giving me trouble."
Dugu Yuanshen inwardly sighed.
"I’m glad you think that way, young man.
Even if we become too powerful, we should not use our power to oppress others; however, we have the right to kill those who attack the people closest to us."

"Senior, I will never kill anyone for no apparent reason, but I will kill them if they dare to touch those closest to me, regardless of whether they are humans, beasts, winged races, or others." Zhang Fei then sat cross-legged and took out the peak-grade metal elemental seed, which shocked the three people.
"Metal elemental seed!"
"Did you get it from the challenge just now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded.
"I don’t know if I’ll be able to obtain the metal element, but I’ll use it now."
Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi moved in front of and behind Zhang Fei.
"We’ll protect you if those cultivators manage to ascend to this floor."
"Thank you."
[Ding]
[A peak-grade metal elemental seed was detected.]
[The process of absorbing the metal elemental seed begins.]
[The chance for the host to get the metal element is 100%.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1620: Obtained Metal Element
paragraphs: After swallowing the metal elemental seed, Zhang Fei felt something emerge within him, enveloping his body in a faint, silver aura, unlike before.
Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi carefully observed Zhang Fei, but they also did not relax their watch at the entrance to the third floor.

Meanwhile, Dugu Yuanshen sat in front of the stone gate, watching Zhang Fei and stroking his beard. ’This kid’s luck is really good! No cultivator ever knew that this place held a peak-grade metal elemental seed, but he managed to obtain it in his first challenge. If he manages to complete all the challenges on this floor, he will probably return with many valuable items that will be useful to his sect.’

Dugu Yuanshen looked towards the entrance when he felt the aura of one of his disciples, and Dugu Liangsen walked onto the third floor after he completed the final challenge on the second floor. "Two seniors, he is my first disciple."
Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi simply nodded and let Dugu Liangsen pass, who immediately walked towards his master while looking at Zhang Fei.
"Who is that young man, Master? I didn’t see him before, but he’s already on this third floor," Dugu Liangsen asked as soon as he arrived beside his master.

"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is one of the leaders of the Moonlit Passion Temple. You took too long to complete your last challenge, so you didn’t know about his arrival in this tower, and he managed to climb to this third floor much faster than you." Dugu Liangsen smiled bitterly upon hearing that, but he was surprised to hear that someone from the sect had managed to reach the third floor, which was unprecedented. "The woman beside him is his wife, Luo Yunxiao. She is the daughter of Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."
Dugu Liangsen only glanced at Luo Yunxiao. "Then, who are those two, Master? Why do you address them as seniors?"

"They are much more senior than me, and they are in the same generation as Emperor Long and the others, Liangsen." Dugu Liangsen looked at his master. "The man is the leader of the giant race, Ju Jushen. The woman is the leader of the druid race, Lu Wangyi."
"Oh." Dugu Liangsen nodded slightly before returning his gaze to Zhang Fei. "What is he doing, Master? Why do the two seniors seem to be protecting him?"

"He just got a valuable item from his first challenge, and he’s absorbing it now." Dugu Liangsen knew that there were many valuable items on the third floor, but he didn’t expect Zhang Fei to get one on his first challenge, making him a little envious. "You shouldn’t bother him, Liangsen. Although his cultivation is far below yours, I can tell you that he’s truly powerful, and he can defeat you even if you use our secret technique."
Dugu Liangsen looked at his master again and raised his eyebrows slightly. "Is he really that strong, Master?"

"Yes." Dugu Yuanshen nodded. "Otherwise, he and his wife wouldn’t be able to go to the third floor much faster than you, right? Besides, you can see for yourself that those two powerful seniors are willing to protect him voluntarily, so you can’t underestimate him."
"I understand, Master."
"What about Dugu Xuanye and Ru Feiyan? Have they completed their previous challenges?"

"Dugu Xuanye has already begun the final challenge, and Ru Feiyan is facing the ninth challenge. Besides them, I saw four women, including Sect Master Yue Xuelian, and they have just begun their final challenge. Anyways, why are Emperor Long and those renowned cultivators on the second floor?"

Dugu Yuanshen sighed and explained everything to his first disciple, especially about the presence of demons from the three previous races in the tower. "Emperor Long and the others came here specifically to fight them, and they are also protecting the other cultivators. If not for them, the demons would have wreaked havoc on the second floor."
"Then, who is the woman guarding the entrance to the second floor?"
"That woman is the most dangerous cultivator in this Paradise Realm, and no one dares to oppose her, including Emperor Long and the four perils."
"Who is she?"
"Empress Huo Yanling."

Upon hearing that, Dugu Liangsen’s jaw dropped. He naturally knew about Empress Huo Yanling, and he greatly admired her after hearing about her exploits in the past. However, he had never met her before because she decided to abandon everything and reincarnate, something no cultivator would ever do. Moreover, he had heard of the actions of the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and they slaughtered all cultivators who had ever tried to invade their domain, which was done on the orders of their empress.
Dugu Yuanshen pointed at Zhang Fei. "That young man is Empress Huo’s future husband, so—"
"Eh? Is he really Empress Huo’s future husband, Master?"

"Yes." Dugu Yuanshen nodded. "Everyone in the Paradise Realm has heard that Empress Huo has a husband-to-be, and the news came from her. Besides, she’s decided to protect the Moonlit Passion Temple, which she never did in the past."
Dugu Liangsen nodded in understanding, but he and Dugu Yuanshen were suddenly sent to their first challenge.
"How long will it take him to complete this?"

Lu Wangyi shook her head at Ju Jushen. "I’ve never used an elemental seed before, so I can’t say for sure how long the process will take. However, I once heard from someone who also obtained a metal elemental seed in the past that the process ended in three days, but that person ultimately failed to obtain the element."
"I don’t think it will be that long." They turned to Luo Yunxiao. "My husband has already used several elemental seeds, and he completed all the processes to absorb them in just one day."
"What elemental seeds has he absorbed in the past?"
"Wind, ice, water, lightning, and wood."
"Did he get those elements?"

"My husband got all five elements." Luo Yunxiao’s answer shocked Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen. "He managed to obtain them with the help of five people; otherwise, he probably would never have obtained them."
"Who were the people who helped him at that time?"
"A wind fairy, an ice phoenix, a water beast, and a lightning spirit helped him obtain all four elements. As for the wood element, you should have heard of Jia Yuyan, right?"
"Do you mean the granddaughter of Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun?" Lu Wangyi asked.
"That’s right." Luo Yunxiao nodded. "My husband met Jia Yuyan in the upper realm, and they have been husband and wife ever since."
Lu Wangyi nodded in understanding. "I’ve heard that Zhang Fei defeated Jia Zizhen a few years ago, but I initially didn’t understand why he interfered in the Fairy Race’s affairs."

"Haha," Luo Yunxiao laughed softly. "Jia Zizhen wanted Jia Yuyan to be his wife, but my husband already took her. Since he held her grandparents hostage and threatened them, our husband decided to take action against the former fairy king."

"Jia Zizhen is truly a bastard!" Ju Jushen cursed. "He trapped the former fairy king, causing him to die at the hands of demons. After he ascended the throne, he eliminated his rivals, including Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu. In the end, he got his karma, and he is completely useless now."

"Actually, Beiming Youhuang is my master, and I’ve known her story since I was little." Both Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen were surprised by that. "However, everything is in the past now, and my master decided not to return to the Fairy Race."

Lu Wangyi nodded slightly. "That incident happened before you were born, and Beiming Youhuang has already left her race since then, so I’m not surprised she’s unwilling to return there. As for Jia Xianzu, he chose to abandon his true identity and guard the Star Tower as Wan Jiang, but I heard that he abandoned his position and disappeared from the public eye."

"Senior Jia Xianzu never disappeared, Senior." Lu Wangyi raised an eyebrow. "Since several years ago, he and my master were helping my husband with something, so the two of them never appeared in public, and they will certainly reappear once they complete their task."
Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen were curious about it, but they chose not to ask anything too private about Zhang Fei.
"Anyways, have you two completed all the challenges on this third floor?"
"Yes." Ju Jushen nodded at her. "We’ve lived on this third floor for several years, waiting for your husband to come here."
"Where did you two get the information that my husband would be coming to this tower?"

Lu Wangyi shook her head. "Honestly, we don’t know the source, but a mysterious message told us that he would be coming to this tower, and the sender asked us to wait here. Since we had heard about him, we decided to follow the message and wait for him to come here."
Luo Yunxiao furrowed her brows and thought about it, and she immediately guessed that it was Feng Yao or Hu Tianlang’s wrath soul who told them about it.
*Swoosh*
A silver aura suddenly erupted from Zhang Fei’s body, startling them.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the metal element.]
[The host’s metal element has reached the lower stage.]
"So fast!" Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen exclaimed. "He actually managed to obtain the metal element!"

"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Since my husband managed to obtain the other five elements using their elemental seeds, I was certain that he would obtain the metal element, which would be useful for his profession as a blacksmith."

chapters.title: Chapter 1621: Metal Element Core
paragraphs: Even though he had obtained the metal element, Zhang Fei didn’t stop there. He still had the final task, and he tried to form his new cultivation core based on his metal element. With his previous experience forming eight cores, he found it much easier to create the new one, needing less than an hour to do so.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei lacked the methods of the metal elemental law, making his metal element the weakest of the nine elements.
[Ding]
[The host successfully formed the peak-grade metal element core.]

Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen looked at the silver cultivation core floating above Zhang Fei’s head in a daze. Forming a cultivation core was the most difficult thing, but he managed to form it in less than an hour. "How many elements does he have in total?"
"Nine."

They took a deep breath. Most cultivators only had one cultivation core, and some had two, but their number was far too small. They had also heard of a handful of cultivators with three cores, but their number was even smaller.

For the first time in their lives, they an unbelievable miracle, and the cultivator sitting in front of them had nine cores in his body. Furthermore, Zhang Fei was the only living being to possess three distinct identities in one body: a human, a celestial fox, and a lust demon.

However, they didn’t know that Zhang Fei had a fourth identity, which was the Calamity Demon Dragon. His dragon identity is much more special than his other three identities because there is only one Calamity Demon Dragon in each era, and only the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon can match it.
After the metal element core entered his body, Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and breathed a sigh of relief.
"You’re crazy!" Ju Jushen shouted.

Lu Wangyi nodded slightly. "I’m sure there’s no other cultivator like you in this universe. You possess three identities, nine elements, and nine cultivation cores. If other cultivators want to defeat you, they’ll have to destroy your nine cores first, which is simply impossible."

"Even though I have some advantages that other cultivators don’t have, I still won’t act arrogantly and carelessly." Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen agreed with Zhang Fei. "One person may not be able to destroy my nine cores, but the situation will be different if hundreds or thousands of people gang up on me at once. That’s why I choose to remain low-key in front of the public eye, and I hope that you two will not tell other people about this matter; otherwise, problem after problem will come to me, which will only waste my time."
Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen exchanged glances before replying. "We swear we won’t tell any other cultivators about your nine cultivation cores or anything else."

Zhang Fei himself had no problem with the situation, as he had already examined Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen with his demon eyes and couldn’t find anything negative in their souls. He looked for Dugu Yuanshen, but Luo Yunxiao told him that the old man and his first disciple were undergoing the first challenge.

Zhang Fei stood up and spoke to the other two. "Since we still have to wait for the second challenge to appear, I want to spar with you two again. Unlike before, I want you two to use your full strength, and you must attack me seriously as if you want to kill me."
"Eh?"
"But—" Lu Wangyi stopped talking, and her eyes widened as she felt Zhang Fei’s strength increase to the level of hers. "This? How is this possible?"
"Did you use a secret strengthening technique?" Ju Jushen curiously asked.

"Something like that." Zhang Fei nodded. "You two don’t have to worry about me because my strengthening technique is different from others, and I won’t experience any backlash even if I use it all day long."

Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen exhaled softly before activating their full power, and both of them immediately attacked Zhang Fei. However, their attacks only struck Zhang Fei’s afterimages, which left them both shocked.
"Haha," Luo Yunxiao softly laughed as she walked away. "Two seniors, you have to fight seriously, or my husband will defeat both of you."

Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen had no doubts about this, as Zhang Fei was the heir of the ten-tailed fox, so he should possess special abilities that they and other cultivators didn’t possess. They were curious about his power-enhancing technique, but they quickly dismissed it and moved to attack him again.
Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao sat on the sidelines and watched their fight. Since she was already accustomed to level eight gravity, it wasn’t difficult for her to see their movements.

Luo Yunxiao thought about her conversation with Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen earlier regarding the mysterious person who told them that her husband would challenge the Tower of Eternity. Moreover, that person told them several years ago, but her husband only learned about the tower a little over a month ago.

Luo Yunxiao recalled the conversation he and Zhang Fei had with the mysterious man before, and she was sure that Feng Yao did all that. "What does she want from him? Why did she do all that for him? Just like Helian Xun’er and the others, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling had been training in Zhang Fei’s training room for decades, so the challenges on the second floor weren’t too much of a hassle for them.

The majority of the disciples and elders of the sect had disappeared because they were unable to face those challenges, and they immediately left the Glazed Heaven Domain according to Liang Huizhong’s orders.

Liang Huizhong and the elders who arrived at the tower later had already reached the second floor and began their challenge. They were extremely cautious due to Feng Yao’s presence, and they were also wary of the mysterious people who had previously attempted to pit them against the demons.

The second group from the War God Pavilion had also arrived on the second floor, and they were a little surprised to find so many people already arriving for the final challenge. They ignored the people in front of them and began their first challenge.

Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng were also on the second floor, and they had already reached the fifth challenge, though they had struggled to get there. Only a few disciples from the Divine Samsara Sect could match them, such as Wang Tieshan, Hua Liuying, and a few others.

"Did you encounter any problems on the third floor?" Feng Tian also asked him.

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head. "I didn’t encounter any problems on the third floor, and I was just thinking about the best way to go to the Ancient Realm. Those shadowy creatures have invaded many places there, including the tower in the Zhanlu Domain, and they are truly powerful."
"Are you thinking about going to the Ancient Realm anytime soon? Are you ready for that?"

Zhang Fei [1] sighed. "I have no choice but to go to the Ancient Realm because the old fox’s last two souls are in two domains in that realm, and my soul must merge with them first before I can meet his wrath soul."
"I see." Feng Jiu nodded in understanding. "I know those two souls are important to you, but you have to think things through carefully first, okay?"
"Don’t worry, I won’t make any rash decisions."

With his previous experience forming eight cores, he found it much easier to create the new one, needing less than an hour to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 1622: The Gate Key
paragraphs: The sounds of battle startled Dugu Yuanshen and Dugu Liangsen, who had just returned from their two challenges. They looked at Zhang Fei, who was fighting in the air with Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi.
Dugu Yuanshen was not surprised to see Zhang Fei able to keep up with the two leaders of the giant and druid races, even though he had to use a strengthening technique to fight them.

On the other hand, Dugu Liangsen was shocked to see Zhang Fei able to fight against Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi. He knew about a strengthening technique, but he had never heard of a speed technique that could increase a person’s speed that much.

Dugu Yuanshen nodded his head several times. "Did you see that, Liangsen? Zhang Fei did use a strengthening technique to increase his strength, but his speed is his original speed, and I feel that he can still move faster than that."
"Did he use a special technique to increase his speed, Master?"

"I don’t know how he trained his speed to such a level, but I can clearly see that he didn’t use any technique like that. In this Paradise Realm, I have met many speed cultivators, including the speed demon, Su Shentian. However, I have never met a cultivator who can move as fast as Zhang Fei, and he obviously hasn’t used all his speed." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Luo Yunxiao, who was thinking to herself at the side. "You can ask that young lady to spar with you, but you have to suppress your strength according to her cultivation level."

Dugu Liangsen looked at Luo Yunxiao, but he felt hesitant to spar with her. He didn’t underestimate her, but he wasn’t used to sparring with a woman. He often lost control of his strength during battle, and he was afraid of injuring her.
"Go on! I’ll stop you if you lose control."
"Yes, Master." Dugu Liangsen flew toward Luo Yunxiao. "Young miss, are you willing to spar with me?"

Luo Yunxiao snapped out of her thoughts, looked at Dugu Liangsen, and stood up. "I’m bored waiting for my next challenge, and I rarely spar with anyone other than my husband, so I’ll spar with you now."
"Don’t worry, I won’t use all my power, and I will suppress it down to your level. Besides, we won’t use our abilities, and we will spar normally."
"Alright." Luo Yunxiao instantly disappeared from Dugu Liangsen’s sight, leaving him in shock.

Dugu Liangsen tried to detect Luo Yunxiao’s movements, but his eyes couldn’t follow her. He tried to track her using his senses, but she suppressed her aura so deeply that it seemed as if she had vanished from the place. ’What the hell? Her speed is as fast as her husband’s, and she can suppress her aura so deeply that I can’t track her.’

"Don’t daydream in battle." Dugu Liangsen turned around to catch Luo Yunxiao, but she also moved at the same time as him and dodged behind him. She swiftly struck his back, causing him to stagger a few steps forward.

Dugu Liangsen immediately moved from his spot, but Luo Yunxiao suddenly appeared in front of him. He tried to block her punch with both hands, but she moved behind him and struck him back again. "Shit! I couldn’t see or sense her movements at all!"

Dugu Liangsen tried to use his maximum speed to evade Luo Yunxiao, but her speed simply surpassed his by far. After all, she had perfectly adapted to level eight gravity, which meant it was 256x heavier than normal.
In the Paradise Realm, no cultivator had such a place, so no other cultivators could match Luo Yunxiao’s speed, except for the people Zhang Fei allowed to train in his training space.

Witnessing that, Dugu Yuanshen rubbed his white beard as his eyes tried to track Luo Yunxiao’s movements, but he couldn’t do so either. ’How exactly did they train? How could their speed be so fast? I’m not surprised that Zhang Fei could do it because he has many advantages, but I didn’t expect his wife to be able to do it too.’
Just like Dugu Liangsen, Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi were also frustrated facing Zhang Fei. They fought him together, but they were never able to hit him with a single blow.
In contrast, Zhang Fei could easily launch attacks against them, and the force of his strikes caused them significant pain.
No matter how fast Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi attacked Zhang Fei, he was always one step faster than them, even though he still hadn’t used his maximum speed like Luo Yunxiao.
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow when he felt movement from the tower, and he was sent into the next challenge a second later, forcing Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi to stop chasing him.
Dugu Liangsen, who was sparring with Luo Yunxiao, was also surprised because she was suddenly sent to the next challenge, so he stopped and returned to his master’s side.
"Haha," Dugu Yuanshen laughed at his first disciple’s expression. "Can you see that young lady’s movements?"
Dugu Liangsen shook his head helplessly. "I’ve never seen a cultivator as fast as her before, Master. I’ve sparred with Su Shentian before, but that woman is much faster than him."

"Their speed is simply absurd." The two men looked at Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi. "Every time we increase our speed, Zhang Fei always becomes faster than us, which makes us think his speed has no limits."
Lu Wangyi sighed. "No wonder Zhang Fei can defeat Jia Zizhen! The former fairy king was one of the fastest cultivators in the Paradise Realm, but he managed to defeat him so easily."
"Eh? Did Zhang Fei really defeat the fairy king, Senior?" Dugu Liangsen and Dugu Yuanshen were both shocked to hear such news.

"Yes," Ju Jushen nodded to them. "Zhang Fei came to the Floral Mirage Domain about six years ago, and he defeated Jia Zizhen himself. If I remember correctly, his cultivation was still at the Three-Sun Celestial Lord realm at the time, and—"
"What?" Dugu Liangsen screamed. "How... how did he manage to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm in less than six years?"
"Zhang Fei is a dual cultivator, and he has many powerful female cultivators here."
Dugu Liangsen shook his head at Ju Jushen. "Senior, even if Zhang Fei had a thousand women by his side, he couldn’t have reached that stage in less than six years."

"Well, that’s true." Ju Jushen nodded. "I don’t care how he improved his strength, but I won’t ask him if he has no intention of telling me. After all, all cultivators have their secrets, including us, right?"
Dugu Yuanshen agreed with him and spoke to his first disciple. "Liangsen, don’t tell anyone about everything you saw today. Do you understand?"
"I understand, Master." Dugu Liangsen immediately sat down beside his master, but his thoughts were preoccupied with Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao, especially their speed.
"Hehe," Lu Wangyi chuckled. "Hey, Jushen! Since we’ve met Zhang Fei, I plan to return to our domain and talk to my druid race about him."
Ju Jushen nodded. "I also have to tell my wife and the members of my giant race about him, but I think we should wait for him to return from his challenge first."
"Let’s wait for him to come back." Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen went to the side and waited there for Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was in an empty space with heavy pressure, but it wasn’t a problem for him at all.
[Master, look in front of you.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked ahead, where a large key was floating.
[That must be the key to the gate, Master.]
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded and walked in that direction. "Feng Yao seemed to have sent me here on purpose to retrieve the key because she knew all the challenges on the third floor were useless to me."
[What are you going to do about Feng Yao, Master?]

Zhang Fei stopped in front of the key, but he didn’t immediately take it. "What can I do about her, Mei? In the past, I always believed that I could surpass Feng Yao someday, but it seems reality isn’t on my side, and I’m no longer confident that I can surpass her even if I evolve into a ten-tailed fox."
[Does that mean you’re going to give up on getting her, Master?]

"How can I get her if I can’t surpass her?" Zhang Fei replied in a desperate tone. "You know that my demon abilities are useless against her, and she still has the hot-tempered Huo Ling by her side. Perhaps Feng Yao is not destined to be mine, so I won’t think about her anymore. Even so, I still want to know her true reasons for manifesting herself, including her reasons for helping me all this time."
[Do you think Feng Yao is using you for her personal gain, Master?]

"Isn’t that obvious?" Zhang Fei sighed. "Feng Yao probably had her reasons for doing all that, but I’m truly disappointed that she used me for whatever it was. If she had told me everything from the start, I might not have been as disappointed as I am now, and I would have willingly helped her achieve her goals."
[Do you want to ask her about her reasons, Master?]
"Even if I asked her, I’m sure she wouldn’t be willing to tell me the truth, so I won’t waste my time on that."
After he took the key, Zhang Fei was sent out of the place and returned to the third floor.

Even so, I still want to know her true reasons for manifesting herself, including her reasons for helping me all this time."
[Do you think Feng Yao is using you for her personal gain, Master?]
"Isn’t that obvious?" Zhang Fei sighed.
"Feng Yao probably had her reasons for doing all that, but I’m truly disappointed that she used me for whatever it was.
If she had told me everything from the start, I might not have been as disappointed as I am now, and I would have willingly helped her achieve her goals."
[Do you want to ask her about her reasons, Master?]
"Even if I asked her, I’m sure she wouldn’t be willing to tell me the truth, so I won’t waste my time on that."
After he took the key, Zhang Fei was sent out of the place and returned to the third floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1623: Looking For A Way
paragraphs: "What happened?" Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen asked simultaneously as soon as Zhang Fei reappeared on the third floor.
"This." Zhang Fei showed them the key.
"Key?" Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen looked at the gate. "Don’t tell us that’s the key to opening the gate."
"This key is indeed for opening the gate."
Zhang Fei walked to the gate, but Dugu Yuanshen grabbed his shoulder. "Are you serious about opening this gate, young man?"

"I don’t know, Senior." Zhang Fei moved Dugu Yuanshen from his shoulder. "I have to look for two items in the Ancient Realm, so I have to go there, but I’m not sure about opening this gate. Those shadowy creatures had already invaded the Tower of Eternity in the Zhanlu Domain, and they would invade this tower as soon as I opened the gate."
Dugu Liangsen wore a confused look and asked. "What do you mean by those shadowy creatures, little brother? Where is Zhanlu Domain located? Why haven’t I heard of it before?"

"Wait." Zhang Fei created a qi screen and displayed the situation in the Ancient Desolate Domain. "The video you are currently watching is set in the Zhanlu Domain of the Ancient Realm, and those creatures are shadowy creatures. As you can see for yourself, they possess all the beasts and demons there."

Dugu Liangsen was horrified to see those shadowy creatures, and all the living beings in that domain could not prevent them from controlling them. Even Dugu Yuanshe, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi held their breath after seeing all this.
"Is that the Ancient Desolate Domain that young lady is referring to?" Dugu Yuanshen asked.
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "The location of the portal to the Ancient Desolate Domain used to be behind those gates, but no one knew about it before, and I learned about it from someone."
"Can those shadowy creatures go to this realm through that portal?"

"Fortunately, that domain has a powerful barrier, so those creatures cannot invade this Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei supported his chin in thought. "I don’t know the exact strength of the barrier, but those creatures will probably find a way to invade this realm someday. Fortunately, the gates have vanished, and a vast distance separates all domains. If those gates still exist, they can easily invade all the domains here, and they will also control the powerful cultivators here."
"Then—"

"Hmm? Have you managed to find the key, husband?" Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao, who had just returned from her previous challenge. "Are you thinking about opening the gate and going to the Zhanlu Domain?"

Zhang Fei sighed and shook his head. "Those shadowy creatures are too powerful for us, Yunxiao. Once I open this gate, they will charge in here, and none of the cultivators in this tower can stop them, including Long Wuzhao."

"I see." Luo Yunxiao looked at him. "What do you think if we delay it for now? I think our best option is to go that place and meet that woman first, and we’ll figure out a way to enter the Zhanlu Domain after we meet her."

"I can’t think about that right now." Zhang Fei stored the key into the system inventory because it was much safer than his storage ring. "Feng Yao forbade me from entering that place before my cultivation reached the Celestial God Realm, and my cultivation hasn’t completely stabilized after I broke through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, so I still need a long time to reach that stage."
"What kind of place are you two talking about?" Dugu Yuanshen and the others were curious about it.
Luo Yunxiao looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately changed the display on the qi screen to the Limbo Lotus World.
Dugu Yuanshen, Dugu Liangsen, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi were shocked upon seeing the place, as there was nothing there but pitch-black darkness.

"That’s the Limbo Lotus World, and the entrance is in the Floral Mirage Domain." Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi looked at Zhang Fei because they were natives of that domain, but they had never heard of it. "Do you two know about the Ancient Treant Tree?"
"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed. "We are both natural races, so we have heard of Su Yuangu."
"Even though Su Yuangu lives in the fairy race region, all natural races know about him." Then, Lu Wangyi asked him. "What does he have to do with the entrance to that dark and terrible place?"

"The entrance is located under Senior Yuangu’s body." Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi were shocked to hear that. "Actually, no member of the fairy race knew about it until six years ago. At that time, Jia Yuyan took me to see him, and he showed me the entrance, but I forbade them to tell anyone else."
"Hahaha."
Loud laughter broke their conversation, and they looked towards the entrance to the third floor, where Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, and Yue Ningxue came out of the gate.
"Hahaha! It’s been a long time since I saw you three," Ju Jushen said to them.
Lu Wangyi looked at Yue Ningxue. "Why is that woman with the three of you, Emperor Long?"

"Yue Ningxue came because of the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, and we started the challenge on the second floor at the same time. Since all of us have reached this floor in the past, we managed to complete the challenge on the second floor at the same time." Long Wuzhao looked at Zhang Fei. "Why is your expression so serious? Did something happen before?"
"Emperor Long, this young man has found the key to open the gate."
"Oh?" Long Wuzhao and the others were shocked to hear that. "Do you intend to open the gate?"

Zhang Fei removed the qi screen and told the four of them about the situation at the Tower of Eternity in the Zhanlu Domain, which shocked them. "I’ve never been to that domain, but I could sense the aura of those shadowy creatures when I touched the gate. They are far stronger than all the cultivators in this realm, including the four of you. If I open the gate now, they will attack us directly, and we won’t be able to stop them from possessing us. If they gain control over us, they will destroy this realm."
"What about that woman on the second floor, kid? Can she stop those shadowy creatures?" Long Xukong asked in an annoyed tone as he remembered Feng Yao.

"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed because he knew about the problem between Feng Yao and Long Xukong before. "She is powerful, but I don’t know whether she can stop those shadowy creatures or not, so I don’t want to take the risk of opening the gate."
Long Wuzhao nodded in agreement. "Since you can sense that the power of those shadowy creatures surpasses ours, we must think things through carefully before opening the gate."

"Yeah," Zhang Fei agreed with him. "I think I’ll complete all the challenges on the third floor first while waiting for the others to arrive. We’ll discuss it with them before I decide whether to open the gate or not."

"Why don’t you go to the Ancient Realm through the Ancient Desolate Domain? Can’t you easily get to the portal with your abilities?" Tianshi Bailong asked him. "You can enter the portal, but those shadowy creatures can’t get out of it, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded to him. "You’re not wrong about that, father-in-law. However, those shadowy creatures have already taken control of the Ancient Desolate Domain, and they’re far stronger than me. If I force my way in, I’ll be courting death."
Tianshi Bailong’s lips twitched hearing Zhang Fei address him as his father-in-law, even though his daughter was not yet married to him.

Dugu Liangsen’s jaw dropped as he looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief. Almost everyone in the Paradis Realm knew about the Celestial Dragon Race’s Tianshi Shengjie, but no one knew that she had chosen him as her husband. ’This kid! How does he know all those renowned cultivators? Emperor Long is casual with him, and Senior Tianshi is his father-in-law.’
"Is there no other way to go to the Ancient Realm other than through those two domains?" Yue Ningxue suddenly asked.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei and the others thought about it.

Long Wuzhao remembered something. "If I’m not mistaken, the Forbidden Land is part of the Ancient Realm, right? People from that realm always come down there to hold auctions, so I’m sure there’s a portal there that will connect us to that realm."

"Ahh! That’s right!" Luo Yunxiao clasped her hands. "What if we go to the Forbidden Land and ask the people there, husband? They can’t go to the Ancient Realm because of the disappearance of the Eternal Flame, but I believe they know the way to go there. Perhaps the domain connected to that place has not been invaded by those shadowy creatures, and we can go there safely if that’s true."
"You’re right." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "I’ll send one of my clones there and ask those people."
Yue Ningxue immediately asked, "How are you going to get to the Forbidden Land? The portal is already closed, and it won’t open for another thousand years."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed softly and opened the gate to the Forbidden Land. "Even though the portal is closed, I can create my own so I can enter and exit the place freely."
"Tch." Yue Ningxue clenched her teeth.
Zhang Fei simply smiled and opened a portal to the training space, and his third clone immediately walked out before disappearing into the gate. He immediately closed both of them. "Let’s wait then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1624: Meet Ancient Leiyu Tianlu
paragraphs: [Master, why don’t you try asking Feng Yao about other paths to the Ancient Realm? She is the embodiment of the core of this universe, so she should know many paths to that place.]
"Do you still not understand me, Mei?"
[Master, I know, but—]
"I won’t rely on her, and I will find my own way to the Ancient Realm."
Mei sighed to herself because she was so familiar with her master’s character, and Feng Yao’s lies dealt a blow to him.

"Anyways, I need you to scout out all the areas in this domain, Mei. Since people from the Ancient Realm can descend into this domain, I’m sure there’s a hidden portal that can take me there, so I need you to find it."
[I’ll do it now, Master.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to fly towards the main city, but he suddenly saw Ancient Leiyu Tianlu descend from the sky and fly hurriedly towards it.
"Did something happen there? Why is that ancient beast in such a hurry? Moreover, he came alone without his master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his Nine Cloud Steps to go to the main city.

When Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at the main city, Ancient Leiyu Tianlu had already landed there with his body covered in wounds. He saw that the people from the Xuanyuan Clan had already gathered there to check on the male beast.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s sudden arrival surprised Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people from the Xuanyuan Clan. He approached the male beast and gave him some pills. "Swallow these pills so your injuries can heal quickly, and you can tell me what happened at the Puyang Clan afterward."
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded and immediately swallowed the pills in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hands.
"I didn’t expect your cultivation to have reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, young man," Xuanyuan Zhuanxu said.

Xuanyuan Shun also spoke to him. "The last time we met was six and a half years ago, and your cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm, yet you managed to reach this stage in such a short time."
Six years may seem long to ordinary mortals or low-level cultivators, but it was truly a short time for cultivators at their level, and no one could break through as quickly as Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"I am a dual cultivator with hundreds of women by my side, and I used several other methods to increase my cultivation; otherwise, I wouldn’t have managed to reach this stage so quickly." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the male beast. "Did those shadowy creatures attack you and the Puyang Clan?"

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded at him. "Those creatures appeared out of nowhere, and their numbers were enormous. My master and the others tried to stop them, but they were too late because those creatures had already invaded almost every domain in the Ancient Realm, and they also controlled many living creatures there. But how do you know about them?"

"The void spirit told me about those shadowy creatures, and I’m looking for a way to go to the Ancient Realm to meet two important people there." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer surprised Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. "Since you’re already here, can you please take me to the Ancient Realm?"
"Wait a minute," Xuanyuan Hao interjected. "What do you mean by those shadowy creatures? Where did they come from? Why did they attack the Puyang Clan and the others?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled softly and created a qi screen, showing them the situation in the Ancient Desolate Domain. "You guys can see those creatures for yourself."
"Huh? Isn’t that the Ancient Desolate Domain? Have you ever been to that domain?" Xuanyuan Wuyue asked him.

"Not yet." Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to them about how he found out about the Ancient Desolate Domain and the situation there, causing all the ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan to frown with dark faces. "I’ve never fought those shadowy creatures, but I know they are powerful; otherwise, Ancient Leiyu Tianlu wouldn’t have been injured like this, especially given his strength and physique."
Xuanyuan Changyi and the others agreed with him.
"What is the situation in the Puyang Clan now? Have those creatures managed to break through their clan?"

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu shook his head before telling Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the situation in the clan. "The Puyang Clan has powerful protective barriers, and they also have powerful counterattack mechanisms, but all of them are nearly useless against those creatures. They possess and control other living creatures to attack the clan, and they move to other bodies if the previous ones die."
"Does that mean that many cultivators have died there?"

"Yes." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded. "Those creatures don’t possess human cultivators, but they do possess beasts and demon beasts. They chose powerful beasts and demon beasts as their vessels, and they slaughtered many human cultivators. My master sent me here to look for you because he heard that those creatures are after the two souls of the ten-tailed fox, but they still haven’t managed to find them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already heard about it from the Will of the Universe before, so he was not surprised to hear it again from the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. "Can you take me there?"

"I can take you there, but I won’t." Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned. "My master sent me here to protect you because he was afraid that those creatures would invade the Paradise Realm, and he believed that you were the key to defeating them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly. "As long as I haven’t evolved into the next ten-tailed fox, I will never be able to defeat them. The only way for me to evolve is to meet the two souls of the old fox and merge them with my soul, so I have no other choice but to go to the Ancient Realm to meet them."
"But—"

"I already have two ways to go to the Ancient Realm, but those creatures have already taken over both places. If I force my way there through either path, I’ll have to fight them, so I want to take another path."
"Two paths? What is the other path besides the Ancient Desolate Domain?"

"The tower of eternity." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people of the Xuanyuan Clan were shocked to see the black key in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand. "I can open the gate with this key, but the problem is that those creatures have already invaded the tower in the Zhanlu Domain. Even if I use my strengthening technique, they are still much stronger than me, and there are too many of them. Moreover, this body is only my clone, and I can cancel it at any time. If I encounter danger in that realm, I will immediately cancel it."

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu shook his head in refusal. "Even though this body of yours is just a clone, I still won’t take you to the Ancient Realm, as the situation there is too risky. My master warned me that if you fell into their control, it would be dire, and the universe would face destruction."
"Do you really not want to take me there?"
"No," Ancient Leiyu Tianlu firmly refused. "My master ordered me to protect you, so I won’t disobey his orders by taking you there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly. "Alright, I won’t force you to take me there, and I’ll find my own way."
"I won’t let you go there."
"Try to stop me if you can." Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from their sight, and he activated his invisibility ability so that Ancient Leiyu Tianlu couldn’t track his movements.
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was a little surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s speed, but he immediately flew to catch up to him, followed by the people from the Xuanyuan Clan.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked as he looked in their direction, and he accelerated his speed, leaving them far behind. "Have you found the portal, Mei?"
[Master, I found something several miles up in the sky, but I don’t know if it’s the portal or not because something is blocking my detection system.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map. "Show me the location."
[Done.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] flew high into the sky towards that location, with Ancient Leiyu Tianlu still trying to follow behind him. "He can detect me even though I’ve used my invisibility ability, huh?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly opened the portal to his training space, followed by Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5], who walked out of it.
Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5] flew in two different directions, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] continued flying into the sky to inspect the object Mei had discovered earlier.
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu became confused as soon as he sensed Zhang Fei’s three auras, but he flew towards Zhang Xiaolong [3] and ignored the other two clones.

Since Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was tailing Zhang Xiaolong [3], Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5] decided to intercept him. The two activated the soul link to borrow the power of the beasts in the beast space.
"Ugh! Why are you so stubborn? If you act like this, I will fight you seriously, and you will definitely be seriously injured!"
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head as he took out his sword. "You underestimate me too much, you know?"
"If you want to stop me, you’ll have to fight us." Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword. "Even though we’re old friends, I won’t hesitate to attack you."

The people from the Xuanyuan Clan appeared behind Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. "Young man, please think things through carefully and don’t act recklessly. The situation in the Ancient Realm is unstable, and those creatures are targeting you."
