"I am a dual cultivator with hundreds of women by my side, and I used several other methods to increase my cultivation; otherwise, I wouldn’t have managed to reach this stage so quickly." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the male beast.
"Did those shadowy creatures attack you and the Puyang Clan?"
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded at him.
"Those creatures appeared out of nowhere, and their numbers were enormous.

My master and the others tried to stop them, but they were too late because those creatures had already invaded almost every domain in the Ancient Realm, and they also controlled many living creatures there.
But how do you know about them?"

"The void spirit told me about those shadowy creatures, and I’m looking for a way to go to the Ancient Realm to meet two important people there." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer surprised Ancient Leiyu Tianlu.
"Since you’re already here, can you please take me to the Ancient Realm?"
"Wait a minute," Xuanyuan Hao interjected.
"What do you mean by those shadowy creatures?
Where did they come from?
Why did they attack the Puyang Clan and the others?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled softly and created a qi screen, showing them the situation in the Ancient Desolate Domain.
"You guys can see those creatures for yourself."
"Huh?
Isn’t that the Ancient Desolate Domain?
Have you ever been to that domain?" Xuanyuan Wuyue asked him.

"Not yet." Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to them about how he found out about the Ancient Desolate Domain and the situation there, causing all the ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan to frown with dark faces.
"I’ve never fought those shadowy creatures, but I know they are powerful; otherwise, Ancient Leiyu Tianlu wouldn’t have been injured like this, especially given his strength and physique."
Xuanyuan Changyi and the others agreed with him.
"What is the situation in the Puyang Clan now?
Have those creatures managed to break through their clan?"
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu shook his head before telling Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the situation in the clan.
"The Puyang Clan has powerful protective barriers, and they also have powerful counterattack mechanisms, but all of them are nearly useless against those creatures.
They possess and control other living creatures to attack the clan, and they move to other bodies if the previous ones die."
"Does that mean that many cultivators have died there?"
"Yes." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded.
"Those creatures don’t possess human cultivators, but they do possess beasts and demon beasts.
They chose powerful beasts and demon beasts as their vessels, and they slaughtered many human cultivators.
My master sent me here to look for you because he heard that those creatures are after the two souls of the ten-tailed fox, but they still haven’t managed to find them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already heard about it from the Will of the Universe before, so he was not surprised to hear it again from the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu.
"Can you take me there?"
"I can take you there, but I won’t." Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned.
"My master sent me here to protect you because he was afraid that those creatures would invade the Paradise Realm, and he believed that you were the key to defeating them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly.
"As long as I haven’t evolved into the next ten-tailed fox, I will never be able to defeat them.
The only way for me to evolve is to meet the two souls of the old fox and merge them with my soul, so I have no other choice but to go to the Ancient Realm to meet them."
"But—"
"I already have two ways to go to the Ancient Realm, but those creatures have already taken over both places.
If I force my way there through either path, I’ll have to fight them, so I want to take another path."
"Two paths?
What is the other path besides the Ancient Desolate Domain?"
"The tower of eternity." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people of the Xuanyuan Clan were shocked to see the black key in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand.
"I can open the gate with this key, but the problem is that those creatures have already invaded the tower in the Zhanlu Domain.
Even if I use my strengthening technique, they are still much stronger than me, and there are too many of them.
Moreover, this body is only my clone, and I can cancel it at any time.
If I encounter danger in that realm, I will immediately cancel it."
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu shook his head in refusal.
"Even though this body of yours is just a clone, I still won’t take you to the Ancient Realm, as the situation there is too risky.
My master warned me that if you fell into their control, it would be dire, and the universe would face destruction."
"Do you really not want to take me there?"
"No," Ancient Leiyu Tianlu firmly refused.
"My master ordered me to protect you, so I won’t disobey his orders by taking you there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly.
"Alright, I won’t force you to take me there, and I’ll find my own way."
"I won’t let you go there."
"Try to stop me if you can." Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from their sight, and he activated his invisibility ability so that Ancient Leiyu Tianlu couldn’t track his movements.
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was a little surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s speed, but he immediately flew to catch up to him, followed by the people from the Xuanyuan Clan.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked as he looked in their direction, and he accelerated his speed, leaving them far behind.
"Have you found the portal, Mei?"
[Master, I found something several miles up in the sky, but I don’t know if it’s the portal or not because something is blocking my detection system.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map.
"Show me the location."
[Done.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] flew high into the sky towards that location, with Ancient Leiyu Tianlu still trying to follow behind him.
"He can detect me even though I’ve used my invisibility ability, huh?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly opened the portal to his training space, followed by Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5], who walked out of it.
Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5] flew in two different directions, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] continued flying into the sky to inspect the object Mei had discovered earlier.
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu became confused as soon as he sensed Zhang Fei’s three auras, but he flew towards Zhang Xiaolong [3] and ignored the other two clones.
Since Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was tailing Zhang Xiaolong [3], Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5] decided to intercept him.
The two activated the soul link to borrow the power of the beasts in the beast space.
"Ugh!
Why are you so stubborn?
If you act like this, I will fight you seriously, and you will definitely be seriously injured!"
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head as he took out his sword.
"You underestimate me too much, you know?"
"If you want to stop me, you’ll have to fight us." Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword.
"Even though we’re old friends, I won’t hesitate to attack you."
The people from the Xuanyuan Clan appeared behind Ancient Leiyu Tianlu.
"Young man, please think things through carefully and don’t act recklessly.
The situation in the Ancient Realm is unstable, and those creatures are targeting you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1625: Feng Yao’s Story
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [4] transformed into his half-fox form.
Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his half calamity demon dragon form.
Zhang Fei [4]’s transformation didn’t shock Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people of the Xuanyuan Clan, but Zhang Fei [5]’s transformation greatly shocked them.
"What the hell? You... you are the Calamity Demon Dragon?" Ancient Leiyu Tianlu stuttered in shock.

The expressions of Xuanyuan Changyi and the others became serious after they recognized Zhang Fei [5]’s half calamity demon dragon form. They were natives of the Ancient Realm, and they had long heard of the Calamity Demon Dragon and the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, which were born from Yin and Yang.

Zhang Fei [5] pointed the demon extermination sword at them. "You are right, I am indeed the current Calamity Demon Dragon. My strength may not be as high as yours, but I will not give up easily, and I will not lose if I have to fight all of you."

"If both of us aren’t enough to fight you, we’ll summon another one." Zhang Fei [4] opened the portal to the training space, and Feltia [2] came out from inside already in his lust demon form, with his strength equal to the other two clones. "I’m determined to find a way to the Ancient Realm, so I’ll do whatever it takes, including fighting all of you."
Xuanyuan Changyi and the others frowned upon hearing that, but none of them moved to attack Zhang Fei’s three clones, waiting for Ancient Leiyu Tianlu’s decision.
*Swoosh*

They were shocked when crimson flames came out of Zhang Fei [4]’s body and transformed into Feng Yao. She didn’t pay any attention to them and stared at Zhang Fei’s three clones. "I know you’re angry after learning the truth, but you’ll die if you go to the Ancient Realm now."

"Are you afraid there won’t be anyone else to take advantage of?" Zhang Fei [4] coldly asked. "I trusted you, but you repaid my trust in you with deception, and you only thought of using me for your own personal ambitions. Should I call you Feng Yao, Huo Yanling, or Shen Yuanzhi? Or should I call you the embodiment of the core of this universe?"
Zhang Fei [4]’s questions shocked Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and people from the Xuanyuan Clan. ’What did he just say? Did he call this woman the embodiment of the core of this universe?’
Feng Yao sighed. "I don’t know what that mysterious man said to you, but I never thought of taking advantage of you. I—"
"Is that so?" Zhang Fei [4] squinted his eyes. "If you don’t want to take advantage of me, then what is your real goal in manifesting and reincarnating over and over again?"

Feng Yao waved her hands, and countless black chains appeared around her, shocking all of them. "Just like you, I have always dreamed of freedom and living a life without restraints, but these chains bind me to this universe. I have tried to break them too many times, but I have never succeeded. Every time I break them, they will reappear and bind me again, just like now."

Zhang Fei [4] and the others looked at those chains with serious expressions, but they could hardly believe Feng Yao’s words. She sighed and destroyed those chains, causing her to spurt quite a lot of blood from her mouth.

The chains disappeared, but they reappeared a moment later and bound Feng Yao’s entire body again, and the chains seemed to bind her even tighter than before. "See? I will never be able to be a free living being as long as these chains bind me, but I cannot break them with my strength. I reincarnated over and over again in search of the right person to free me from these chains, and I roamed the entire universe searching for that person for billions of years."
Zhang Fei [4] and the other clones looked at Feng Yao and those black chains with expressions full of seriousness, but they did not say anything to her.

"One day, Hu Tianlang came to see me and told me about his vision. One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to all races. At that time, the reincarnations of the ancestors of all races will join him and fight by his side." Zhang Fei [4] had already heard about it many times, so he was no longer surprised by it, but those words shocked the others. "Hu Tianlang told me that the person would appear in the Sky Jade Realm, so I went there and founded the Blazing Phoenix Sect to wait for his appearance. I found out your identity when Aqua met me in the central region, and she told me about you, so I’ve been following you ever since."
Zhang Fei [4] and the other clones stared at Feng Yao, but their expressions clearly showed that they did not believe her.

Feng Yao waved her hand again, causing Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people of the Xuanyuan Clan to be even more shocked because those black chains also appeared around them and bound them. Then, she waved her hand towards Zhang Fei [4] and the other clones, but no black chains appeared around them. "Normally, those chains would bind everyone to this universe, but they can no longer bind you, making you the freest living being in this universe."
"Why?"

"Shouldn’t you already know the answer?" Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow. "Did you forget that you died once? That young girl brought you back to life, and those chains could no longer bind you from then on. However, the story will be different if your soul has entered the circle of reincarnation, and those chains will bind you again in your next life."
"Let me ask you one thing."
"Please ask."

"Have you ever been serious about your feelings for me?" Feng Yao couldn’t answer Zhang Fei [4]’s question because she herself didn’t have an answer for her future. "Heh! Since you can’t answer my question, I assume you were never serious about me, and you only wanted to use me to free yourself from those chains."

"It’s not that I don’t want to answer your question, Zhang Fei. My future is still vague, and I don’t know what will happen to me if I manage to break free from these chains." Zhang Fei [4] frowned further. "As you already know, I am different from all of you because I am the embodiment of the core of this universe. However, I don’t know what will happen to me if these chains disappear, and many questions arise within me. Will I still exist then? Will I die if that happens? What will happen to this universe if I die? Will this universe be destroyed with my death?"
"What did Hu Tianlang tell you about your future?"

"I can’t see her future because she is the embodiment of the core of this universe." Zhang Fei [4] and the others looked at Hu Tianlang’s wrath soul that suddenly appeared at the side. "My decision to sacrifice myself had nothing to do with her intentions, and I sacrificed myself purely for the peace of this universe. I may be strong as a primordial being, but I’m not that strong either, and there are many things I can’t do, including eliminating the other primordials. When I had a vision of you, I made the decision to sacrifice myself, and I hope you can bring peace to all living beings in this universe."
"Why did you come here?"

Hu Tianlang sighed. "I didn’t come here to interfere in your affairs, but I wanted to prevent you from making a reckless move by going to the Ancient Realm in the current situation. One of my souls has already encountered those shadowy creatures, and I can tell you that they are extremely powerful. If you go there with your current strength, they will immediately attack you. You do have many advantages, but you won’t be able to do anything against them. You surely know the risks if they take over your body, right? You may not care about other living beings, but you don’t want to see those closest to you suffer because of you, right? Besides, the two avatars of the two primordial beasts are also there, and they will notice your presence there."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [4] nodded.

"See?" Hu Tianlang moved to his side and grabbed his shoulder. "For now, forget about those shadowy creatures and focus on your strength. Once your cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm, I’ll take you to the Ancient Realm, and I’ll help you meet my two souls there."
"Are you sure that those shadowy creatures won’t be able to reach both domains of your two souls?"
"Ask her." Hu Tianlang pointed at Feng Yao.

Zhang Fei [4] looked at Feng Yao. "The Will of the Universe has created barriers in both domains, but I’m not sure that they are enough to stop those shadowy creatures. That’s why I plan to go to the Ancient Realm soon, and Huo Ling will help me to get rid of them from both domains."
"When are you going there?"
"After your real body returns from the Tower of Eternity."
Zhang Fei [4] and the other two clones returned to their human forms. "I’ve already obtained the key to open the gate."
"I know."
"However, I won’t leave the tower now, and I’ll complete all the challenges on the third floor first."
"I don’t think that’s a problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 1626: The Portal
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood a little distance away from the portal connecting the Forbidden Land and one of the domains in the Ancient Realm. An invisible barrier blocked his path, preventing him from reaching the portal.
Hu Tianlang’s wrath soul and Feng Yao immediately appeared beside him.
"You won’t be able to get past that barrier."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Feng Yao.
"This barrier was created to prevent people from the Forbidden Land from going to the Ancient Realm, and—"
"You can change or remove this barrier, right?"
"I can do that, but I won’t."
"Bring me there."
Hu Tianlang and Feng Yao frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3] because they had warned him not to go to the Ancient Realm with the current situation, but he still insisted on going there.
"I won’t go to explore that realm, and you can bring me back here directly."
"Hey, kid! Why are you so adamant about going there? You already know that the situation there is dire, but you insist on going there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] glanced at Hu Tianlang. "I just want to confirm something, and we’ll be right back here."
"What do you want to confirm?"
"I can’t tell you about that, but Feng Yao already knows what I want to confirm."

Hu Tianlang looked at Feng Yao, but she didn’t want to tell him the truth. "Unfortunately, I can’t take you there with this body, but I can do it with my real body. If you want to go there, you should settle all your matters in the Tower of Eternity first, and I’ll take you there after that."

"You said it yourself." Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment. "From now on, I don’t want you to live in my body anymore. I’m grateful for everything you’ve done for me, but I don’t want you to observe my activities anymore."
"Alright." Feng Yao immediately disappeared.

"Aren’t you being too harsh with her, kid?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Hu Tianlang. "I know she’s lied to you about many things, but you know that she’s never harmed you; instead, she’s always protected you and helped you in many ways, including when you faced those powerful cultivators like Yuan Xiajie and the others. If it weren’t for her protection, you would have been in big trouble long ago."

"I know," Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed. "She has helped me a lot and protected me all this time, but I was disappointed by her lies. She should have told me the truth from the start, but she didn’t say anything, and I found out everything from someone else."

"What could you have done for her if she had told you everything from the start? You couldn’t even defeat Yuan Xiajie, and you were scared to death of her. She did lie to you a lot, but you have to remember that you would never have gotten this far if it weren’t for her help." Hu Tianlang grabbed his shoulder. "I know you’re angry with her because of your pride, but you should learn to understand her. She’s lived for so long because she’s the embodiment of the core of this universe, and she has no ill intentions toward you. All she wants is freedom, and you are the only person who can help her achieve it, so I hope you can understand her better."
After saying that, Hu Tianlang also disappeared from the place, leaving Zhang Xiaolong [3] to think things over by himself.
"Zhang Fei."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Ancient Leiyu Tianlu and the people of the Xuanyuan Clan.
"Who exactly is that woman? What do you mean by calling her the embodiment of the core of this universe? What exactly are the black chains that bind us?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed. "This universe has its core, and it manifested itself as Shen Yuanzhi in the past, who was a primordial being like the ten-tailed fox. I never knew her purpose until yesterday, and she reincarnated again and again to free herself from those black chains that bound her to this universe. I don’t have clear information about those chains, and I only know that they have existed since the birth of this universe, which binds all living beings within it."
"Why don’t those chains bind you?"

"As Feng Yao said before, I died some time in the past. That young girl accidentally killed me, and she revived me, which allowed me to come this far. I don’t understand why those chains didn’t bind me, but it might have something to do with my death at that time."
"Who is the young girl you are referring to?"

"I myself have never spoken directly to that young girl, so I don’t know her identity." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. "What are you going to do now? I won’t stay here, and I have to return to the outside world."

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu could only shake his head. "My master asked me to protect you from those shadowy creatures, but I can’t leave this place because of the barrier that separates this domain from the outside world, so I don’t know what to do now."
[Try sending him to your beast space, Master.]
’Alright,’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed. "I don’t know if this will work, but I will send you into my beast now, and I will leave here after that."
"Okay."

After he sent Ancient Leiyu Tianlu into his beast space, Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to the people of the Xuanyuan Clan. "I know you guys still have many questions, but I don’t have the answers to all of them myself. Only Feng Yao and Hu Tianlang have the answers, but I’m sure they won’t tell you anything. I still have a lot of things to do, so I have to go now, and I will come back here in the future."
The people from the Xuanyuan Clan did not stop Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the three clones from leaving, but today’s events left many questions in their minds regarding Feng Yao and those black chains.
"What should we do?"
"We can’t do anything, right?"
"That kid, that woman, and Hu Tianlang are beyond our capabilities. We won’t be able to do anything to help them, especially with our limited strength."

"Let’s go back now."
"Yes."
"What happened, husband?"

"Can you bring him out here?"

"Husband, I know Big Sis Yao lied to you a lot, but she also helped you a lot when you both lived in the Three Mortal Realms, and I think your attitude towards her is too harsh."
"But—"

chapters.title: Chapter 1627: Conflicated
paragraphs: Feng Yao had already moved in front of the gate leading to the third floor, and she stood there with her hands behind her back. Her crimson eyes looked at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect who were shocked by her actions, but her gaze wasn’t focused on them.

Liang Huizhong and everyone from the sect were completely shocked once Feng Yao moved there, as they knew she hadn’t challenged any of the challenges on the second floor. They had never heard of anyone who could skip all the challenges and go directly to the next gate; even Long Wuzhao and their ancestors could not do such a thing.

They knew that Feng Yao had always been mysterious since her past life as Huo Yanling, and she had always been able to surpass all cultivators without exception. Every time other cultivators’ strength increased, her strength also increased one step ahead of them, making her unrivaled.

The two groups from the War God Pavilion were also surprised to see Feng Yao teleport away instantly, but they thought she had already completed all the challenges on the second floor. They had heard news of her decision to protect the Twin Flames Domain, and they assumed she was waiting there to protect the cultivators of that domain.

Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng finally completed their final challenge. They were a little surprised to see Feng Yao standing in front of them, but they didn’t think much of it because they had long known that she was different from other cultivators, including them. Without further ado, the three men immediately went to the third floor to meet with Zhang Fei and the others.

Not long after, Helian Xun’er, Tianshi Shengjie, Nalan Wangzi, Yue Xuelian, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling had also completed their challenges. Feng Yao instructed them to proceed to the third floor without worrying about the members of the four sects.
Unlike them, Lu Shaqing, Gong Wei, Yue Qianrou, Yue Qingyi, Nong Qinwei, Lan Xuening, Dongfang Yuechan, and a few others were still struggling to continue their challenge.
Huo Ling appeared beside Feng Yao and questioned her. "What happened to you, Master? Why are you feeling so uneasy and sorrowful?"
"Nothing happened."

"Do you think you can fool me, Master?" Huo Ling looked at the gate to the third floor. "We’ve been together for so long, and I understand your feelings very well. You feel that way because of that damn brat, right?"
Feng Yao did not answer Huo Ling.

"You’ve changed, Master." Huo Ling sighed. "Even though you didn’t want to admit it, I knew it was all that brat’s fault. If you had never met him, you would have never felt that kind of feeling. I warned you not to get too close to him, but you weren’t willing to listen to me, and your feelings became like a mess because of him."
"Shut up, Ling’er." Feng Yao glared at Huo Ling, causing her to shudder. "I know you’re saying that for my own good, but you know that Zhang Fei is the only one who can free me from those chains."

"Tch! I hate that brat! Before you met him, you were mine alone, but you changed after you two met! If it weren’t for you, I would have burned him alive with my eternal flame!" After saying that, Huo Ling entered Feng Yao’s body again.
"Sigh." Feng Yao sighed as she could hear Huo Ling continuing to insult and curse Zhang Fei. "I’m sorry, Ling’er."
[Humph! I don’t need your apology! I hate you! You chose that brat over me, who has been faithfully by your side for so long!]

On the first floor, Zhang Fei [1] stood alone, observing everyone else as they went through their challenges. He was satisfied that Zhang Chen and the others were not having any difficulties there, but their movements were not particularly fast either.

Meanwhile, Yao Qilin and Fei Lian were able to complete all the challenges before them more easily than Zhang Chen and the others. After all, the two female evil beasts were far more experienced than them, and their cultivation had almost reached the peak.

Since he had already completed all the challenges on the second floor, Zhang Fei [1] didn’t know if Yao Qilin and Fei Lian would have any difficulty facing all the challenges there. Their soul power was already high, but it was pointless to face all the challenges there, especially when they faced all the battles later.

Zhang Fei [1] sighed and shook his head slightly. Then, he looked at the gate to the second floor, thinking about Feng Yao and their relationship. At first, there was nothing special about their relationship, and they were no different from acquaintances at that time. However, their relationship began to change after he took her to the Nine Stars Realm and his training space, which made him fall in love with her.

From the moment they got to know each other, Zhang Fei [1] was aware that Feng Yao was not an ordinary cultivator or an ordinary beast because of all her past identities, but he never expected that she was the embodiment of the core of their universe. Since she had such an identity, he was convinced that the Will of the Universe he had encountered repeatedly in the Era of the Beginning was hers.

Zhang Fei [1] had always been grateful for all of Feng Yao’s help since they were still living in the Sky Jade Realm, but he found it hard to accept all of her lies, and he felt that she had approached him just to use him.
[Master.]
"Hmm?"
[I think you should have a heart-to-heart talk with Feng Yao, Master.]
"What for?"
[To clear and repair the relationship between the two of you, Master.]
"Our relationship was always good, but she ruined everything with all her lies."

[Master, I’ve always agreed with you, but I disagree with you this time.] Zhang Fei [1] furrowed his brows. [Try to remember, Master. She once promised you that she would tell you everything, right? She is the embodiment of the core of their universe, and you? Even though you have continued to get stronger over the past years, you are still weak compared to her. You couldn’t defeat Yuan Xiajie without her help, remember? So, how could she tell you about everything?]
"Mei, I—"
[Besides, you’re a liar yourself, right?]
"What did you say?"

[You haven’t revealed the system and my existence to the majority of your wives, remember? So far, only Zhang Lin and Zhang Chen know everything, and you constantly change the subject whenever the others ask you about their suspicions.] Zhang Fei [1] was at a loss for words to rebut Mei. [Feng Yao lied to you, but you also lied to them. So, what’s the difference between the two of you? In my opinion, it’s normal that she didn’t tell you anything because your relationship with her hadn’t gone beyond acquaintance, and you were too weak to know some things. However, everything changed because of that mysterious man, and you learned her true identity early on.]

Zhang Fei [1] understood everything Mei said, and he was fully aware that her words were true. However, he never liked being lied to, especially when the person lying to him was someone he trusted like Feng Yao.

[Besides, you are a man, and Feng Yao has helped you so much over the past years. Therefore, you should stop acting like a prideful pussy and give her a chance to make things right.] Zhang Fei [1] fell silent. [Master, I know you love her very much, and you will suffer if you lose her.]
Zhang Fei [1] exhaled softly. "You’re right, I love Feng Yao very much, and I will suffer if I lose her in the future. But—"
[Master, you must put aside your ego and pride, and you must give her a chance to explain everything, or you will regret it for the rest of your life.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed and closed his eyes.

Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng were confused when they saw Zhang Fei’s expression. They exchanged glances and wondered to themselves, but they didn’t approach him and sat in another area, waiting for their first challenge.

Helian Xun’er, Tianshi Shengjie, Nalan Wangzi, Yue Xuelian, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling were also confused by Zhang Fei’s expression and mood. He didn’t say anything to them, and they could see that he was seriously thinking about something.
’Hey, Yunxiao! What happened to our husband?’ Nalan Wangzi asked in a whisper. The other women were also curious about that, waiting for her explanation.

Luo Yunxiao glanced at Zhang Fei, who was closing his eyes. Then, she explained to her sisters about their previous encounter with the mysterious man, including Feng Yao’s true identity, which shocked them.
’Are you joking with us, Yunxiao?’ Qing Qiu’er asked in a shout. ’Is Feng Yao really the embodiment of the core of their universe?’

’I know you guys will be shocked by that fact, but it is the truth, and Feng Yao is truly the embodiment of the core of their universe.’ Nalan Wangzi and the others found it difficult to accept that fact, but Zhang Fei’s expression was convincing enough for them. ’We all know that our husband loves her, and he is angry because of her lies, so he is acting like this now.’
’Then?’
Luo Yunxiao shook his head. ’I don’t know what will happen between them in the future, but you guys should not ask our husband anything for now and let him think things through first.’
’We know.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1628: Worries
paragraphs: Inside the beast space, Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was enjoying his time. The flow of time there was much faster than in the outside world, even though the quality and quantity of qi within it were not as good as in the Ancient Realm.

However, the presence of Ancient Leiyu Tianlu made all the beasts in it, such as Lan Zhen, You Bai, Hu Yi, Hu Er, Jui Shui, Lei Que, Hai Ma, and Tianguo, feel pressured. Even Long Jishan, who was a thunder dragon, felt pressured by his aura, as did Sha Huoyan and Shou Yunzhi.

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked at all the beasts, but he couldn’t care about them, and he was more focused on recovering from his injuries. ’Sigh! How is my master’s situation now? Our contract is still intact, so I know that he is still alive. However, those shadowy creatures are too strong, and they will probably succeed in destroying all the barriers in the Puyang Clan one day. If that happens, my master and the others will die in their hands. I wanted to bring Zhang Fei there, but his strength was still not enough to help them.’

On the third floor of the Tower of Eternity. Lu Wangyi, Ju Jushen, and Dugu Yuanshen wanted to question Zhang Fei, but they immediately gave up their intention. They saw him, and the other cultivators were sent to the next challenge.
"What exactly happened to that young man? Why did his demeanor and expression change after his clone went to the Forbidden Land?" Dugu Yuanshen asked the other two.
Ju Jushen sighed. "I don’t know what happened to him there, but I hope he won’t dwell on his problems. This universe needs him, and peace will never return without him."
"What do you mean by that, Senior Ju?"

"Your human races are unaware of the writings about him, but both the natural race and the beast race are familiar with them." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Lu Wangyi. "One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to all races. At that time, the reincarnations of the ancestors of all races will join him and fight by his side."
Dugu Yuanshen was shocked to hear that. "Where did that writing come from, Senior Lu?"

"The former ten-tailed fox wrote all that down before he disappeared." Lu Wangyi looked at him. "You don’t need to ask about him because Ju Jushen and I don’t know him, but that writing has been passed down from generation to generation in the natural and beast races, and almost everyone from both races has been waiting for the fulfillment of that writing."
"I see." Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly. "And that young man is the person referred to in that writing, right?"
"Yes." Lu Wangyi and Ju Jushen nodded. "Zhang Fei is human, but he is also a heavenly fox and lust demon as written by the ten-tailed fox."

"Phew," Dugu Yuanshen exhaled softly. "Even though I didn’t know about it before, I know that young man is truly extraordinary. He can reach the Celestial Emperor Realm in less than a hundred years, which is an incredible achievement, and no other cultivator has ever been able to do so before him."
Lu Wangyi nodded at him. "Even though Zhang Fei is a dual cultivator, no other dual cultivator can match him because his cultivation speed is simply too absurd."

"Yes," Dugu Yuanshen replied with a slight nod. "I know several dual cultivators, and one of them has over fifty partners. His cultivation speed is incredible, but it’s still not as fast as that young man."

"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei can have such a monstrous cultivation speed, but I think it’s good for this universe. If he becomes strong faster and surpasses all the senior cultivators like us, the safety and peace of the universe will be guaranteed, and all living creatures in it will live in peace."

Dugu Yuanshen agreed with him. "However, Senior Ju, the appearance of those shadowy creatures was beyond everyone’s expectations, and that young man said they were far stronger than us. For now, they only appear in the Ancient Realm, but they might invade this Paradise Realm in the future."
"That’s true." Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi turned serious.
"I don’t know what we can do to deal with those shadowy creatures, but we can’t just wait idly by, and we must prepare many countermeasures against them."

"No matter what happens in the future, I must prepare my giant race members to face those shadowy creatures. Even if their strength surpasses ours, we will give them a tough fight if they invade our domain."
"After I return to my domain, I will also prepare the members of my druid race to face those shadowy creatures. Even if we have to die, we cannot die without giving them a fight."

Dugu Yuanshen looked at the two people in front of him and thought about some things. "I don’t know what that young man is planning, but I will order the members of my War God Pavilion to prepare themselves after we return from this tower, and we might fight together against those shadowy creatures in the future. After all, the safety and peace of this universe are not only that young man’s responsibility; all of us as its inhabitants are also responsible for them."
"That’s right."
Three days passed quickly.
For the past three days, Zhang Fei didn’t say anything to everyone on the third floor, and he was completely focused on going through all the challenges there.

Liang Huizhong and all the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect had already reached the third floor, and their attention was focused on Zhang Fei, who was standing alone in front of the stone gate in thought. However, Yue Ningxue warned them not to do anything because they didn’t know his true strength and his relationship with all the cultivators on the third floor.

Some people from the War God Pavilion had also reached the third floor, such as Dugu Xuanye and Ru Feiyan, who were also Dugu Yuanshen’s direct disciples. The two people immediately went to their master and Dugu Liangsen’s side.
Ju Jushen, Lu Wangyi, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng gathered around Zhang Fei’s group to protect his women such as Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, and Luo Yunxiao.

Tianshi Shengjie joined Long Wuzhao’s entourage, and she informed them about several things, including Zhang Fei’s change in attitude. However, she did not tell them about Feng Yao’s identity as the embodiment of the core of their universe.

Yue Xuelian sat a little apart from them, and she repeatedly looked towards the gate, waiting for the people from the Celestial Moon Sect. However, many of them had already failed and left the tower, and she ordered them to return to the Twin Flames Domain.

Zhang Fei didn’t care much about the presence of the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, and he was determined to eliminate them if they attacked him. He felt incredibly nauseous when he touched the stone gate, but he endured it and thought whether he should open it or not.

Zhang Fei had always been confident in his abilities and strength, but he lacked the confidence to fight those shadowy creatures. He knew they were truly powerful, and his strength wouldn’t be able to match theirs even if he borrowed the power of all the beasts in the beast space.

Luo Yunxiao approached Zhang Fei and hugged him from behind. "Husband, I know you’ve been thinking about those shadowy creatures, but you’ve been like this for the past four days. Even though they haven’t said anything to you, everyone is worried about you."

"Sigh." Zhang Fei sighed deeply and turned to face her. "I’m really worried that those shadowy creatures will invade this Paradise Realm, Yunxiao. I have always been confident in everything I have, but I lose my confidence when I think about them. If they invade this realm, they will definitely look for me, and our domain will face great danger. I always think that I don’t care about the fate of other people, but I can’t just ignore them, and I’m afraid that I can’t protect them from those creatures."

Luo Yunxiao looked at him. "Don’t you have two spaces? If those shadowy creatures invade this realm and come to our domain looking for you, you can hide in one of them, right? If you don’t want to bring them to the training space, you can put them in the yin-yang space. If you don’t want them to know about your two spaces, you can send them into your soul world. My master and Senior Jia Xianzu have worked hard in the past few years to help you with your soul world, and I think that place is ready to be used to hide our people."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded before looking at the people. "My soul world is indeed habitable now, but the quality and quantity of qi there is still inferior to this paradise realm. Besides, I won’t be bringing everyone there, and I’ll only bring those who have good relationships with us. As for those unrelated people, I won’t save them, and they will have to think for themselves how to survive if those shadowy creatures invade this realm."
Luo Yunxiao naturally understood her husband’s wishes, and she didn’t want to interfere with his decision. "So, do you still want to continue the challenge in this tower?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1629: Send People Back
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sighed. "All the rewards here are good, but not as good as I imagined."
"So, do you want to leave this tower now?"
Zhang Fei looked at Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Helian Xun’er, and Nalan Wangzi, who immediately ran to his side. "Do you guys want to face all the remaining challenges?"

"No," the four women answered in unison. "Even though we only reached this third floor three days ago, we feel that the rewards from the last challenges are useless. Instead, the rewards on the first and second floors are much more useful to us, especially the ones from the soul challenges, so we would rather not waste any more time here."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly and looked at Tianshi Shengjie and Yue Xuelian walking over to them. "What about you two? Do you guys want to continue? I’ve already gotten the reward I need most, and I’ve also gotten the key to this gate, so I’m thinking about leaving because the other rewards aren’t that useful."

Since they started facing these challenges three days ago, Tianshi Shengjie and Yue Xuelian also realized that those rewards were useless. Rather than wasting time earning them, they preferred to train in Zhang Fei’s training space, particularly with the time flow there four times faster than in the outside world.
"I’ll go back with you." Tianshi Shengjie decided immediately.

Yue Xuelian contacted the people from the Celestial Moon Sect who were still on the second floor to ask about their situation. Since they decided to give up due to their inability to face the challenges, she chose to return to her sect. "I’ll go back with you, and you should send the others back there."
"Zhang Xiaolong [3] is outside the forest, so they will meet him once they give up."
"I’ll inform them now." Yue Xuelian contacted her people again.

"What about the people from the Spring Zenith Sect and the Hidden Moon Sect, husband?" Zhang Fei informed Luo Yunxiao of their decision. "In that case, you can send them all back there, husband. Will you leave one of your clones here?"

"I’ll leave two of them here." Zhang Fei stole a glance at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect who seemed eager to take action against him. "One to protect my grandmother and the others on the first floor, and one to deal with those people."
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao chuckled, noticing her husband’s glance at those people. "They seem eager to get their hands on you, Husband."
"Don’t mind them." Zhang Fei hugged Luo Yunxiao’s waist, bringing her over to Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi, followed by the other women. "Are you guys going back to the Floral Mirage Domain now?"
"Are you okay now?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Lu Wangyi. "Thank you for your concern, but I’m fine now. If you two want to return to that domain, I can send you there directly, and you won’t have to waste your time on a long journey."

"I think that’s much better." Since Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi had heard of Zhang Fei’s battle with the former fairy king, and they also knew his abilities as a celestial fox, they knew that he could open a gate leading to the Floral Mirage Domain. "Although we don’t yet have information on whether those creatures have the ability to invade this Paradise Realm or not, we will prepare our giant and druid races to face their threat, so we will be ready if something unexpected happens."

"Alright." Zhang Fei looked at the male giant. "There are some members of the giant race in my sect, so I will send them to the Floral Mirage Domain after I return, and I want you to help them improve themselves."
Ju Jushen nodded. "Leave them to me, and I will prepare them better."
"What about the other natural races?"

"They have been waiting for you for a long time, and they will give you a warm welcome when you go there." Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi told Zhang Fei about all the natural races living in the Floral Mirage Domain. "If there are many members of the natural races in your sect, you can send them to our domain, and those of the same races will teach them more things."

Zhang Fei created a qi screen and showed Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi about the members of the natural races in his sect. "They are natural races from the Sky Jade Realm, the Nine Stars Realm, and the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Since they decided to follow me, I decided to bring them to this realm."
Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi watched the people on the screen. "Fairy race, dryad race, elf race, centaur race, gnome race, dwarf race, and giant race."
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "Do all those races live in the Floral Mirage Domain?"

"Many members of all those races live in our domain, except for the centaur race. It’s fine if you want to send members of the centaur race in your sect there, and the people of the other races will welcome them."

Zhang Fei handed half of the teleportation device to Lu Wangyi. "Install it in a safe place, and I’ll install the other half in my sect. That way, all members of the natural races in my sect can travel between the two places freely, and your members can also go to my sect if they wish."

Lu Wangyi was a little skeptical that the teleportation device could connect the two domains, especially after the changes that occurred in the Paradise Realm, but she asked nothing. "Please send us back to our domain, and we will wait for you there."
"Wait." Ju Jushen stopped Zhang Fei. "Are you sure you want to open the gate in front of the people from that sect?"

Zhang Fei briefly glanced at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect with a slight smirk. "Even if they see my abilities, they won’t be able to do anything because they come from my beast bloodline. The only person I don’t want to see my abilities is Qian Yan because his middle eye ability is too terrifying, so I haven’t been to his domain to this day."

"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed at that. "People always fear the other demon gods like Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, Sha Mo, and Ku Shenzu, but they don’t know that Qian Yan is more terrifying than them because he rarely appears."

"I still have some fears about the four of them myself, but I’m more afraid of Qian Yan than them." The people of the Divine Samsara Sect and the War God Pavilion were shocked when Zhang Fei opened the gate leading to the Floral Mirage Domain. "You two will arrive at your domain directly."
"We will wait for you in our domain, Zhang Fei."

"I will arrange a time to go there." After Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi disappeared, Zhang Fei approached the three dragons. "Those people have decided to leave this tower, so you three don’t need to wait here any longer."
Long Wuzhao immediately stood up, followed by Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong. "Are you thinking of opening the gate?"

"I originally thought about doing so, but I didn’t want to take the risk because those shadowy creatures have already taken over the tower in the Zhanlu Domain, and they will invade this tower once I open the gate." Zhang Fei looked at the gate leading to the second floor. "Moreover, Feng Yao has another path to the Ancient Realm, and I might go with her there after this."
"Are you serious about going to that realm with the situation there being bad?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a frown.

"Father-in-law, I have no choice but to go to that realm, okay?" Zhang Fei sighed. "Hu Tianlang’s two souls are there, and I can’t evolve without them. I don’t want to rush there, but the appearance of those shadowy creatures is worrying, and they are also targeting those two souls. If they get those two souls, I will never be able to evolve, and we will have no other solution to stop them. Even though going there right now is too risky, I will take that risk to protect the people closest to me."
Tianshi Bailong grabbed his shoulder, glancing at his daughter. "You must do something about my daughter before you go to the Ancient Realm. Do you understand?"
Zhang Fei smiled and looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who had turned her face to the side. He returned his gaze to Tianshi Bailong. "Don’t worry about that, father-in-law."

"How about I go with you to the Ancient Realm, Kid?" Zhang Fei looked at Long Xukong. "As you already know, I’m a void dragon, and I can take you through the void, so you won’t encounter those shadowy creatures there."

[I think that’s a good idea, Master. If you don’t encounter those shadowy creatures, you can meet Hu Tianlang’s two souls much more easily, and the avatars of the two primordial beasts probably won’t notice your presence there either.]
Zhang Fei agreed with Mei, but unfortunately, he didn’t have any information about the abilities of those shadowy creatures. "Let’s discuss this matter with Feng Yao first, Senior Xukong."
"Alright." Long Xukong agreed.
"So, do you two want to return to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain now?"
"Please send us back."
"Alright." Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong disappeared into the gate as soon as Zhang Fei opened it, but he immediately closed it again.
"Young man." Zhang Fei turned to Dugu Yuanshen. "Can you also send us back to your domain?"

"Do all those races live in the Floral Mirage Domain?"
"Many members of all those races live in our domain, except for the centaur race.
It’s fine if you want to send members of the centaur race in your sect there, and the people of the other races will welcome them."
Zhang Fei handed half of the teleportation device to Lu Wangyi.
"Install it in a safe place, and I’ll install the other half in my sect.
That way, all members of the natural races in my sect can travel between the two places freely, and your members can also go to my sect if they wish."
Lu Wangyi was a little skeptical that the teleportation device could connect the two domains, especially after the changes that occurred in the Paradise Realm, but she asked nothing.
"Please send us back to our domain, and we will wait for you there."
"Wait." Ju Jushen stopped Zhang Fei.
"Are you sure you want to open the gate in front of the people from that sect?"
Zhang Fei briefly glanced at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect with a slight smirk.
"Even if they see my abilities, they won’t be able to do anything because they come from my beast bloodline.
The only person I don’t want to see my abilities is Qian Yan because his middle eye ability is too terrifying, so I haven’t been to his domain to this day."
"Haha," Ju Jushen laughed at that.
"People always fear the other demon gods like Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, Sha Mo, and Ku Shenzu, but they don’t know that Qian Yan is more terrifying than them because he rarely appears."

"I still have some fears about the four of them myself, but I’m more afraid of Qian Yan than them." The people of the Divine Samsara Sect and the War God Pavilion were shocked when Zhang Fei opened the gate leading to the Floral Mirage Domain.
"You two will arrive at your domain directly."
"We will wait for you in our domain, Zhang Fei."
"I will arrange a time to go there." After Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi disappeared, Zhang Fei approached the three dragons.
"Those people have decided to leave this tower, so you three don’t need to wait here any longer."
Long Wuzhao immediately stood up, followed by Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong.
"Are you thinking of opening the gate?"

"I originally thought about doing so, but I didn’t want to take the risk because those shadowy creatures have already taken over the tower in the Zhanlu Domain, and they will invade this tower once I open the gate." Zhang Fei looked at the gate leading to the second floor.
"Moreover, Feng Yao has another path to the Ancient Realm, and I might go with her there after this."
"Are you serious about going to that realm with the situation there being bad?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a frown.
"Father-in-law, I have no choice but to go to that realm, okay?" Zhang Fei sighed.
"Hu Tianlang’s two souls are there, and I can’t evolve without them.
I don’t want to rush there, but the appearance of those shadowy creatures is worrying, and they are also targeting those two souls.
If they get those two souls, I will never be able to evolve, and we will have no other solution to stop them.
Even though going there right now is too risky, I will take that risk to protect the people closest to me."
Tianshi Bailong grabbed his shoulder, glancing at his daughter.
"You must do something about my daughter before you go to the Ancient Realm.
Do you understand?"
Zhang Fei smiled and looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who had turned her face to the side.
He returned his gaze to Tianshi Bailong.
"Don’t worry about that, father-in-law."
"How about I go with you to the Ancient Realm, Kid?" Zhang Fei looked at Long Xukong.
"As you already know, I’m a void dragon, and I can take you through the void, so you won’t encounter those shadowy creatures there."
[I think that’s a good idea, Master.
If you don’t encounter those shadowy creatures, you can meet Hu Tianlang’s two souls much more easily, and the avatars of the two primordial beasts probably won’t notice your presence there either.]
Zhang Fei agreed with Mei, but unfortunately, he didn’t have any information about the abilities of those shadowy creatures.
"Let’s discuss this matter with Feng Yao first, Senior Xukong."
"Alright." Long Xukong agreed.
"So, do you two want to return to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain now?"
"Please send us back."
"Alright." Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong disappeared into the gate as soon as Zhang Fei opened it, but he immediately closed it again.
"Young man." Zhang Fei turned to Dugu Yuanshen.
"Can you also send us back to your domain?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1630: Leave The Tower
paragraphs: "Heavenly Trial Domain, right?" Dugu Yuanshen nodded to Zhang Fei. "Are you sure you want to go back there, Senior? Most of your elders and disciples only arrived on the third floor today, and they’ve only completed one challenge, so their efforts to get here would be in vain if they were to turn back now."

Dugu Yuanshen shook his head. "Naturally, not all of us will be returning to the sect. I will only be bringing a few elders with me, and our disciples will remain in this tower. Actually, we have a teleportation portal connecting this domain to ours, and we can return whenever we want."
"If you want it like that, I will send you back to your domain." After Dugu Yuanshen summoned several elders, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the Heavenly Trial Domain.

"Young man," Dugu Yuanshen patted his shoulder. "If you need our help fighting those shadowy creatures, you can contact me directly, and I will lead my men to assist you. After all, the safety and peace of this universe are not only your responsibility; all of us as its inhabitants are also responsible for them."

Zhang Fei initially thought the people from the War God Pavilion would be his enemies because of his demon identity, but it turned out he was mistaken. "Thank you, Senior. If I need your help, I will contact you immediately. Currently, I cannot confirm anything about those shadowy creatures, but I hope you all start preparing to prevent any eventuality."
"I know." Dugu Yuanshen nodded slightly. "I will contact my old friends, such as Hun Lingwu and the others, and I will tell them about those shadowy creatures."

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly at the old man’s name. "Senior, Hun Lingwu is my enemy, and I did some things to him a few years ago. He should already be aware of everything and hold a grudge against me, so you should not tell him about me."

"Oh? What’s the matter between you and Hun Lingwu?" Zhang Fei told Dugu Yuanshen about his problems with the old man, including his actions towards Jing Qiuyue, Yan Yinqing, and Jun Qingling. "Sigh! I’ve advised him countless times, but he never changed. Luckily, you’ve taken his mirror away from him, so he won’t be able to do that kind of thing anymore. You don’t have to worry about him, and I won’t say anything to him about you."
"Thank you, Senior."

"I will take them back to our domain now." Dugu Yuanshen led those elders away from the tower through Zhang Fei’s gate. Upon their arrival at their domain, he immediately gathered all the members of the War God Pavilion present there, discussing the disaster and the future of the Paradise Realm.

Zhang Fei’s actions left many questions in the hearts of Liang Huizhong and the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect, especially regarding those gates. They wanted to attack him, but they had already seen his close ties with those people. Moreover, Long Xukong was by his side, and the male dragon was far more powerful than them, plus there were still Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and Feng Yao.

After closing the gate, Zhang Fei glanced at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, but he didn’t care much about them, and he could order Yue Ningxue to stop them if they decided to make a move on him. Then, he approached Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng. "What about you three? Are you guys going to stay here or return to our sect?"

"Haha," Jian Kuang laughed. "Although all the rewards here are useless to you and your women, they are still useful to us. Moreover, this is our first time reaching the third floor, so we will stay and face all the challenges."
Su Shentian nodded. "Moreover, all your women are still on the first floor, right? Those people can go down to the second floor, so we will challenge this floor while protecting them."
"I’ll stay here too." Zhuxian Sheng glanced at the people from the Divine Samsara Sect. "You can go and do your business in peace; we will protect them from those people."
Zhang Fei nodded to the three men and opened the gate to the Twin Flames Domain. "You can return to our domain now, and I’ll meet Feng Yao first."

"Alright." Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Tianshi Shengjie, and Yue Xuelian immediately entered the gate. Zhang Fei immediately went to the second floor after he closed the gate, followed by Long Xukong.
"Ancestor." Yue Ningxue looked at Liang Huizhong. "Can’t you fight them?"
Yue Ningxue shook her head slightly. "You underestimate Zhang Fei, Huizhong. He’s a wolf in sheep’s clothing, and his strength is far greater than it appears."
"Are—"

"I’m not joking with you," Yue Ningxue interrupted him. "I’ve fought Zhang Fei before, and I couldn’t beat him then, especially his speed. If the other ancestors were in this tower, we might be able to defeat him and capture him, but unfortunately, they won’t come out if our sect isn’t threatened."

The faces of Liang Huizhong and the elders turned gloomy. except for Yu Shan. Unlike the others, he didn’t want to look for trouble with other people, including Zhang Fei, and he just wanted peace for himself.

Yue Ningxue spoke again. "Besides, you’ve seen for yourself his closeness to Long Wuzhao, Empress Huo, and Dugu Yuanshen, right? Do you think we can fight them? Empress Huo is much stronger than us, and her subordinates are just as strong as the people of our sect, so we will face a serious situation if they attack us. The War God Pavilion has been our rival for a long time, and we have never succeeded in defeating them. The dragon emperor? We never knew his true strength because he never fought seriously; even the four perils and the ten demon gods chose not to have any problems with him, remember?"

Liang Huizhong and the elders were even more depressed upon hearing this because Zhang Fei had done a lot to make the Moonlit Passion Temple as powerful as their sect, and they were worried that another formidable enemy would appear to disrupt their dominance.

"Forget that kid! We’re facing a more serious problem now." They looked at Yue Ningxue, who immediately explained to them about the shadowy creatures. "I heard about those creatures from their conversations, and they must be powerful if they can make Long Wuzhao and the others worry. For now, we must return to our domain as soon as possible, and we must strengthen the defenses in our sect. We don’t know if those creatures can invade this realm, but we must use all means to protect our sect."
"What about the Celestial Moon Sect, Ancestor?" Li Guangyu asked.

"Yue Xuelian has already moved the Celestial Moon Sect to the Twin Flames Domain, and they are under Zhang Fei’s protection now, so we don’t need to think about them and focus on our sect. Once the situation stabilizes in the future, we will think of other ways to fight them." Yue Ningxue immediately stood up from her seat. "Let’s go back to our sect to set up our defenses, and you can let our disciples stay here to continue their challenges."
After that, Yue Ningxue, Liang Huizhong, Li Guangyu, and several other main elders immediately left the tower.
"How are you going to get me to the Ancient Realm?"

Feng Yao created a qi screen and showed Zhang Fei a portal. "The portal’s location is in my Blazing Nirvana Domain, and it connects us to the Blazing Desert Domain. That place is no less hot than my domain, and there’s nothing there but vast desert, so I don’t think those shadowy creatures will invade it."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at the qi screen with a serious look. "Do you think we can move through the void with Senior Xukong’s abilities?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "Long Xukong should be able to lead us through the void to avoid those shadowy creatures, but we don’t have clear information on their strength and abilities, so we shouldn’t underestimate them."

"I know." Zhang Fei himself never underestimated his enemies, especially those whose strength and abilities were unclear. "Everyone has left this tower, except for my woman and your parents. I think we should leave now, and our main goal is the old fox’s two souls. I don’t know their location, but you should know about them, right?"
"I know." Feng Yao nodded. "Let’s get out of this tower."
They immediately appeared outside the forest area, and Zhang Fei opened the gate to the Blazing Nirvana Domain before bringing everyone there.
Upon arrival at the domain, Feng Yao led them to the portal located deep beneath her palace.

"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei took out the Demon’s Eye Orb and sent it into the domain to ensure there were no shadowy creatures there. "It seems you were right, because those creatures aren’t there, so we should be safe to go there."

Feng Yao looked at Long Xukong. "Once we arrive at the domain, I want you to lead us into the void, and I’ll show you the way to Hu Tianlang’s first soul. However, we must remain cautious as we are uncertain of their abilities, and we must flee immediately if we encounter them."
"I understand," Long Xukong asked her. "Can’t you stop those shadowy creatures with your current strength?"
Feng Yao shook her head. "Those shadowy creatures are different from all living creatures in this universe, so I don’t know if I can face them."
"Let’s go now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1631: Avatars Of The Primordial Beasts
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Blazing Desert Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Ding.]
[The host has arrived in the Ancient Realm, and the requirements have been fulfilled. Initiated the last system upgrade process, and it will undergo major changes. Estimated time: a year.]
[New upgrades will be implemented after the process is complete.]
[Unable to generate new quests, the host’s cultivation is insufficient.]
Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief after the series of notifications appeared, but he didn’t expect the system to enter its final upgrade because Mei had once said that level 10 was the final level.
[Master, I don’t know what kind of changes will occur to the system, so we can only wait for the process to end, but I don’t think the additional features will be much.]
Zhang Fei had no problem with that because he had already benefited greatly from the system, which had helped him progress so far in the cultivation world since he obtained it.

The Blazing Desert Domain is a vast expanse where the earth burns beneath a giant, never-dying sun. The sand stretches endlessly in waves of crimson, making every step feel like walking on smoldering stones.

Heat radiates not only from above but also from below, as if the entire domain rests atop a dormant furnace without visible flames. The sky is often a hazy red from the extreme intensity of the heat. The air vibrates with heat, creating a constant mirage so that distance and direction lose their meaning. Hot wind sweeps across the land, mingling with the fine sand that burns anything.
"So fucking hot!" Long Xukong enveloped himself with his void qi because he couldn’t stand the extreme heat in the domain.
On the contrary, Zhang Fei did not find it difficult to adapt to the extreme heat in the domain, especially since he had several beast bloodlines affiliated with the fire element in his body.

Meanwhile, Feng Yao was a pure fire phoenix, and the hottest fire, the eternal flame, resided in her body. Besides, she was the embodiment of the core of the universe, so she had all the abilities needed to withstand the extreme heat. "Bring us into the void now."
"Alright." Long Xukong enveloped them with his void qi and brought them into the void.
As they entered the void, a violent tremor occurred within the dark forest in one of the Ancient Realm’s domains. Two giant eyes opened, but their physical appearance was invisible to the naked eye.

The creature was none other than the Primordial Nihility Beast, and his form was only revealed after he moved. He has a colossal, towering body. His body stretched endlessly, with a broad, heavy torso and elongated limbs. His skin was like layers of compressed darkness that flow like slow-moving smoke, constantly folding and collapsing inward. There were no scales or fur, only a smooth yet unstable surface.

His head was enormous, with a long, heavy snout and a wide mouth that never fully opened but seemed capable of devouring the entire forest. His eyes were deep and dark—darker than the rest of his body. His limbs were long and heavy, lacking clear joints, and bending in unnatural ways. The ends of his limbs did not form claws; instead, they sprawled out into strands of darkness.

"Hmm? I can sense the aura of the calamity demon dragon, and he has just arrived in this ancient realm, but he suddenly disappeared again. Besides the aura of the calamity demon dragon, I sense the aura of another beast radiating from him, but I can’t recognize it." The primordial nihility beast muttered to himself as he looked into the distance. "Besides, I can sense the aura of a void dragon beside him, so I’m sure that weak dragon brought him into the void. Apart from that weak dragon, there is one female beast by his side, and I think it’s a fire phoenix. However, she is different from the other fire phoenixes, and I feel quite familiar with her aura, but I can’t remember her."

After thinking, the primordial nihility beast or rather, his avatar—decided to merge with the dark forest again, but he continued to observe the situation and waited for Zhang Fei to come out of the void.
"Where exactly did those shadowy creatures come from? Even though this is only my avatar, I am a primordial beast that has existed since the birth of this universe, but I am afraid of them."
Meanwhile, atop a mountain peak shrouded in thick white clouds, another beast opened his eyes. He was none other than the Primordial Genesis Beast—though it was only an avatar.

His body was completely white from head to tail. A smooth, pure white that felt too perfect, as if it didn’t belong in the normal world. His body was massive and long; he looked like a combination between a dragon and a qilin. His eyes were pure white too, with no pupils or color at all. There was no expression in his gaze, no anger or kindness, just a calm, distant feeling, like he didn’t care about anything. His enormous body wrapped around the mountain peak, with a head like a dragon mixed with a qilin and a heavy torso.

"The Calamity Demon Dragon has returned, so the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon should have returned as well. Based on his appearance, he must have come from the Paradise Realm, but he is too weak compared to his predecessor. The void dragon and the fire phoenix with him are quite strong by the standards of that realm, but they are still no match for me and my brother." He looked in several different directions. "The appearance of those shadowy creatures is really unexpected, and they are much stronger than my avatar. I don’t know the reason for their appearance, but they seem to be looking for something in this Ancient Realm, and I will monitor their movements while waiting for that man to come out of the void."
Inside the void, Long Xukong was already in his void dragon form with Zhang Fei and Feng Yao sitting on his back.
"Do you think the avatars of the two primordial beasts are aware of my presence in this realm?"

Feng Yao tilted her head at Zhang Fei. "They should already be aware of your presence in this realm, and they will definitely come for us as soon as we exit the void, so you must be prepared for the risks."

"Phew," Zhang Fei exhaled. "Unfortunately, I have no other choice, right? You told me that those shadowy creatures are targeting the old fox’s two souls, and your barrier won’t be able to stop them forever. If those two souls fall into their hands, I will never be able to evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and no one can stop them. If they succeed in invading the Paradise Realm, all living creatures living there will die."
"You’re right." Feng Yao pointed to his chest. "You have a way to save them, but I’m sure you won’t save everyone, and you’ll only save those who have a close relationship with you, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "As I told you in the past, I don’t care about other living beings, and I only care about those I’ve chosen all along. If those shadowy creatures really invade this Paradise Realm, I will send those people into my soul world, and I will hide inside the Sealed World Pearl so they won’t be able to find me."

"Is that kind of life interesting to you?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "You always say you want to live freely without restraint, but in the end, you will be forced to live in hiding if those shadowy creatures invade this realm. Besides, have you ever considered whether they have the ability to invade your soul world or not?"

Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao in contemplation, as he had never considered this before. Although his soul world was separate from his universe, his body was still in the same universe as those shadowy creatures, and he had no information about their abilities.

"I don’t know that," Zhang Fei sighed. "For now, I don’t want to think about that, and I want to focus on meeting the two souls of the old fox as soon as possible. If I succeed in evolving into the ten-tailed fox, I will think of a solution to get rid of those shadowy creatures. However, there are questions that have been bothering me since their appearance."
"What kind of questions are you thinking?"
"What would happen to you if those shadowy creatures invaded this entire universe? What would happen to you if they destroyed this universe? Would you die along with the destruction of this universe?

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled before hugging her legs. "You already know my identity, right? Those creatures were intentionally sealed within the core of this universe, but they were freed because of me. I’m confident in facing the two primordial beasts, but I’m not confident in facing those creatures. Even though I’ve reincarnated several times, my identity has never changed, and I will die if this universe is destroyed."
