paragraphs: "Eh?" Mo Anqi shrieked. "Is my father really returning to this realm soon? If he returns, my big sister and I won’t be able to return to your sect, and he’ll pressure us to follow his every command."

Mo Zainan looked at him. "How can you be sure that my husband will return? My subordinates have tried to break the seal at the tunnel exit, but they never succeeded. When my husband and his subordinates wanted to help them, a mysterious woman attacked them."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "I can’t explain the details to you, but they will come out of the tunnel soon. I told you before that several demon gods are targeting your demon race, but I haven’t told you that there is a hidden danger threatening this Paradise Realm. It threatens not just one domain but all of them, so I need your husband to protect this domain."
"A hidden danger?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen and showed those shadowy creatures to the three women. "Those creatures are powerful, but fortunately, they haven’t invaded this realm yet. However, it’s possible that they will invade this realm in the future, so all powerful cultivators must be on guard. The strongest cultivator in your race is your husband, so he must return here to protect everyone."
"If my husband returns and finds his trusted men in captivity, he will be furious and kill us."

"You don’t need to worry about them because I will help you take care of them, and you can free them afterwards. As for your subordinates, you can talk to them later, and you can arrange everything before your husband returns."
Mo Zainan rose to her feet and led him elsewhere, followed by her two daughters. "Please follow me."

Soon, they arrive at the underground prison, where Mo Zainan imprisons her husband’s subordinates. Their condition was quite dire because they had been imprisoned since Mo Shentian left, and their cultivation was also sealed.

Zhang Fei [5] went inside and examined those demons, and he used his memory manipulation ability on them. They would be loyal to Mo Zainan even if Mo Shentian came back later. After he was done, he gave them healing pills and qi restoration pills, so they could return to their prime conditions as soon as possible. "Done! You can release them after this, and they will recover before your husband returns, preventing his suspicion."
"Thank you." Mo Zainan breathed a sigh of relief.

"What about us, Zhang Fei? Can you do anything for us?" Mo Anqi asked. "We’ve been comfortable living in your sect because we have many friends there, so we don’t want to stay here and go back there."

Zhang Fei [5] understood Mo Anqi’s wishes because she had lived in her sect for almost six years since Mo Shentian left for the Three Mortal Realms, and he also always monitored her activities in his sect.
{You got artificial dolls x2.}
{2,000,000,000,000 has been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out the two dolls and asked for the two princesses’ hair and blood. He put them into the dolls, making them turn into two princesses. "Inject a bit of your consciousness and soul power into it, so you two can drive them from my sect, and your father won’t know the difference."

Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha touched the two dolls’ chests and channeled their soul power into them, along with a bit of their consciousness. They were surprised when she did, mainly because the doll moved according to their wishes. Besides, they could sense that the two dolls’ aura and cultivation matched their own, and they were confident that no one, including their father, would be able to recognize them.

Mo Zainan was also surprised to see the two dolls, but she smiled happily because her two daughters would not have to suffer with her if her husband returned, and they could enjoy their lives in the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to his domain. "You two should return there now, and you can accompany your mother through these dolls."
Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha hugged and kissed Mo Zainan before disappearing into the gate, which Zhang Fei [5] immediately closed.
"Will my husband really not recognize them?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into his embrace and kissed her. "Sorry, I haven’t been with you all these years because I’ve been too busy with my cultivation. When I reach your husband’s level, I will challenge him and defeat him, and you will be free from him at that time."

Mo Zainan nodded slightly with a smile. "Even though we haven’t seen each other for a long time, I am satisfied with your cultivation progress. You have reached the Celestial Emperor now, and I believe you will reach my level in a few years. Are you leaving now?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I have to meet some other people, so I have to go now, but I will return here to accompany you after I meet them."
"I’ll wait for you to come back."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, Mo Zainan ordered her husband’s subordinates to leave the prison and return to their old posts. Then, she went to meet her subordinates and explained everything to them.

Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Azure Cloud Domain to meet Xiao Jingyi and Huo Yu’er. He informed them about the shadowy creatures and asked them to be vigilant in case they suddenly appeared in the domain.

After speaking with the two women, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Lotus Expanse Domain, the Radiant Starfall Domain, and the Twilight Domain. He informed Huo Hao’er, Huo Xiaoyu, and Huo Lanyin, who were guarding his shops in the three domains, about the shadowy creatures. He asked them to inform him and Feng Yao if they suddenly appeared.

Huo Lanyin felt bored standing guard in the Radiant Starfall Domain, and she asked Zhang Fei [5] to send one of his clones to her so they could practice and compete in alchemy together, to which he agreed and left his fourth clone there.

Zhang Fei [5]’s next destination was the Heavenly Mist Domain, where he spoke with Huo Fengyin, Feng Shanxi, and Ren Xiyi about the shadow creatures. Like the others, he asked the three women to contact him and Feng Yao if those creatures suddenly appeared in the domain.

After speaking with the three women, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Long Huoyan, Huo Jinying, and Si Yingwu. Like the others, he told them about those shadowy creatures and asked them to be on guard for their appearance.

Thereafter, Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying ordered many demihumans to spread out to every corner of their domain to stand guard, hoping they wouldn’t be late in noticing if the shadowy creatures suddenly appeared.

Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, but he warned Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi about those shadowy creatures. However, they had already heard everything from Bing Xingying, and they had also asked the other clans and sects to prepare.

Zhang Fei [5] also did not go to the five demon domains, but he informed Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Qi Qingxiu, Wu Mian, and Jiu Mozu about those shadowy creatures. Although Xie Yao and Xie Yan were unwilling to become his subordinates, he still informed them about the matter. Besides them, he also informed Mo Tianshen and Morgana, who were still cultivating in the mountain in the Endless Domain.
Since Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Ju Jushen, and Lu Wangyi already knew about the matter, Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the Floral Mirage Domain and the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Zhang Fei [5] considered going to the Radiance Domain, but Tian Yaoqin informed him that Tian Qiye was monitoring their domain, and she was afraid that her leader would detect his presence. He gave up his intention to go to that domain, and he informed Tian Yizu and the other grand elders through voice transmission.

Zhang Fei [5] did not forget to go to the Peach Garden Domain, specifically the Emerald Bamboo Sect, and spoke to the two sect leaders, Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru. He also went to the Starfall Martial Domain to meet the ancestor of the Zhang Clan, Zhang Zetian, to inform him of the matter. As for the other domains, he didn’t have any connections there, so he thought of other ways to monitor the situation there.
After everything was settled, Zhang Fei [5] went to his final destination, which was none other than the Thousand Beast Grave Domain. He met Dong Xuanyin at her pond.
"Huh? Why are you here? Didn’t you go to the Glazed Heaven Domain to train in the tower?" Dong Xuanyin asked in surprise.
"I’ve already finished my training in the tower, and my real body is on his way to the Cangxuan Domain."
"The Cangxuan Domain? Why haven’t I heard of that domain before?"

"The Cangxuan Domain is one of the domains in the Ancient Realm." Dong Xuanyin was shocked to hear that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately created a qi screen and showed it to her. "Feng Yao brought me to that domain because I need to meet the old fox’s two souls. Anyways, I didn’t come here to talk about that, but I wanted to warn you about the hidden dangers threatening this realm, and I also wanted to tell you that the four perils will return soon."
"What do you mean by the hidden dangers?" Zhang Fei [5] changed the picture on the qi screen and explained to Dong Xuanyin about those shadowy creatures. "Are they really that strong?"

Didn’t you go to the Glazed Heaven Domain to train in the tower?" Dong Xuanyin asked in surprise.
"I’ve already finished my training in the tower, and my real body is on his way to the Cangxuan Domain."
"The Cangxuan Domain?
Why haven’t I heard of that domain before?"
"The Cangxuan Domain is one of the domains in the Ancient Realm." Dong Xuanyin was shocked to hear that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately created a qi screen and showed it to her.
"Feng Yao brought me to that domain because I need to meet the old fox’s two souls.
Anyways, I didn’t come here to talk about that, but I wanted to warn you about the hidden dangers threatening this realm, and I also wanted to tell you that the four perils will return soon."
"What do you mean by the hidden dangers?" Zhang Fei [5] changed the picture on the qi screen and explained to Dong Xuanyin about those shadowy creatures.
"Are they really that strong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1635: Free The Demons And Evil Beasts
paragraphs: "They’re powerful, so I want you to keep an eye on this domain, and you must report to me if those creatures appear here." Dong Xuanyin nodded solemnly. "Anyway, the four perils will be released soon, and they’ll be back here shortly. They’re seriously injured, so they won’t be able to do anything.
Dong Xuanyin raised an eyebrow. "Are they really coming back?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Those shadowy creatures are too powerful, so we need all powerful cultivators, beasts, and demons here. Otherwise, those creatures will take over this realm, and it will be even more difficult for us to stop them."
"I see." Dong Xuanyin nodded in understanding. "Don’t worry, leave this domain to me, and I will notify you if I detect the appearance of those creatures. What are you going to do now?
"I want to go around all the domains before returning to my sect, and I will think of a way to monitor them." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate and disappeared inside.

Dong Xuanyin let out a long sigh and lay down on her coral. "The four pearls will return, but I think that’s good, so I don’t need to guard this domain myself. If those creatures invade this realm, they can help me fight them off."

After he left Dong Xuanyin’s place, Zhang Fei [5] went to all domains except Qian Yan’s domain because he was not ready to face the demon god. He looked for a way to monitor all domains, but Feng Yao, who was with his original body, told him not to think about them.
"Are you serious about that, Big Sis?" Yue Qianrou asked after Yue Xuelian informed them about those shadowy creatures.

Yue Xuelian nodded at them. "Zhang Fei already knew about those creatures before we left for the Glazed Heaven Domain, but he only told me after we reached the third floor. For now, they only appear in the Ancient Realm, but we can’t relax and must monitor the situation in this domain. If we let our guard down and those creatures appear in the domain, we’ll be too late to fight them."
"Aren’t Xuan Meiyun and her race members also watching over this domain, Sect Master?"

"That’s right." Yue Xuelian nodded to Yue Yuling. "Even though they are monitoring this domain, we can’t leave all the surveillance to them. We are the residents of this domain now, so we must assist them in monitoring all areas. Zhang Fei will also inform the other sects and clans about them later, so we will jointly monitor everything."
"What about the Celestial Moon Domain?" Yue Wanxin asked.

"Zhang Fei should have already informed Nanfeng Yunxi about those creatures, and I will inform the sect masters of those sects about them so they can monitor the domain themselves." Then, Yue Xuelian ordered them. "Inform all disciples of this matter and ask them to participate in monitoring this domain."
"Yes, Sect Master."
After the elders left, Yue Qianrou asked her, "Big Sis, are you going into seclusion again after this?"
"No." Yue Xuelian thought for a moment before saying to her, "Qianrou, I know you’re hiding some things from me, but I hope you’ll be willing to open up to me about everything someday."

’Tch! What can you do if I tell you the truth? Will you care about my condition as a corpse demon? Will you be able to restore me and turn me back into a human?’ Yue Qianrou nodded at her. "When I’m ready, I’ll tell you the truth, Big Sis. I’ll leave now, and I’ll help them talk to the disciples."

Yue Xuelian could only sigh inwardly as she watched Yue Qianrou leave; however, she lacked the courage to discuss the events at that mysterious place with her, especially regarding her transformation into a demon corpse. ’’Sigh! I can’t do anything for you, but I’m sure Zhang Fei and Empress Huo will find a way to break the curse and reverse it so you can become human again.’
Like the Celestial Moon Sect, people from the other sects and clans in the Twin Flames Domain also discussed the issue of the shadowy creatures and sent people to monitor all areas of their domains.

Not only the sects and clans of the Twin Flames Domain, but everyone in the Empyrean Domain did the same, especially after Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi spoke to them. At first, they didn’t believe them, but they changed their minds after they told them the information came from Empress Huo.
The people of the Heavenly Trial Domain initially didn’t believe the news, but Dugu Yuanshen displayed some images of those shadowy creatures that he had obtained from Zhang Fei in the tower.

Everyone in the domain immediately sent people to monitor their domains, and Dugu Yuanshen also mobilized almost all members of the War God Pavilion to cooperate with those people in monitoring their domains.

Meanwhile, Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru were having difficulty convincing the people from the Peach Garden Domain, and they ultimately decided to monitor the situation in their own domain. They also ordered the people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect to assist them, including Sima Yun and Hua Mei’er, who had decided to return there after spending years at the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, and Wu Mian did not doubt Zhang Fei’s news. They immediately deployed their subordinates to monitor all areas of their domains.

In the Slaughter Blood Domain, Shang Luohu discussed the matter with Shang Zhui and the four asura guardians. The asura empress did not doubt Zhang Fei, but the four asura guardians were still skeptical about the news. Even so, they carried out their empress’s orders because their emperor had not yet emerged from his seclusion, even though he had been there for several years.
"What do you think about those creatures, Zhui?"

Zhang Zhui shook his head. "I can’t say anything about them because I’ve never seen them, so we must be prepared for the possibility of them invading this realm. My son told me that everyone in the Twin Flames Domain has also spread out in their domain to keep an eye on everything."
"I’m not surprised by that," Shang Luohu sighed. "I’ve spent too much time with Zhang Fei’s clones over the past few years, and I have some idea of his abilities, so I won’t doubt him."
"Does Zhang Fei still not intend to release Princess Xueli?"

Shang Luohu shook her head. "Zhang Fei will never release my daughter before she meets my husband, but my husband is still in seclusion to this day. I don’t know when he will come out, but I hope he will soon because our people have begun to question his condition."
"Don’t worry, Empress. Our people won’t dare do anything, and I will personally stop them if they even think about rebelling."
"Alright, I’ll leave them to you, Zhui."
In the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Long Wuzhao gathered all the leaders of the beast races, except for Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu, who were still in seclusion in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

Long Wuzhao informed them about those shadowy creatures, and he also displayed their pictures to more easily convince them. After he finished speaking with them, he and Feng Jinhuang went to meet the higher-ups and informed them about those creatures.

Hui Chen and the others did not doubt Long Wuzhao, especially after he showed them pictures of those creatures and told them that he heard everything from Feng Yao. After they had a long discussion, they immediately returned to their respective places and ordered their members to monitor the situation.

In the Floral Mirage Domain, Ju Jushen and Lu Wangyi gathered all the members of the natural races. They informed them about the shadowy creatures, supported by Jia Leixuan and Jia Yuyan’s grandparents. They also told the people about Zhang Fei, but they couldn’t tell them the exact date he would arrive in their domain, so they asked everyone to be patient until he came to meet them.

After the discussion, all the natural races also ordered their respective members to keep watch over their domains so they wouldn’t be caught off guard if those creatures suddenly invaded their domains.

In the Radiance Domain, Tian Yizu discussed the shadowy creatures with several grand elders, including Tian You’an, Tian Wei, and Tian Xuanyin. However, they were unsure about how to inform Tian Qiye about the creatures, and they also struggled to find a way to monitor their domain’s situation without arousing her suspicion. In the end, they decided to monitor everything themselves, and some of their children helped them, such as Tian Huangjin and Tian Huotian.

Tian Yaoqin herself had heard the news from Zhang Fei, but she couldn’t tell Tian Qiye about it because her leader would be suspicious of her. She thought of another way to tell her leader, but she couldn’t find a suitable solution for it.

As planned by Feng Yao and Zhang Fei, Mo Shentian and his five subordinates were finally freed from the tunnel after being trapped there for several years. The Celestial Demon God wasted no time and immediately led all their members back to their domain, which was quite far from the tunnel’s location.

In four different tunnels, Taotie and three other evil mythical beasts were also freed, and they immediately moved quickly to return to their domains. However, their previous situation left many questions in their minds, and they attempted to contact the primordial nihility beast to discuss the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1636: Arrive At Cangxuan Domain
paragraphs: "What happened, Master? Why is your expression so serious?" Hun Tianyu asked.

Hun Lingwu sighed and explained to him the message he received from Dugu Yuanshen, which shocked Hun Tianyu. "My old friend received this news from Empress Huo and Long Wuzhao, so I’m sure it’s not false. I’ve ordered people from our sect to move and monitor the changing situation in our domain, and I’ve also sent several elders to meet with the other sects and clans. Have Hun Dian and the others still not given you any news about the Twin Flames Domain?"

"No, Master," Hun Tianyu replied with a shake of his head. "This paradise realm is too vast, and we don’t know the exact location of the Twin Flames Domain, plus we weren’t used to traveling that far in the past. They have found several other domains located close to our domain, but they are only small domains."

Hun Lingwu was furious whenever he thought of Zhang Fei, especially after everything he did to him. He lost his backup memories, causing him to forget many things, including his Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror. Before the separation of all the domains, he had already sought a way to eliminate Zhang Fei, but all his attempts failed, resulting in the deaths of the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain. He wanted to attack the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he was afraid of Feng Yao and her subordinates.
Nearly six years have passed since that day, and all the domains have been separated for several years, making it difficult for Hun Lingwu to find the location of the Twin Flames Domain.
"Tell Hun Dian and the others to continue searching for the location of that domain."
"Yes, Master."
"Mo Shentian and the four perils are free now," Feng Yao informed Zhang Fei.

"I’ve already warned Mo Zainan and Dong Xuanyin about them." Zhang Fei opened the portal to his training space. "I’ve also asked the people from the other domains to be on guard if those shadowy creatures suddenly appear, and I’ve asked them to report to us."

Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, Nalan Wangzi, and Tianshi Shengjie walked out of the training space. They had asked Zhang Fei to take them to the Ancient Realm, so his fifth clone sent them to the training space after he returned from the other domains. You Feiling wanted to join them, but he asked her to take care of their sect.
"Wow!" Nalan Wangzi exclaimed. "This is the first time I’ve seen the inside of the void."
Qing Qiu’er was the same as her, and she was quite surprised by the situation in the void. "It’s too dark in here!"
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled as she looked at the darkness in the void.

Unlike them, Tianshi Shengjie wasn’t surprised to see the situation in the void, as Long Xukong and Long Youjia had brought her inside many times. "How long will it take us to arrive at the Cangxuan Domain?"

"About a week or less," Feng Yao answered her. "You guys can join us now, but you must return to his training space when we arrive at that domain. Those creatures have invaded that domain even though it has become a barren land now because Hu Tianlang’s greed soul is stored there."
The four women agreed with that, but Luo Yunxiao spoke directly to her. "Do you think my special physique will be useful to help you two there, Big Sis Yao?

"I don’t know the abilities of those shadowy creatures myself, so I don’t know if your special physique will be useful there. If the situation there is not too dangerous, he can take you out of the training space."
"I know." Luo Yunxiao asked her again. "Does this mean you two have made up?"
Feng Yao wanted to answer Luo Yunxiao, but Zhang Fei suddenly pulled her onto his lap and kissed her, surprising them. "Do you know the answer now, Yunxiao?"
"Yeah." Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly. "I’m glad you two have reconciled like this."
Tianshi Shengjie and the others also agreed with Luo Yunxiao, but Feng Yao simply smiled and moved away from Zhang Fei’s lap.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill. "Since it will take us several days to reach that domain, I’ll swallow this pill now."
"What kind of pill is this?" Feng Yao snatched it.

"The Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill." Zhang Fei took out other pills, and he gave one to Tianshi Shengjie while explaining its effects to them. "Unfortunately, this pill is only useful for beasts, so Yunxiao and the others can’t take it. However, you can take it if you like, and the effects will be good for you. Besides, I have two new alchemy recipes, but I can’t find the ingredients in the Paradise Realm, and I think they only exist in the Ancient Realm."

"Show me those two recipes." Zhang Fei took them and gave them to Feng Yao, who immediately read them one by one. "You’re right, these ingredients only exist in the Ancient Realm. In that case, we’ll go to the Puyang Clan after you merge with Hu Tianlang’s two souls, and they might have these ingredients."
"Alright." Zhang Fei kept both pill recipes and swallowed the pill, as did Feng Yao and Tianshi Shengjie.

As soon as they swallowed it, their bodies turned bright red, and they felt lightning tribulations within them. Those lightning bolts rapidly spread throughout their bodies, tempering their flesh, bones, and meridians as if they were undergoing a miniature heavenly tribulation.
Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, and Nalan Wangzi watched them intently. Even Long Xukong, who was carrying them to the Cangxuan Domain, glanced at them repeatedly.

"Ugh!" Tianshi Shengjie grimaced at the effects occurring within her body, and she had a difficult time enduring the pain. Even her face quickly turned pale, and her body trembled strongly. ’Ugh! The effect of this pill is indeed good, but the effect is really painful.’
On the other hand, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei looked calm and normal, even though they were also feeling excruciating pain inside their bodies.

Zhang Fei hadn’t given the pill to his beast wives and their contracted beasts because he wanted to try swallowing it first. Based on the pill’s reaction, he wasn’t confident that his wives would be able to withstand the effect, but he had no choice but to give it to them, as its effects would strengthen them.

After a few hours, the effects of the pill finally wore off. Tianshi Shengjie was the first to open her eyes and lay down on Long Xukong’s back. "I’ve never felt so tortured before! The pill’s effects are amazing, but the pain is so terrible."
"Haha," Feng Yao chuckled. "No pain, no gain, right? Although the pain was quite terrible, you gained a lot of benefits from the pill. Your flesh, bones, and meridians are all strengthened now."
Tianshi Shengjie nodded and raised her right hand. "I do feel great changes in my body, and I might be able to surpass my father one day."

"Why don’t you ask him to help you?" Tianshi Shengjie tilted her head to Zhang Fei. "You’ve lived with him for two and a half decades, and you’ve been in love with him for a long time, but you still haven’t given yourself to him."

Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, and Nalan Wangzi were also confused about Tianshi Shengjie. They hoped she would become Zhang Fei’s wife soon, and they had waited so long for it, but she still hadn’t given herself to him.
Zhang Fei himself had long wanted Tianshi Shengjie to be his wife, but he never forced the female Celestial Dragon, and he chose to wait for her to give herself to him.
Tianshi Shengjie sighed. "How about we do it after you merge with Hu Tianlang’s two souls?"
"Are you really ready for that?"
"I’ve been ready for a long time, but there were some things that bothered me back then." Tianshi Shengjie sighed again. "However, I’ve put them out of my mind, and I’m ready to be your wife now."
Zhang Fei nodded. "If you are ready, we will do it after our business in the Ancient Realm is finished."
"Alright."
Time flew by, and they arrived at the Cangxuan Domain two days earlier than everyone expected. Zhang Fei sent Luo Yunxiao and several others into his training space. "Can we leave the void now?"
"Wait." Feng Yao stopped Long Xukong, and she checked the situation in the domain first. "There are too many of those shadowy creatures there, and they will attack us as soon as we leave the void."
Long Xukong looked up at her. "Could they have noticed our arrival? But how could that be possible?"
"I don’t know." Feng Yao thought of another way to get to that domain. "Fly high and open the void there! I’ll go out to that domain first, and Huo Ling will help me keep them away."
[Humph! I won’t help you! You’ll have to do it yourself if you want to bring that brat there!]
Feng Yao inwardly sighed. ’Ling’er, please don’t act like this, okay?’
[I don’t care! You care more about that brat than me, so I won’t help you with anything related to him!]
’Alright, I won’t ask for your help anymore, and I’ll handle those creatures myself.’
[Humph! As you wish!]
"Go now."

Long Xukong immediately went to the top of the domain and opened the void, allowing Feng Yao to emerge from the void. He and Zhang Fei watched her from within the void, but they were puzzled when Huo Ling didn’t appear beside her. "It seems like the eternal flame is jealous of the relationship between the two of you, kid."

Those creatures have invaded that domain even though it has become a barren land now because Hu Tianlang’s greed soul is stored there."
The four women agreed with that, but Luo Yunxiao spoke directly to her.
"Do you think my special physique will be useful to help you two there, Big Sis Yao?
"I don’t know the abilities of those shadowy creatures myself, so I don’t know if your special physique will be useful there.
If the situation there is not too dangerous, he can take you out of the training space."
"I know." Luo Yunxiao asked her again.
"Does this mean you two have made up?"
Feng Yao wanted to answer Luo Yunxiao, but Zhang Fei suddenly pulled her onto his lap and kissed her, surprising them.
"Do you know the answer now, Yunxiao?"
"Yeah." Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly.
"I’m glad you two have reconciled like this."
Tianshi Shengjie and the others also agreed with Luo Yunxiao, but Feng Yao simply smiled and moved away from Zhang Fei’s lap.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill.
"Since it will take us several days to reach that domain, I’ll swallow this pill now."
"What kind of pill is this?" Feng Yao snatched it.
"The Heaven Tribulation Beast Pill." Zhang Fei took out other pills, and he gave one to Tianshi Shengjie while explaining its effects to them.
"Unfortunately, this pill is only useful for beasts, so Yunxiao and the others can’t take it.
However, you can take it if you like, and the effects will be good for you.
Besides, I have two new alchemy recipes, but I can’t find the ingredients in the Paradise Realm, and I think they only exist in the Ancient Realm."
"Show me those two recipes." Zhang Fei took them and gave them to Feng Yao, who immediately read them one by one.
"You’re right, these ingredients only exist in the Ancient Realm.
In that case, we’ll go to the Puyang Clan after you merge with Hu Tianlang’s two souls, and they might have these ingredients."
"Alright." Zhang Fei kept both pill recipes and swallowed the pill, as did Feng Yao and Tianshi Shengjie.
As soon as they swallowed it, their bodies turned bright red, and they felt lightning tribulations within them.
Those lightning bolts rapidly spread throughout their bodies, tempering their flesh, bones, and meridians as if they were undergoing a miniature heavenly tribulation.
Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, and Nalan Wangzi watched them intently.
Even Long Xukong, who was carrying them to the Cangxuan Domain, glanced at them repeatedly.
"Ugh!" Tianshi Shengjie grimaced at the effects occurring within her body, and she had a difficult time enduring the pain.
Even her face quickly turned pale, and her body trembled strongly. ’Ugh!
The effect of this pill is indeed good, but the effect is really painful.’
On the other hand, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei looked calm and normal, even though they were also feeling excruciating pain inside their bodies.
Zhang Fei hadn’t given the pill to his beast wives and their contracted beasts because he wanted to try swallowing it first.
Based on the pill’s reaction, he wasn’t confident that his wives would be able to withstand the effect, but he had no choice but to give it to them, as its effects would strengthen them.
After a few hours, the effects of the pill finally wore off.
Tianshi Shengjie was the first to open her eyes and lay down on Long Xukong’s back.
"I’ve never felt so tortured before!
The pill’s effects are amazing, but the pain is so terrible."
"Haha," Feng Yao chuckled.
"No pain, no gain, right?
Although the pain was quite terrible, you gained a lot of benefits from the pill.
Your flesh, bones, and meridians are all strengthened now."
Tianshi Shengjie nodded and raised her right hand.
"I do feel great changes in my body, and I might be able to surpass my father one day."
"Why don’t you ask him to help you?" Tianshi Shengjie tilted her head to Zhang Fei.
"You’ve lived with him for two and a half decades, and you’ve been in love with him for a long time, but you still haven’t given yourself to him."
Luo Yunxiao, Qing Qiu’er, and Nalan Wangzi were also confused about Tianshi Shengjie.
They hoped she would become Zhang Fei’s wife soon, and they had waited so long for it, but she still hadn’t given herself to him.
Zhang Fei himself had long wanted Tianshi Shengjie to be his wife, but he never forced the female Celestial Dragon, and he chose to wait for her to give herself to him.
Tianshi Shengjie sighed.
"How about we do it after you merge with Hu Tianlang’s two souls?"
"Are you really ready for that?"
"I’ve been ready for a long time, but there were some things that bothered me back then." Tianshi Shengjie sighed again.
"However, I’ve put them out of my mind, and I’m ready to be your wife now."
Zhang Fei nodded.
"If you are ready, we will do it after our business in the Ancient Realm is finished."
"Alright."
Time flew by, and they arrived at the Cangxuan Domain two days earlier than everyone expected.
Zhang Fei sent Luo Yunxiao and several others into his training space.
"Can we leave the void now?"
"Wait." Feng Yao stopped Long Xukong, and she checked the situation in the domain first.
"There are too many of those shadowy creatures there, and they will attack us as soon as we leave the void."
Long Xukong looked up at her.
"Could they have noticed our arrival?
But how could that be possible?"
"I don’t know." Feng Yao thought of another way to get to that domain.
"Fly high and open the void there!
I’ll go out to that domain first, and Huo Ling will help me keep them away."
[Humph!
I won’t help you!
You’ll have to do it yourself if you want to bring that brat there!]
Feng Yao inwardly sighed. ’Ling’er, please don’t act like this, okay?’
[I don’t care!
You care more about that brat than me, so I won’t help you with anything related to him!]
’Alright, I won’t ask for your help anymore, and I’ll handle those creatures myself.’
[Humph!
As you wish!]
"Go now."
Long Xukong immediately went to the top of the domain and opened the void, allowing Feng Yao to emerge from the void.
He and Zhang Fei watched her from within the void, but they were puzzled when Huo Ling didn’t appear beside her.
"It seems like the eternal flame is jealous of the relationship between the two of you, kid."

chapters.title: Chapter 1637: Fighting The Shadowy Creatures
paragraphs: The moment Feng Yao emerged from the void, all the shadowy creatures in the domain immediately turned their attention to her. They quickly darted toward her after smelling her beast scent, but she immediately used her phoenix flames and forced them away from her.

Feng Yao raised her eyebrows slightly and observed the behavior of those shadowy creatures, which seemed frightened by her phoenix flames. However, she could see that her phoenix flames couldn’t hurt them and only scared them.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Eleven different flames passed by Feng Yao and shot towards those shadowy creatures, causing them to run helter-skelter to avoid those flames.
*Boom... Boom...*
Several large explosions were heard throughout the domain after all those flames plunged into the ground, causing significant destruction in every area and a large earthquake throughout the domain.

Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei, who was already in his lust demon form and activated his soul link to borrow the power of all the beasts in the beast space, including the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. "Why did you come out of the void?"
"I can’t possibly leave you alone like that jealous bitch, right?" Zhang Fei summoned the Demon Extermination Sword, and he also materialized the two female sword spirits.
Jian Guang’an released a light element, which was so bright that it illuminated their area for several miles around.
Those shadowy creatures hurriedly fled from the light and hid in dark areas.
Jian Hei’an didn’t do anything and floated behind Zhang Fei, as her darkness would disturb her sister’s light element.
Huo Ling immediately came out of Feng Yao’s body, fiercely glaring at Zhang Fei. "You-"
"Shut up!" Zhang Fei snapped at her. "I don’t care even if you are the eternal flame! You are just a fucking jealous old woman!"
Huo Ling’s face darkened until her muscles were bulging out. "How dare you!"
"What?" Zhang Fei was not afraid to face her. "You love Yao’er? You don’t deserve her! Your love is just bullshit! Your love is egoistic love!"
"You-"
"Enough!" Feng Yao snapped at them. "Stop fighting and look at those creatures!"
Huo Ling and Zhang Fei looked at the creatures, who seemed to be acting strangely. "What are they doing?"
"They’re summoning the other shadowy creatures in other domains because I can sense their movements."
"Guang’an, spread your light element further."
"Yes, Master." Jian Guang’an nodded and carried out Zhang Fei’s orders directly, forcing those shadowy creatures to move farther and farther.
Zhang Fei also summoned the four elemental spirits: Huo Yan, Huo Diqiu, and Lei. He didn’t summon the darkness spirit because he believed those shadowy creatures were immune to the darkness.
"Are they those creatures, Master?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei pointed towards the west. "The old fox’s greed soul is in that area, so we have to get rid of those shadowy creatures from that area."
"I will attack them now!" Since he was the spirit of the Earth Flame, he could use the Earth Flame within Zhang Fei’s body to attack those creatures.
Huo Yan, the fire salamander that Zhang Fei obtained at the Star Tower, immediately followed Huo Diqiu to attack the shadowy creatures.
Lei, the lightning spirit, joined them and attacked the creatures with lightning, but his lightning had no significant effect on them.
Unlike Huo Diqiu’s attacks, Huo Yan’s attacks were also too weak, and they did not have much effect on those shadowy creatures.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei didn’t obtain the complete Sky Flame; he only obtained its fragment because its spirit, Yan Huo, chose Yuan Tianling as his master in the past.
"Ling’er, please help them." Huo Ling ignored Feng Yao and re-entered her body.
"You don’t need to ask that selfish bitch for help anymore." Zhang Fei summoned all his elements and used his self-created techniques to materialize them.

A golden crow, a dark phoenix, a fire phoenix, an ice phoenix, a vermillion bird, a flame dragon, a mythical deer, an azure emperor roc, a rainbow-shelled tortoise, an azure dragon, a white tiger, and a light dragon appeared to fill the sky of the Cangxuan Domain.

Zhang Fei didn’t manifest the calamity demon dragon due to the presence of the avatars of the two primordial beasts. He didn’t want to encounter them while he was dealing with the shadowy creatures, as their appearance would only add to his troubles.

After that, Zhang Fei also used all the flames he had, such as the phoenix flame, the dragon flame, the soul flame, the sky flame, the earth flame, the blood flame, the moon flame, and the eternal flame. Their size was large enough to make the darkness covering the domain quickly dissipate.

Feng Yao smiled when she saw all that because Zhang Fei’s progress had come so far. In fact, he wouldn’t be able to use them all at once with his current cultivation, but he had already borrowed the power of all the beasts inside his beast space.

Long Xukong, who witnessed everything from within the void, was utterly shocked. He knew that Zhang Fei had always hidden his true strength and abilities, but his actions now were completely beyond his imagination.

As a mythical beast, Long Xukong knew that all the mythical beasts that Zhang Fei summoned were not real ones, and they were just manifestations of his elements. He also knew that using such a technique required high cultivation and an incredibly large amount of qi.

Zhang Fei didn’t stop there and opened a portal to the training space. Zhang Fei [4] and Zhang Fei [5] immediately walked out of it, and they used their heavenly fox abilities—the Exorcismus, which made the domain brighter and further eroded the darkness.
"I won’t believe that all these attacks won’t be able to destroy those shadow creatures," Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "Attack them!"
All the mythical beasts, all the heavenly flames, and the two halos in the sky immediately attacked the shadowy creatures, who continued to flee as the darkness in the domain continued to shrink.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
*Boom... Boom...*
Feng Yao didn’t stand idly by, and she used her phoenix flames to assist Zhang Fei, causing the entire domain to shake violently under their attacks.

Deep in the woods of the west, Hu Tianlang’s greedy soul stood atop the ten-tailed fox statue and watched as Zhang Fei’s attacks rained down on almost the entire domain, including the area outside the forest where he was located.

"Haha! That kid’s progress is truly astonishing! He can use all his high-level attacks at once with the help of his two clones! Besides, Shen Yuanzhi was also with him, and her attacks were beyond doubt. If his other three clones were here, this domain would probably be destroyed by their attacks."
Hu Tianlang looked at those shadowy creatures who were trying hard to break through the universe’s barrier created to protect the forest.

"If it weren’t for this barrier, these creatures would have reached this place some time ago, and they would have devoured this soul. Unfortunately, they were too late because that kid had already arrived in this domain, and I will be merging with him soon."

Hu Tianlang sighed. "After I merge with him, he only needs to find my envy soul and merge with it. After that, he must find my wrath soul in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, and he also has to take the hearts of those two heavenly foxes."
Zhang Fei and Feng Yao continued to attack those shadowy creatures, as did Huo Yan, Huo Diqiu, and Lei.

"We have to move into that forest now, and my two clones will attack those shadowy creatures." Feng Yao agreed with Zhang Fei, and they flew quickly towards the forest while attacking the creatures in that area.

Feng Yao looked outside the domain. "Those creatures from outside the domain are already moving here, and they’ll be here soon. Furthermore, they’ve already taken control of the bodies of the beasts and demons, so we won’t be able to deal with them that easily."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned as he looked in that direction. He decided to bring his other two clones to assist them because the number of those shadowy creatures was too great. "I think my four clones should be enough to fend them off, right?"

Feng Yao nodded. "As long as you use the soul link, I think their numbers will be sufficient. I’ll also use the universe’s barrier to protect the forest, so they won’t be able to approach you while you fuse with Hu Tianlang’s greed soul. Once you’re done, we should leave this domain directly to go to the location of his envy soul."
"How long does it take to travel to that domain? Is that domain far from this one?"
"Far enough! We need at least two weeks to get there."

"We’ll think about that later, and we have to reach the forest soon." Zhang Fei channeled his fire and light elements into the Demon Extermination Sword, swinging it towards the shadowy creatures blocking their path. "These creatures are really tough! Such a powerful attack only scratches their bodies but doesn’t kill them."

Feng Yao supported Zhang Fei and attacked them with her phoenix flames. "Do you dare imagine if they invaded the Paradise Realm? Even a cultivator as powerful as Long Wuzhao wouldn’t be able to face them, let alone the others. If they succeed in invading the Paradise Realm, it will result in significant bloodshed across all domains, and the number of victims will increase dramatically."
"We can only hope that they won’t be able to invade the Paradise Realm anytime soon."
Soon, they arrived in front of the forest, and Feng Yao opened a gap in the barrier before leading Zhang Fei inside.
"Over there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1638: Greed Soul
paragraphs: "Hahaha." Hu Tianlang laughed as soon as Zhang Fei and Feng Yao arrived. "I didn’t expect you to come so soon, kid. I thought it would be a few more years before we met, but you’re already here."

"Can we start now, old fox?" Zhang Fei impatiently asked. "My four clones and Feng Yao can hold off those shadowy creatures, but more of them will arrive in this realm soon, so we don’t have much time."

Hu Tianlang smiled at that. "You’re lucky, kid. We didn’t need long to merge our souls, but you’ll become extremely greedy once our souls merge. You won’t be able to control that feeling before you evolve into the ten-tailed fox, so you must be prepared for the risks."
"I know," Zhang Fei sighed. "Let’s start now."
After Zhang Fei transformed into his celestial fox form, Hu Tianlang’s soul immediately entered his body and fused with their souls.
At that moment, Zhang Fei felt his greed increase sharply, just like when he fused with Hu Tianlang’s other soul. "Damn it! I have to control this feeling, or I’ll cause trouble everywhere."

"As Hu Tianlang said before, you won’t be able to control your feelings before you evolve into the next ten-tailed fox." Feng Yao looked outside. "Those shadowy creatures from other domains are getting closer and closer, and their numbers are too large, so we have to leave now."
Zhang Fei nodded and a void crack opened in front of them. "Let’s go now! My clones can escape on their own."
"Alright."
After entering the void, Feng Yao directed Long Xukong towards the domain where Hu Tianlang’s envy soul was stored, and the male void dragon immediately flew at full speed.
Outside the barrier, Zhang Fei’s four clones saw that the shadowy creatures hadn’t decreased much. They wasted no time in disappearing into the training space, as more creatures would soon arrive.

Some time after they disappeared, the other shadowy creatures from the other domains arrived. One of them had a much larger body, and its aura was terrifying—even more terrifying than the two primordial beasts.
*Screech*

The core creature released a sharp and loud, furious screech, causing the other shadowy creature to cower in fear. It looked around the area before unleashing a small attack downwards, which instantly shattered the Cangxuan Domain into dust. Despite this, the core creature’s attack did not kill those smaller creatures, and they went straight to the next domain.

The avatars of both primordial beasts could sense the power of the core creature’s attack, even though their location was far from the Cangxuan Domain. Both were shocked by the event, as the power of the core creature’s attack far surpassed their own.

Even though they were primordial beasts of such a long time, they felt a sense of dread in their hearts. However, they were also relieved that their real bodies were not in the Ancient Realm, but in the Primordial Realm.

Even so, the two primordial beasts were afraid that the core creatures and those shadowy creatures might go to the Primordial Realm, and they were afraid that they would not be able to do anything to stop them.
After thinking for a long time, the two primordial beasts decided to disappear from both domains and return to their original bodies.
Inside the void, Zhang Fei tried hard to suppress his overflowing greed as his soul was in the process of merging with Hu Tianlang’s. "Shit! This feeling is harder to control than my lust."
"Bear it for now." Feng Yao looked back. "The core creature seemed to have appeared there after we left, and the domain is now destroyed."
"What?" Long Xukong screamed. "Is the domain really destroyed, Empress Huo?"

Feng Yao nodded slightly. "The power of the core creature is truly terrifying! It only used a small attack, but it has already reduced the domain to dust. Fortunately, no living creatures lived there; otherwise, the number of casualties would be countless."
"What if that creature invades the Paradise Realm?"
Feng Yao sighed. "No one will be able to stop it, and mass destruction will occur there."

Long Xukong shivered at the thought because the population of all the domains in the Paradise Realm was so large. He didn’t dare to imagine if the core creature appeared there, which would cause mass death and the destruction of all domains.
"Do you think the core creature will make it to the Paradise Realm one day?"

Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei. "I don’t dare say whether the core creature can go to the Paradise Realm or not, as I myself have no information on its true strength. Judging from its attack just now, its power far surpasses mine and all the Primordials. You can’t sense it, but I can sense that the two avatars of the two Primordial Beasts immediately disappeared from this realm after destroying the Cangxuan Domain."

"Even the two primordial beasts are afraid of the core creature, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself while frowning. "Do you think I can defeat and kill the core creature after I evolve into the ten-tailed fox?"

"I don’t have an answer to your question." Feng Yao hugged her legs. "This is the first time in my life that I’ve felt so helpless because the core creature is too powerful, making me lose all confidence."

Zhang Fei hugged her. "I’m as worried as you are, but I’m sure we’ll find a solution to combat the core creature. For now, we don’t need to think too much about it, and we will together find a solution to deal with that creature after I evolve into the ten-tailed fox."

"Sigh." Feng Yao leaned against his chest. "What if we can’t find a solution? What if you can’t defeat the core creature after you evolve into the ten-tailed fox? I manifested myself in the past to seek my freedom, but I never expected that my actions would bring such a great disaster to this universe and all its inhabitants."

Zhang Fei hugged her tighter. "It’s okay; everyone makes mistakes, including us. Everything has already happened and we won’t be able to turn back time, so there’s no point in regretting it. By the way, the mysterious man told me that the possessors of the Immortal Sacred Physique, the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique, the Universe Tree Physique, and the Heavenly Calamity Physique are in the Ancient Realm, so I think you can start looking for them."
"Huh?" Feng Yao looked up at him. "Is that true?"
"The mysterious man told me that, but he didn’t tell me their locations, so we’ll have to look for them ourselves."

paragraphs: Zhang Fei lay on Long Xukong’s back with his head on Feng Yao’s lap. "How do you feel?"

"Not good, but not bad either." Zhang Fei pulled her head closer and kissed her. "Of all the old fox’s souls, his greed soul is the most troublesome so far. I felt a strong urge to obtain many things because of my greed. When I fused with his lust soul, I had no problem controlling it because I already had several women at the time. His pride soul made me quite arrogant for a while, but I managed to control it. You accompanied me when I fused with his sloth and gluttony souls, so you should still remember what happened to me at that time."

Feng Yao smiled and rubbed his forehead. "Once you fuse with his wrath soul and obtain the hearts of the two heavenly foxes, you will evolve into the next ten-tailed fox. At that time, you will be able to control all your emotions, and you will also be able to freely control yin and yang."

"You know that I don’t want any of that, right?" Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei. "I just want a calm and peaceful life for everyone close to me, but I realize that I can’t make that happen without strength, and evolving into the ten-tailed fox will give me the power to make that happen. At that time, I will take care of all the dangers that threaten this universe, and I will destroy them if necessary so they can live peacefully in the future."
"Actually, you can make that happen easily, and—"

"I know," Zhang Fei cut her words. "However, we were born and raised in this universe, and life would be different if they lived in my soul world. Speaking of my soul world, have you ever thought that this universe is a collection of people’s soul worlds?"
Feng Yao replied with a light shake of her head. "I’ve thought that in the past, but I’ve thrown that thought away because I’ve found proof that this universe is independent."
"What proof?"

"You." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "As I said before, you are the only living being in this universe who possesses a soul world, and no other living being has possessed one before you, so I am certain that this universe is independent. I don’t know how that little girl acquired such a technique, but I heard that her father defeated the core of her universe and took over its position as its core."
Zhang Fei looked at her in disbelief. "Have you really ever met that young girl?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "She was watching you through that thing, and she brought her mother to see me a few months after I returned to the Paradise Realm. You don’t need to ask about her whereabouts because I can’t track her, which is because she’s not part of this universe."
"How did she and her mother get to our universe? What is their purpose in coming here?"

"She built a flying artifact that could penetrate space, and she created it based on her father’s artifact." Feng Yao told Zhang Fei about her meeting with Xuanyuan Yue and her mother several years ago. After that, she shared pictures of the two women with him. "Her mother’s name is Xuanyuan Xue’er, but I don’t know her father’s identity because they didn’t mention it."
"Xuanyuan Yue, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "Do you think we can go to her universe?"

Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "So far, there are no flying artifacts in our universe that can penetrate space like that girl’s, so I can confirm that we won’t be able to. However, things might change in the future if people discover a method to create flying artifacts similar to hers, and we might be able to do it then."
"Did she tell you about the number of other universes out there?"

"She only said there were many other universes, but she didn’t specify the number. She’s been to all of them to find a way to free her father, but no one from those universes can go to other universes."

Zhang Fei thought for a moment. "Then, what about the mysterious man’s real body? He said that his real body accidentally created this universe, so I’m sure he also accidentally created her universe."

"I haven’t met his real body, so I can’t answer that question. As for him, he represents the will of his real body, which was accidentally left behind during the creation of this universe. His job is to maintain the balance of this universe, or it will be destroyed if that balance is lost."
"Phew," Zhang Fei exhaled softly. "In the past, I was just an ordinary human, and my life completely changed after that young girl accidentally killed me and brought me back to life."
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "That young girl isn’t really young, you know? She may look young, but she’s an old monster, and I’m not confident that I could defeat her if we were to fight."

Zhang Fei frowned for a moment before taking out two pills, which were the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill. "She gave me these two pills, so it’s not surprising that she’s that young."

"Haha," Feng Yao took the two pills from his hand. "Cultivators in our universe have created similar pills, but their effects will never be the same as these two. Their effects are only temporary, and they will disappear in ten years, but these two pills have permanent effects."

"Hey." They looked at Long Xukong, who had been listening to their conversation. He was shocked to hear about other universes, Xuanyuan Xue, Xuanyuan Xue’er, and the others. However, he didn’t ask anything and listened to them silently, but Zhang Fei’s two pills piqued his curiosity. "What are the effects of those two pills?"

"Open your mouth." After Long Xukong opened his mouth, Feng Yao threw the two pills into his mouth, and he immediately swallowed them. "You can see your physical changes later. Can you speed up your flying speed again?"
"I’m not a monster like you two, and this is my maximum speed."
"You can continue flying at this speed, but don’t open the exit when we arrive at the domain. I’m afraid the core creature is waiting for us there, and we have no chance of winning against it."
Long Xukong nodded to Feng Yao, as he himself was terrified of the creature that could destroy a domain with one small attack.
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei, who kept staring at her. "What are you thinking?"
"Eat you." Feng Yao smiled upon hearing that. "Hey! You’re the core of this universe; doesn’t that mean I’m fucking this universe if I fuck you?"
[Shameless pervert!]
’I want to fuck you too, Mei!’
[Keep dreaming!] Mei herself felt relieved after she learned the identity of her creator, and she hoped that Zhang Fei would meet Xuanyuan Xue one day.

Feng Yao smiled amusedly at his question. "Although I am the core of this universe, I am also a separate being from it, so we are different at the same time."
"Really?"

The people on my side don’t have elemental body techniques, and they only learn ordinary body techniques, so I have no interest in them."
"I see." She rested her head on his chest.
"I think you can meet someone from the Puyang Clan, and one of them should have the wind or light elemental body techniques."
He raised an eyebrow for a moment.
"I’d like to go to the Puyang Clan, but I’ll focus on meeting the old fox’s envy soul first.
After his soul merges with mine, and the situation permits, we’ll go to that clan."
"If you successfully obtain and master those elemental body techniques, your body will become too strong, and all your women will never be able to satisfy you again."

"Even if my body becomes even stronger, I am still not capable of defeating that core creator or those shadowy creatures, so I have to think of a way to defeat them." He fell into deep thought, mulling over several things.
"What do you think if I clear out all those demon races after I evolve into the ten-tailed fox?"
She looked up at him again.
"Do you want to attack them?"
"Yes." He nodded.
"Five of the ten demon races are already on my side, but the other five are still difficult.
I am confident to face Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu, but I am not confident to fight with Shang Zhanluo.
However, what scares me the most is Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, especially the latter."
"Are you really going to hand Mo Shentian over to Mo Tianshen?" He didn’t have an answer for that.
"Mo Tianshen has inherited the power of the previous Celestial Demon God, but his power is no longer the same because his brother has inherited most of it, so he will never be able to defeat him."
"That’s true," Then, he asked her.
"Which one between Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu should I face first?"
"Ku Shenzu."
"Why?"
"Ku Shenzu is weaker than Sha Mo, and he always relies on his torture techniques to fight his enemies.
Your speed is much higher than his, so you should be able to dodge his abilities easily."
"Do you think I can defeat Ku Shenzu with my current cultivation?
Or should I wait to evolve into the ten-tailed fox first?"
"Hmm?" She calculated everything first before answering him.
"Normally, you won’t be able to defeat him with your current strength, especially since he’s a demon god.
However, you have five clones and speed, so I think you can fight him using all of that.
Besides, you have several demon gods by your side, and three of them are already training in your training space, so they should be able to help you deal with him.
I know you want to defeat him with your strength, but you can’t always use force against some of your enemies, so you should ask your allies for help like you did in the past."
"The past, huh?" He muttered to himself, recalling all the events, especially when they faced those heretics in the Sky Jade Realm.
Back then, his strength was far weaker than those heretics, and he gathered all the powerful cultivators in the realm to fight them, which ended in their victory.
"You’re right, I can’t rely on myself forever, and I often need the help of my allies to deal with certain things.
In that case, I will send my clones to meet them, and I will go to the Torture Demon Race Domain after we return from this realm."
"I think it’s good."
"As for Sha Mo, I will use his children and grand elders to deal with him, but I will do so after I defeat Ku Shenzu."
"Hey!" They suddenly heard Long Xukong calling, so they hurriedly got dressed before removing the barrier.
"Have you two noticed something strange happening in this universe?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1642: Meet Xuanyuan Yue
paragraphs: "What do you mean, Senior Xukong?"
Long Xukong stopped flying and brought his dragon head before them. "Even though I can’t see or spy on your activities because of the barrier, I’m aware that you’re both doing that within it."
"Haha," Zhang Fei scratched the back of his head. "So, what happened before?"
Long Xukong sighed. "You already know Empress Huo’s true identity, but you still ask about it, kid."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei folded his forehead.

"Your previous activities affected this universe." Zhang Fei and Feng Yao were both confused by this. "Hey! She is the embodiment of this universe’s core, so this universe should be tied to her, right?"
Feng Yao nodded at him. "This universe is tied to me. If I die, this universe will die, and vice versa."
"See?" Long Xukong shook his head. "This void shook violently when you were both inside that barrier, and everyone in the Paradise Realm experienced the same thing, causing panic everywhere."

[Hahaha!] Mei suddenly laughed. [It seems that my earlier guess was correct, Master. This universe experienced everything that Feng Yao did, mainly because she was the embodiment of this universe’s core. She and the core are one, and this universe is no different from her body, so this universe experiences such a situation because of your intimate activities.]
Zhang Fei’s jaw dropped, speechless. "This-"

Feng Yao nodded in understanding after realizing the situation. "I’ve never thought about that before, but I couldn’t care less about it. All living beings in this universe can enjoy themselves with their partners, so why can’t I do the same with the man I love?"

"Haish," Long Xukong hissed. "Empress Huo, I’m not saying that you can’t do the same with other people, but at the very least, you should think of a way so that your activities won’t affect everyone. I couldn’t hear or see anything, but the strong tremor made me aware that your activities are affecting this universe. Mass panic erupted in the Paradise Realm, leading people to believe that this universe was on the brink of destruction."
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei. "Did your clone experience that incident?"

"It first happened a few days ago, but I didn’t expect such a strong tremor to be caused by our activities," Zhang Fei sighed. "We haven’t dual-cultivated yet, but the tremor was really strong, and it only got stronger when we did it just now."
*Swoosh*
A qi screen suddenly shot out from Zhang Fei’s body, shocking the three of them. They were even more shocked when Xuanyuan Yue appeared on the screen.

"Hehehe! Honestly, I didn’t want to appear in front of you because our meeting could result in many things to this universe. By the way, I haven’t apologized to you for accidentally killing you in the past, Zhang Fei."

Long Xukong already knew that Zhang Fei had died, but no one knew the cause of his death or the mastermind, except for those closest to him. He didn’t expect that the person who accidentally killed him was a young girl.

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "You must be Xuanyuan Yue, right? Even though you killed me in the past, you’ve already repaid your mistake by giving me many things that have helped me come this far."

"My name is Xuanyuan Yue, but I appear now not to talk about myself." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Feng Yao is the embodiment of this universe’s core, and everything she experiences will resonate throughout it. If you want to temporarily sever her connection to this universe, you must bring her into your soul world. You two can do whatever you want there, and your activities will not affect this universe because your soul world is separate from it."
"Is that true?"

"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue nodded. "In the past, my mother and her sisters faced the same problem, especially when they spent time with my father. My father thought hard to find a way to deal with it, and he created the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art after pondering it for hundreds of years. After he created the technique, they could gather freely without thinking about the situation outside."
"Does that mean you and all your family have soul worlds?"

Xuanyuan Yue shook her head. "My father is the only person who can create a soul world, Zhang Fei. My mother, her sisters, and my siblings also learned that technique, but our soul powers are not comparable to my father’s, so we never succeeded in creating our own soul worlds. In this universe, you are the only person who can create one because of all your advantages, and you may be able to reach the final stage in the future."
"The final stage is to form a soul universe, right? Has your father reached that stage?"

"Hehe," Xuanyuan Yue chuckled. "My father is the creator of that technique, and his soul power is unrivaled by anyone, so he reached the final stage a long time ago. However, he would rather not take care of so many worlds, so he didn’t use the final technique, and he only used his soul world to gather with all my mothers. By the way, I’ve said too much, so I have to go now. If you want to spend time with Feng Yao, you must bring her to your soul world, or your universe will always be affected by your activities."
"Wait!" Zhang Fei was disappointed that Xuanyuan Yue immediately disappeared because he still had other questions for her.
"Hey, kid! Who’s that woman? Where did she come from? What does she mean by a soul world?" Long Xukong asked.

"Little Dragon, you don’t need to know that woman’s identity or origins," Long Xukong grumbled to himself after hearing Feng Yao’s statement. "As for Zhang Fei’s soul world, I think he can take you there so you can see it for yourself."
"Bring me there, kid!" Long Xukong impatiently shouted.
Zhang Fei sighed before bringing Long Xukong and Feng Yao into his soul world.
"Fuck! This world actually exists!" Long Xukong screamed as he looked around. "Is this really your soul world?"

"The process wasn’t simple, and I started creating it when my cultivation broke through to the Soul Realm. My soul slowly turned into a soul mark, and the mark evolved into a soul sea, which continued to turn into this soul world." Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao. "Can you feel your connection with our universe?"
Feng Yao nodded to him. "When I first entered your soul world, I never thought about that. I could still feel my connection with our universe, but it became faint."
"So, it’s true, huh?" Zhang Fei mumbled with a perverted grin. "If that’s the case, I’ll bring you in here often, and we can spend time together without disturbing the people in our universe."
"Are you only thinking about having sex with me?"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled and hugged her. "I’ve waited a long time to get you, so I won’t waste the time we have."
Feng Yao cupped his face and kissed him. "Alright, I’ll stay with you as long as you want."
"Can you guys stop being lovey-dovey in front of me?" They chuckled. "So, are there people living in your soul world?"
"There are several people here, and they are helping me develop my soul world." Zhang Fei immediately contacted those people and asked them to meet him.
Soon, Beiming Youhuang, Jia Xianzu, Tian Taiyang, and Yin Yue came to meet them.
"Oh? I didn’t expect you two to live here, You Huang and Jia Xianzu." Long Xukong looked at Tian Taiyang and Yin Yue. "Who are these two?"

"The man is Tian Taiyang, a member of the Golden Sun Clan, and his clan is the owner of the Zenith Sun Sanctum. The woman is Yin Yue, the leader of the Silver Moon Clan, and her clan is the owner of the Endless Night Dungeon." Long Xukong had entered both dungeons several times, but he never knew about the two people in front of him. "Their clans and domains were part of the Ancient Realm in the past, but a past catastrophe destroyed them, and they appeared in my domain as two different dungeons."
"Did something happen outside?" Beiming Youhuang asked.

"Nothing happened in the Paradise Realm, but something terrible happened in the Ancient Realm." Before Tian Taiyang and Yin Yue could ask, Zhang Fei had already created a qi screen showing those shadowy creatures. He explained the nature of those creatures to them, which left them in shock. "They are too powerful, and no one can defeat them, including Feng Yao and Emperor Long. Right now, I am in the Ancient Realm, and I am on my way to a domain to meet one of the old fox’s souls."
"Where did they come from, Zhang Fei?"

"They emerged from the core of this universe." Yin Yue and the others looked at Zhang Fei in confusion. "I can’t explain to you all about the origin of those creatures because I don’t know the details, and we are looking for a way to defeat them so that this universe can be safe again. By the way, I will take the two of them out now because we have no time to waste, and we must arrive at that domain as soon as possible."
After the three of them disappeared, Jia Xianzu let out a soft sigh. "It seems our universe will never be at peace, and this soul world is much more peaceful without the slightest disturbance."
"However, you forgot that this soul world will be destroyed if anything happens to that kid, Old Xianzu."
"Let’s hope nothing bad ever happens to him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1643: With Five Demon Gods
paragraphs: Inside the void, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei sat side by side on Long Xukong’s back as he flew at full speed to the next domain. "Have you given those Heaven Tribulation Beast Pills to all your beast wives and beast bloodline owners?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "After I used the pills and experienced their benefits, I immediately distributed them to them. Many of them are beasts, demon beasts, and owners of beast bloodlines, so those pills are very beneficial for them."
"Since we still need a long time to arrive at the next domain, you can bring them out here."
"Alright." Zhang Fei opened the portal to his training space, and several women came out of it, especially those who had already challenged the tower.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was in Qi Qingxiu’s palace along with several other demon gods, such as Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Wu Mian, Ye Futian, Jiu Moze, and Jiu Mozu.
Qi Qingxiu and the others were shocked when Zhang Fei [5] informed them that he would start attacking the other demon races soon, and his first target would be the Torture Demon Race.
"Are you serious about that, kid?" Wu Mian asked with a solemn expression.

Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "Senior Wu, I already told you about the situation regarding those shadowy creatures, right? Feng Yao, I, and my four clones have already fought against them in the Cangxuan Domain, so I am familiar with their strength. Besides, the core creature is much more powerful than the others, and it blew up the domain with just a small attack after we left."
"Is that true, master?"

"Do you think you would make up a story about a serious matter like this?" Jiu Mozu shut his mouth tightly as Zhang Fei [5] glared fiercely at him. "Honestly, I still don’t want to deal with the other demon gods because my strength is not enough to fight against them, but Feng Yao made me realize something, so I decided to attack them starting from Ku Shenzu."
"What did you realize, kid?" Ye Futian asked him.

"In the past, I was also confident in my strength, but I never forgot my allies, and they have always helped me in various matters, including fighting those heretics." Zhang Fei [5] created several qi screens that displayed his battles with cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm and the Xianjin Realm, allowing them to see everything themselves. "However, I changed after my cultivation reached the Seven Divine Realms, and I changed even more after my cultivation reached the Five Celestial Realms. My strength could reach your level if I used some of my advantages, and I believed I could handle everything on my own, which led me to neglect my allies. Feng Yao’s words made me realize that I had neglected something important, which was my allies. No matter how strong I am, I still need the help of my allies to handle some things that are beyond my control, such as fighting the other demon gods."

"Hehe." Qi Qingxiu moved to his lap and wrapped her arms around his neck. "You finally realized it, huh? Honestly, I’ve been wanting to talk to you about this matter for a long time, but I saw that you were so confident in your abilities and advantages. I thought you wouldn’t listen to me, so I chose to keep quiet and wait for you to realize everything on your own."

"You’re right, I’m overconfident about myself." Zhang Fei [5] sighed and hugged her waist. "Even though I don’t want to admit it, the appearance of those shadowy creatures puts a lot of pressure on me, and I realize I need the help of my allies to deal with them. The situation in this Paradise Realm is still safe, but I’m worried that they will invade here one day in the future, so we have to do something to prevent that. However, some humans and some other races have different views than me, and many of them want to disrupt the current peace. As long as they are not united and are still considering invading other domains, we will never be ready to face those creatures. Therefore, we have to do something about them, and we will start from Ku Shenzu and his Torture Demon Race."
"When will we move?" Nalan Shizhe asked.

Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "Originally, I planned to wait for my real body to return from the Ancient Realm, but I think we are enough to deal with Ku Shenzu. If our numbers are not enough, I will ask for help from others to attack him."
"Are you referring to Long Wuzhao and the beast race?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Ye Mingran. "If Emperor Long and my father-in-law are willing to help us, I think we will be able to defeat them much more easily, and they won’t be able to fight back."

"That’s true," Qi Qingxiu agreed. "Even though I am a demon god, and my cultivation is on par with Emperor Long and Tianshi Bailong, I still have to admit that they are still stronger than me. Even after I trained with you for decades, I still have no confidence in defeating them, so they are your strongest supporters. Is Empress Huo not willing to help you?"

"Feng Yao would definitely help me if she were here, but she’s currently in the Ancient Realm with my real body and Long Xukong. Those creatures are after the old fox’s greed soul, and it will take us about two weeks to reach the next domain, so we can’t return to this realm yet."
Then, Wu Mian spoke to him. "Since you plan to attack Ku Shenzu, I’ll use my other body there to assess the situation, and I’ll inform you all later."

"That’s good," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I don’t know how many grand elders there are in the Torture Demon Race, but I’m sure that Ku Yin and Ku Shan haven’t arrived at their domain because they left the Glazed Heaven Domain about three weeks ago."

"Master," Zhang Fei [5] looked at Jiu Moze. "The Torture Demon Race has five grand elders, and the other three are much stronger than Ku Shan and Ku Yin. Two of them are assigned to protect his wife, and the last one always stays by his side."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly. "I’ve seen Ku Shan and Ku Yin’s abilities, and the two of them were able to force Jian Kuang and the others to retreat."

"Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng are indeed strong, but the three of them won’t be able to defeat those grand elders. The strongest among the five is Ku Cang, who is also Ku Shenzu’s uncle."
"Oh? How strong is Ku Cang?"
"Ku Cang is second only to Ku Shan."
"Can you handle Ku Cang?"
Jiu Moze patted his chest with his fist. "Leave him to me, Master. I’ve fought him and defeated him before, so I’m confident I can defeat him again this time."
"Master, I will face Ku Yanji and Ku Xian." Jiu Mozu said.
Ye Futian looked at Jiu Mozu for a moment. "I will help him face them both, and I’m confident we can defeat them."
Ye Mingran looked at Nalan Shizhe for a moment. "The two of us will face Ku Yin and Ku Shan."
"Tch." Qi Qingxiu clicked her teeth. "In that case, I will face Ku Shenzu’s wife, Ku Biyun."
Wu Mian thought for a moment before speaking. "Kid, I think it’s time you brought out my true body, and I’ll help you deal with Ku Shenzu."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yeah."
"Okay." Zhang Fei [5] entered his soul world and brought out the coffin containing Wu Mian’s real body. "Here."

"Haha." Wu Mian laughed as he walked toward the coffin. He quickly opened the lid and returned to his real body, leaving his previous body slumped on the floor. He immediately jumped out of the coffin and clenched his fists. "Back then, I hid my real body in the lower realm because those demon gods were targeting me, especially Mo Shentian. I wouldn’t be able to defeat him due to his abilities to bend reality, and things would be dire if my real body fell into his hands. However, his Celestial Demon Domain is located far from my domain now, so I don’t need to worry about him anymore."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "For now, I want you to check the situation in the Torture Demon Race Domain, and we will leave for that domain when the situation allows."
"Alright." Wu Mian put away the coffin and sat back down. "I will use my body in that domain now."
"Are your other clones already in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, husband?"
"My fourth clone is meeting with Long Wuzhao and my father-in-law right now."
"Are you sure you want to do that, kid?"

Zhang Fei [4] sighed. "Father-in-law, this Paradise Realm is too vast, and we won’t be able to monitor all the domains ourselves, so we have no choice but to unite the many races. Among all the races, the most difficult ones are the demon race and the winged race because they have their own ambitions."
"I agree with you." Long Wuzhao nodded. "So, when are you going to attack the Ku Shenzu? What about the winged race?"

"Wu Mian is monitoring the situation in the Torture Demon Race Domain, and we will depart after he returns." Zhang Fei [4] thought about the winged race, but he had no solution regarding that race. "What do you think about the winged race, Emperor Long?"
