"After I used the pills and experienced their benefits, I immediately distributed them to them.
Many of them are beasts, demon beasts, and owners of beast bloodlines, so those pills are very beneficial for them."
"Since we still need a long time to arrive at the next domain, you can bring them out here."
"Alright." Zhang Fei opened the portal to his training space, and several women came out of it, especially those who had already challenged the tower.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was in Qi Qingxiu’s palace along with several other demon gods, such as Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Wu Mian, Ye Futian, Jiu Moze, and Jiu Mozu.
Qi Qingxiu and the others were shocked when Zhang Fei [5] informed them that he would start attacking the other demon races soon, and his first target would be the Torture Demon Race.
"Are you serious about that, kid?" Wu Mian asked with a solemn expression.
Zhang Fei [5] sighed.
"Senior Wu, I already told you about the situation regarding those shadowy creatures, right?
Feng Yao, I, and my four clones have already fought against them in the Cangxuan Domain, so I am familiar with their strength.
Besides, the core creature is much more powerful than the others, and it blew up the domain with just a small attack after we left."
"Is that true, master?"
"Do you think you would make up a story about a serious matter like this?" Jiu Mozu shut his mouth tightly as Zhang Fei [5] glared fiercely at him.

"Honestly, I still don’t want to deal with the other demon gods because my strength is not enough to fight against them, but Feng Yao made me realize something, so I decided to attack them starting from Ku Shenzu."
"What did you realize, kid?" Ye Futian asked him.

"In the past, I was also confident in my strength, but I never forgot my allies, and they have always helped me in various matters, including fighting those heretics." Zhang Fei [5] created several qi screens that displayed his battles with cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm and the Xianjin Realm, allowing them to see everything themselves.
"However, I changed after my cultivation reached the Seven Divine Realms, and I changed even more after my cultivation reached the Five Celestial Realms.
My strength could reach your level if I used some of my advantages, and I believed I could handle everything on my own, which led me to neglect my allies.
Feng Yao’s words made me realize that I had neglected something important, which was my allies.
No matter how strong I am, I still need the help of my allies to handle some things that are beyond my control, such as fighting the other demon gods."
"Hehe." Qi Qingxiu moved to his lap and wrapped her arms around his neck.
"You finally realized it, huh?
Honestly, I’ve been wanting to talk to you about this matter for a long time, but I saw that you were so confident in your abilities and advantages.
I thought you wouldn’t listen to me, so I chose to keep quiet and wait for you to realize everything on your own."
"You’re right, I’m overconfident about myself." Zhang Fei [5] sighed and hugged her waist.
"Even though I don’t want to admit it, the appearance of those shadowy creatures puts a lot of pressure on me, and I realize I need the help of my allies to deal with them.
The situation in this Paradise Realm is still safe, but I’m worried that they will invade here one day in the future, so we have to do something to prevent that.
However, some humans and some other races have different views than me, and many of them want to disrupt the current peace.
As long as they are not united and are still considering invading other domains, we will never be ready to face those creatures.
Therefore, we have to do something about them, and we will start from Ku Shenzu and his Torture Demon Race."
"When will we move?" Nalan Shizhe asked.
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment.
"Originally, I planned to wait for my real body to return from the Ancient Realm, but I think we are enough to deal with Ku Shenzu.
If our numbers are not enough, I will ask for help from others to attack him."
"Are you referring to Long Wuzhao and the beast race?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Ye Mingran.
"If Emperor Long and my father-in-law are willing to help us, I think we will be able to defeat them much more easily, and they won’t be able to fight back."
"That’s true," Qi Qingxiu agreed.
"Even though I am a demon god, and my cultivation is on par with Emperor Long and Tianshi Bailong, I still have to admit that they are still stronger than me.
Even after I trained with you for decades, I still have no confidence in defeating them, so they are your strongest supporters.
Is Empress Huo not willing to help you?"
"Feng Yao would definitely help me if she were here, but she’s currently in the Ancient Realm with my real body and Long Xukong.
Those creatures are after the old fox’s greed soul, and it will take us about two weeks to reach the next domain, so we can’t return to this realm yet."
Then, Wu Mian spoke to him.
"Since you plan to attack Ku Shenzu, I’ll use my other body there to assess the situation, and I’ll inform you all later."
"That’s good," Zhang Fei [5] nodded.

"I don’t know how many grand elders there are in the Torture Demon Race, but I’m sure that Ku Yin and Ku Shan haven’t arrived at their domain because they left the Glazed Heaven Domain about three weeks ago."
"Master," Zhang Fei [5] looked at Jiu Moze.
"The Torture Demon Race has five grand elders, and the other three are much stronger than Ku Shan and Ku Yin.
Two of them are assigned to protect his wife, and the last one always stays by his side."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly.
"I’ve seen Ku Shan and Ku Yin’s abilities, and the two of them were able to force Jian Kuang and the others to retreat."
"Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng are indeed strong, but the three of them won’t be able to defeat those grand elders.
The strongest among the five is Ku Cang, who is also Ku Shenzu’s uncle."
"Oh?
How strong is Ku Cang?"
"Ku Cang is second only to Ku Shan."
"Can you handle Ku Cang?"
Jiu Moze patted his chest with his fist.
"Leave him to me, Master.
I’ve fought him and defeated him before, so I’m confident I can defeat him again this time."
"Master, I will face Ku Yanji and Ku Xian." Jiu Mozu said.
Ye Futian looked at Jiu Mozu for a moment.
"I will help him face them both, and I’m confident we can defeat them."
Ye Mingran looked at Nalan Shizhe for a moment.
"The two of us will face Ku Yin and Ku Shan."
"Tch." Qi Qingxiu clicked her teeth.
"In that case, I will face Ku Shenzu’s wife, Ku Biyun."
Wu Mian thought for a moment before speaking.
"Kid, I think it’s time you brought out my true body, and I’ll help you deal with Ku Shenzu."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yeah."
"Okay." Zhang Fei [5] entered his soul world and brought out the coffin containing Wu Mian’s real body.
"Here."
"Haha." Wu Mian laughed as he walked toward the coffin.
He quickly opened the lid and returned to his real body, leaving his previous body slumped on the floor.
He immediately jumped out of the coffin and clenched his fists.
"Back then, I hid my real body in the lower realm because those demon gods were targeting me, especially Mo Shentian.
I wouldn’t be able to defeat him due to his abilities to bend reality, and things would be dire if my real body fell into his hands.
However, his Celestial Demon Domain is located far from my domain now, so I don’t need to worry about him anymore."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him.
"For now, I want you to check the situation in the Torture Demon Race Domain, and we will leave for that domain when the situation allows."
"Alright." Wu Mian put away the coffin and sat back down.
"I will use my body in that domain now."
"Are your other clones already in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, husband?"
"My fourth clone is meeting with Long Wuzhao and my father-in-law right now."
"Are you sure you want to do that, kid?"
Zhang Fei [4] sighed.
"Father-in-law, this Paradise Realm is too vast, and we won’t be able to monitor all the domains ourselves, so we have no choice but to unite the many races.
Among all the races, the most difficult ones are the demon race and the winged race because they have their own ambitions."
"I agree with you." Long Wuzhao nodded.
"So, when are you going to attack the Ku Shenzu?
What about the winged race?"
"Wu Mian is monitoring the situation in the Torture Demon Race Domain, and we will depart after he returns." Zhang Fei [4] thought about the winged race, but he had no solution regarding that race.
"What do you think about the winged race, Emperor Long?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1644: Situation
paragraphs: "Are you considering attacking the winged race?"

Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Long Wuzhao. "As you probably already know, Ye Mingran is my wife now, and I heard that Tian Qiye is targeting her and her demon race because of the actions of her past ancestors. Besides, one of my wives, Xu Ling’er, is the reincarnation of Tian Huangjin."

"Hahaha," Long Wuzhao laughed heartily after hearing that. "You’re truly crazy, kid. Two of the three female gods are your wives, and only one remains. Are you going to take Nalan Shizhe as your wife too?"

Zhang Fei [4] shrugged helplessly. He actually wanted Nalan Shizhe as his wife, but his mother-in-law was clearly not keen on the idea, and she chose to avoid him after the incident a few years ago, especially when Qi Qingxiu brought her to his room while he was dual cultivating with Ye Mingran.
Tianshi Bailong massaged his forehead, as he still regretted his daughter’s decision to choose Zhang Fei as her husband, especially since he had too many wives by his side.
"Back to the topic! Do you have a way to conquer the winged race?"
"Shouldn’t you be able to do that yourself?" Long Wuzhao turned the question around.

Zhang Fei [4] sighed. "I have quite a few supporters within the winged race, and three of them are Tian Qiye’s closest people. However, I don’t have clear information about her abilities, and her strength is on par with yours. If I attack the winged race myself, it would be no different from courting death."

"Honestly, I don’t know the depth of Tian Qiye’s strength because no member of the Winged Race has ever reached his current level." Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow. "As far as I know, the last person to ever reach her level and surpass it was Tian Huangjin, and no one from her race has ever reached that level after her. If you want to fight her, I suggest you find someone and ask for his help."
"Who?"

"Long Hei." Long Wuzhao created a qi screen, where Zhang Fei [4] saw a giant black dragon with six horns on its head. "He is the darkness dragon, and his darkness element is the eternal enemy of Tian Qiye’s light element. In fact, he fought with her in the past, and he managed to defeat her after a fierce battle for several months. Since then, he closed himself in his cave, and he has never come out to this day, but I don’t know the exact reason."

Tianshi Bailong then said to him. "Long Hei’s strength and beast rank are on par with the two of us now, so he should be able to help you fight Tian Qiye. If I were to fight that woman, our abilities wouldn’t work against each other since we’re both light element users. However, I don’t know whether he will be willing to help you fight her or not, so you have to persuade him yourself."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his chin as he observed Long Hei’s image. "Sigh! I’ll think about Tian Qiye later, and I’ll focus on the demon race first. Five demon races are already on my side, but the other five demon races are still not. I’m confident against the other two, but I’m hesitant to fight Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, and Qian Yan."
"Shouldn’t Mo Shentian still be trapped in the tunnel?"

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head. "Mo Shentian was freed from the tunnel a few days ago, and he’s on his way back to his domain. That core creature is simply too powerful, and none of us can fight it, including Feng Yao. In fact, it can destroy a domain in the Ancient Realm with just one small attack, and the two avatars of the two primordial beasts fled because of its appearance, so you should be able to imagine its power, right? Therefore, the will of this universe decided to free him and the four perils from the tunnel so they can protect their domains from those creatures."

They had already heard about the core creature from Long Xukong, so Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong were no longer surprised to hear it. "By the way, do you know what caused the great tremor in the universe earlier?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [4] laughed awkwardly at the question, but he had no intention of telling Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong the truth. "Let’s forget about that matter! It won’t happen again in the future, so we don’t need to discuss it, and we should focus on the main problem at hand."
’He’s the cause of the tremors!’ The two male dragons screamed in their hearts.
Then, Long Wuzhao asked him, "Do you need our help to fight Ku Shenzu?"
"I think we can handle him, but I hope you two will be prepared to assist us if we encounter any unexpected events in his domain."
Long Wuzhao nodded. "You can inform us when you will depart for his domain, and we will go with you there. We won’t act immediately, and we will only act if any unexpected events occur."
"Alright! I have to go somewhere else now, and I’ll contact you two later." Zhang Fei [4] opened a gate and entered it directly.
"What do you think that kid did to cause such a massive and long-lasting tremor, Brother Wuzhao?"
"Haha," Long Wuzhao laughed as he rose from his throne. "Didn’t Brother Xukong already tell you Empress Huo’s true identity? So, you should have guessed it, right, Brother Bailong?"
Tianshi Bailong sighed and nodded. "I’ve run out of words to talk about that kid’s relationship with women."
"Hahaha! Let’s get ready."

"I think we should postpone our plans against Ku Shenzu," Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked at Wu Mian. "Sha Mo is in his domain, and they are discussing the incident at the tower. If we attack his domain now, we will have to face two demon gods at once. Ku Shenzu and his grand elder are already troublesome, and the situation will be even more difficult if the Heavenly Fiend Demon God helps him. I will monitor them for now, and I will notify you if he has left."
"Has Ku Yu arrived at his domain?"
"Ku Yu is already beside his father, but Ku Shan and Ku Yin still haven’t returned."
Zhang Fei [5] fell into thought. "What do you think if we kidnap Ku Yu? Is there a possibility that Ku Shenzu and Sha Mo can see my invisibility ability?"

"I don’t know exactly what Sha Mo is capable of, but the Ku Shenzu definitely can’t do that." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the others, but they also didn’t know for sure Sha Mo’s abilities. "Do you want to try it first? If he can detect it, we’ll get out of there straight away."
Zhang Fei [5] stood up and opened a gate. "Meet me in that domain."
"Alright." Wu Mian nodded.

As soon as Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Torture Demon Race Domain, Wu Mian immediately went to meet him using his other body. He didn’t go straight to Ku Shenzu’s palace; instead, he observed his palace via the system map. "Sha Mo is with him now, as are Ku Yu and the others."
"Are you going to try to sneak in there?"

"I will use another way to look at the situation there." Zhang Fei [5] took out the Demon Eye’s orb and sent it to Ku Shenzu’s palace. He created a qi screen that connected to the orb so they could monitor the situation inside the palace. "How strong is Sha Mo really?"

"Sha Mo is the fourth strongest after Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, and Qian Yan." Wu Mian pointed to the qi screen as the orb arrived in the palace. "His current form isn’t his true form, and his strength will increase severalfold when he uses his true form. Even if you use your methods to increase your strength, you still can’t match him, so you have to think of another way to deal with him."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Actually, Sha Mo’s two children are already under my control, and they will arrive in their domain soon."
"Huh? Are you serious about that?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. "I met them in the tower, and I’ve already implanted my demon mark into their souls. Since Sha Mo is in this domain now, we’ll go to his domain when his two children arrive there, and we’ll do something about his wife and grand elders."
"Although Sha Yuan is not as strong as Sha Mo, she is still a powerful demon. You must not underestimate her, and you must be careful when facing her."

"I never underestimate my enemies." Zhang Fei [5] pulled the orb back to him. "I’ll be heading back now, and I want you to keep an eye on Sha Mo. If he leaves this domain, you must inform me immediately."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to Qi Qingxiu’s palace, and he immediately contacted Sha Huo and asked him about the distance of his location to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain. "I will go to Sha Mo’s domain in three days."
"Huh? Are you going to shift your target to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race?"
"Sha Mo is in Ku Shenzu’s domain, so we can’t attack there while he’s there." Zhang Fei [5] turned to them. "That’s why I’m going to his domain, and I’m going to capture his wife."
"Are you serious about using Sha Yuan against her husband?"
"In combat all methods are legitimate, including the use of hostages."

chapters.title: Chapter 1645: Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain
paragraphs: Three days passed quickly.
Sha Huo contacted Zhang Fei [5] and informed him that his group had entered the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race.

Upon receiving the news, Zhang Fei [5] brought Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and the others to the domain. He could have attacked the demon race without waiting for Sha Huo and the others to arrive, but he didn’t want to complicate the situation to prevent Sha Mo from finding out everything.
Sha Huoran, Sha Minglan, Sha Huo, Sha Qingge, and eight other demons were on alert as soon as Wu Mian and the others appeared on their flying artifacts.
"There’s no need to be so tense." Sha Qingge hid behind her brother as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of them. "They won’t attack you because they’re with me."

Sha Huoran was completely shocked that Zhang Fei [5] had already gained the support of half the demon races, and the five demon gods decided to appear on their own. However, his attention turned to Jiu Moze, who had not appeared in public for a long time and was assisting Jiu Mozu behind the scenes. With their combined strength, he was not confident that his demon god, Sha Mo, could defeat them.

Just like Sha Huoran, Sha Minglan and the eight senior demons also shared the same opinion. Although their demon god was the fourth strongest among all demon gods, they weren’t confident that he could defeat Ye Mingran and the others.

’Brother.’ Sha Qingge tightly hugged Sha Huo’s arm as she was terrified of the presence of the five demon gods. Even though Zhang Fei [5] had said that those demon gods would not attack them, she was still terrified of them.
Sha Huo patted his sister’s hand to calm her down, even though he himself was shocked after learning the fact that five of the ten demon gods had sided with Zhang Fei [5].
"Husband, that little princess is too timid, and she was frightened by our presence."

Once again, Sha Huo and the others were shocked after Qi Qingxiu addressed Zhang Fei [5] as her husband. All the demon races knew that Qiongqi and several others desired her as their wife, but she rejected them all; instead, she chose a man who is younger and weaker than herself as her husband.
Ye Mingran looked at Sha Qingge before asking Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you interested in that little princess, husband?’
’What the fuck!’ Sha Huo and the others screamed in their hearts as Ye Mingran also addressed Zhang Fei [5] as her husband. ’This! Unbelievable! Two of the three female demon gods are his wives!’

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled as he looked at Sha Qingge. "Princess, I already said that they won’t hurt you, so you don’t have to be so scared, okay? Do you want me to hug you to relieve your fear?"
"No!" Sha Qingge shouted at him. "You’re a pervert! I don’t want to be near you!"
"Even that little princess knows that you’re a pervert, son-in-law." Nalan Shizhe chimed in.

Sha Huo and the others almost fell when Nalan Shizhe addressed Zhang Fei [5] as her son-in-law. ’This man is truly unbelievable! Does that mean Nalan Wangzhi is his wife? Nalan Yuzhu died long ago, and her soul was imprisoned in the Star Tower by Tian Qiye, so they couldn’t possibly meet.’
"Ahh!" Sha Qingge screamed loudly as Zhang Fei [5] pulled her. He tilted her like a dancer and hugged her waist. "Ahh! Let me go, pervert!"
Zhang Fei [5] smiled with amusement at her expression. "Princess, I hate it the most when someone calls me a pervert, okay? Since you think of me as a pervert, I’ll show you the real me."

"Ahh! Let me go or—Mhmm..." Sha Qingge’s eyes widened in shock as Zhang Fei [5] kissed her, causing her to lose her rationality. "Phew." Sha Yuan looked at her son, but she noticed something was wrong with his expression. Before she could ask him, five powerful auras pressed down on her and restricted her movements. "What’s going on here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1646: Capture Sha Yuan
paragraphs: "Hahaha," Sha Yuan froze as Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and the others appeared before her. "Are you surprised to see us?"
"You—" Sha Yuan’s expression changed when she saw Zhang Fei [5]. She didn’t know him, but she was certain that he was the mastermind behind the appearance of those demon gods.
Zhang Fei [5] simply smiled and pulled Sha Qingge into his arms. He kissed her in front of her mother’s eyes, which shocked her.
Sha Qingge was embarrassed and awkward because of his actions. "Please don’t hurt my mother."

"I already said that I wouldn’t hurt your mother." Zhang Fei [5] walked in front of Sha Yuan, who was glaring fiercely with hatred at him. He immediately pulled her soul out of her body, replicated it, and merged it with his.
Sha Yuan was completely shocked by his actions. "What...what did you do to me?"

"I just merged your soul with mine." Sha Yuan’s eyes widened. "As you may already know that the soul is the core of all living beings, I can say that your life and the lives of your two children are in my hands now. However, you don’t need to worry because I won’t kill the three of you, and I will only hold you guys hostages until your husband agrees to join us. Once he agrees, I’ll release the three of you. By the way, you can forget about your desires for Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe. The first two women are my wives, and the latter is my mother-in-law."
Once again, Sha Yuan was shocked to hear his words, and she was confused as to how he could know all that.
"Eh? What do you mean by that, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked, glancing at Sha Yuan.
Ye Mingran wrinkled her forehead. "Is she planning something against the three of us?"
"Does this have anything to do with problems in the past?" Nalan Shizhe asked.

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded to his mother-in-law. "She used to want to kill you and Ye Mingran because of past matters, but she changed her mind about you two. She wants Qi Qingxiu to be her son’s wife, and she also wants you two to be his concubines."
Sha Huo, who was behind them, was shocked to hear that. Sha Qingge stood in her spot with a stupid look after she heard all that. ’Did my mother really plan all that?’

Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe did not comment on it because they had long known about Sha Yuan’s hatred for them, but they felt that it was no longer relevant since she was already under Zhang Fei [5]’s control.

"Tch!" Qi Qingxiu gritted her teeth as she stood in front of Sha Yuan, strangling her neck. "Do you think your son is worthy of me? He’s just a weak demon, and he can’t do anything in front of my husband. If I want, I can kill him right now in front of you. If he dies, your demon race will lose its only successor, and someone else will take your husband’s place in the future."

Just like his mother, Sha Huo was also afraid that Qi Qingxiu would kill him. Naturally, he didn’t want to die, but his strength was useless before the female demon god, and Zhang Fei [5] had already controlled him.
Hearing that, Sha Qingge hugged Zhang Fei [5]’s arm and put on a pleading look. He didn’t say anything to her and rubbed her hand to calm her down.
Sha Yuan trembled because of her threat. "Don’t! Please don’t kill my son, Demon God Qingxiu."
"Humph!" Qi Qingxiu snorted and released her neck. "If my husband didn’t need you, I would definitely kill you right here right now!"
"Did you get any other information from her?" Wu Mian asked.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "I heard from Shang Luohu that her husband was acting strangely in his seclusion chamber, but she didn’t know what happened to him. It turns out that Sha Mo enlisted the help of a member of the witch race to do something to him about five and a half years ago, and the asura demon god has been under his control since then."

Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and others frowned at that. Meanwhile, Sha Yuan’s face turned pale as she still didn’t understand how Zhang Fei [5] could know all those things. "What is Sha Mo planning to do to Shang Zhanluo?"

"Sha Mo wants to sacrifice Shang Zhanluo to get rid of Mo Shentian, and he will take over the Celestial Demon Race and the Asura Demon Race after their two demon gods dies." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer caused them to frown, not expecting that Sha Mo had such ambitions. "Before attacking the Celestial Demon Race, he will use him to attack the other demon races first."
"Our four demon races, right?" Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Wu Mian asked in a confident tone.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "He will attack your four demon races before he attacks the Celestial Demon Race, especially since your four races are the weakest among the ten demon races."

"Phew," Wu Mian exhaled softly. "The appearance of those shadowy creatures brings its own blessings, right? If they hadn’t appeared, we probably wouldn’t have made a move against the other demon races, and we would never have known about Sha Mo’s plans for us. By the time we realized his plans, it would have been too late because we couldn’t possibly fight him and Shang Zhanluo."
Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, and Ye Mingran agreed with Wu Mian.

"Can you do anything about Shang Zhanluo?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at his mother-in-law. "If you can take over Sha Mo’s control of him, you can easily control the Asura Demon Race, so we won’t have to fight with them in the future."

Zhang Fei [5] understood about it, but Mei said that there was no method to reverse it, and the only one who could do it was the witch demon who gave the potion to Sha Mo. "The only one who could do that is Wu Han, but I have no information on her whereabouts."
"Why don’t you ask Dong Xuanyin? She helped you get the Demon Soul Elixir from Wu Zu, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] contacted Dong Xuanyin and asked her about Wu Han’s whereabouts. "She said she doesn’t know the female witch demon’s whereabouts because she doesn’t live in the Endless Domain, and she’s always moving from one domain to another. I’ve asked her to contact the female demon who gave her the demon soul elixir to ask for her help, but she said that only the creator can reverse the effects."
"So, we have no other choice but to find Wu Han and force her to reverse the effects of her potion, right?"

"Unfortunately, we have no information about Wu Han’s whereabouts, and only Sha Mo has a way to contact her. We will think about that problem later because we have a serious problem before us, and we need to focus on it first." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Sha Yuan. "Contact your husband and have him return to this domain immediately, so we can take action against Ku Shenzu."

’Ku Shenzu? Is he thinking of subduing that crazy demon god?’ Sha Yuan frowned slightly, but she couldn’t refute Zhang Fei [5]’s order, and she immediately contacted Sha Mo. "He... he will leave the Torture Demon Domain in a week."
"A week, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he nodded. "Inform me once your husband leaves that domain."
Sha Yuan was furious that Zhang Fei [5] kept ordering her around. "Alright."
Zhang Fei [5] hugged and kissed Sha Qingge first. Then, he took Qi Qingxiu and the others to leave the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain.
Sha Qingge breathed a sigh of relief after they left. Then, she hugged her mother. "Mother, I’m sorry."

"No need." Sha Yuan sighed softly and embraced her daughter. "Even though our situation isn’t good, I’m grateful that nothing bad happened to you and your brother. If something bad happened to you two, our demon race would be doomed. Did that human force you?"
Sha Qingge blushed as she nodded. "He kissed me forcefully, Mother. I don’t like a pervert like him, but I liked our kiss."

Sha Yuan sighed inwardly because her daughter was too innocent, and she had never been in a relationship with any man before. She looked at her son. "Tell me, how could he do that to you two? Didn’t Sha Huoran and the others protect you?"

"Mother, he defeated Grand Elder Huoran and the others." Sha Yuan frowned at that, but Sha Huo immediately created a qi screen, showing the fight between Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Huoran some time ago. "As you can see, that man is a lust demon, but his strength is much greater than Xie Yao and Xie Yan, and he defeated Grand Elder Huoran so easily."

Sha Yuan didn’t listen to her son, and her eyes showed deep shock as she watched Zhang Fei [5] beat Sha Huoran to the point of being helpless. Besides, she was also shocked to see Yao Qilin and Fei Lian there, and the two evil female beasts were clearly by her side. "Does he have connections with the evil beast races?"
"Those two evil female beasts are his wives."

Sha Yuan took a deep breath. "Who exactly is he? How can he possess such great power with his cultivation still at the Celestial Emperor Realm? Besides, he also has a special relationship with those demon gods, especially the three female demon gods."

"Contact your husband and have him return to this domain immediately, so we can take action against Ku Shenzu."
’Ku Shenzu?
Is he thinking of subduing that crazy demon god?’ Sha Yuan frowned slightly, but she couldn’t refute Zhang Fei [5]’s order, and she immediately contacted Sha Mo.
"He... he will leave the Torture Demon Domain in a week."
"A week, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he nodded.
"Inform me once your husband leaves that domain."
Sha Yuan was furious that Zhang Fei [5] kept ordering her around.
"Alright."
Zhang Fei [5] hugged and kissed Sha Qingge first.
Then, he took Qi Qingxiu and the others to leave the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain.
Sha Qingge breathed a sigh of relief after they left.
Then, she hugged her mother.
"Mother, I’m sorry."
"No need." Sha Yuan sighed softly and embraced her daughter.
"Even though our situation isn’t good, I’m grateful that nothing bad happened to you and your brother.
If something bad happened to you two, our demon race would be doomed.
Did that human force you?"
Sha Qingge blushed as she nodded.
"He kissed me forcefully, Mother.
I don’t like a pervert like him, but I liked our kiss."
Sha Yuan sighed inwardly because her daughter was too innocent, and she had never been in a relationship with any man before.
She looked at her son.
"Tell me, how could he do that to you two?
Didn’t Sha Huoran and the others protect you?"
"Mother, he defeated Grand Elder Huoran and the others." Sha Yuan frowned at that, but Sha Huo immediately created a qi screen, showing the fight between Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Huoran some time ago.
"As you can see, that man is a lust demon, but his strength is much greater than Xie Yao and Xie Yan, and he defeated Grand Elder Huoran so easily."
Sha Yuan didn’t listen to her son, and her eyes showed deep shock as she watched Zhang Fei [5] beat Sha Huoran to the point of being helpless.
Besides, she was also shocked to see Yao Qilin and Fei Lian there, and the two evil female beasts were clearly by her side.
"Does he have connections with the evil beast races?"
"Those two evil female beasts are his wives."
Sha Yuan took a deep breath.
"Who exactly is he?
How can he possess such great power with his cultivation still at the Celestial Emperor Realm?
Besides, he also has a special relationship with those demon gods, especially the three female demon gods."

chapters.title: Chapter 1647: Visit Asura Demon Race
paragraphs: "He’s the one behind the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple, Mother."
"Moonlit Passion Temple?"
Sha Huo nodded. "Back in the forest, we saw dozens of women wearing the sect’s uniform. All of them were his wives, so I’m sure he’s the mysterious person."
"Did he tell you his purpose for doing this to us? What did Wu Mian mean by those shadowy creatures before?"

Sha Huo created a qi screen, showing those shadowy creatures. "According to him, they haven’t appeared in this Paradise Realm, and they have only appeared in the Ancient Realm. They are too powerful, and there is a possibility that they will invade this realm one day, so he wants to unite all the races to deal with them."
"Hmm?" Sha Yuan folded her forehead as she looked at those creatures. "What do you mean by the Ancient Realm?"
"The Ancient Realm is a higher realm after the Paradise Realm."
"What?" Sha Yuan screamed, looking at her son. "Are you kidding me? Are there other realms higher than this Paradise Realm?"
Sha Yuan shrugged. "I don’t know anything about it, but I think the Ancient Realm really exists. I don’t know how he found that realm and went there, but he and Empress Huo are there now."

Sha Yuan found it difficult to believe the Ancient Realm existed because there were no records mentioning it in the Paradise Realm. However, she knew that Empress Huo was different from other cultivators, and she could do things that other cultivators, including Long Wuzhao, the ten demon gods, and the four perils, could not.
"Mother."
"Hmm?"

"I think you should persuade my father to side with him." Sha Yuan frowned. "We don’t know anything about those creatures, and he didn’t explain much to us. However, he previously said that he and Empress Huo had already fought with them in the Ancient Realm, and neither of them could defeat them."
"Not even Empress Huo can defeat those creatures?" Sha Yuan was shocked because all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm were so afraid of Feng Yao.
"No."

Sha Yuan’s expression turned serious after that because Feng Yao was the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm, making her think about several things. However, she wasn’t confident in convincing her husband to side with Zhang Fei.
"I’ll go back to my room now, Mother." Sha Huo immediately left after his mother nodded.
"Mother."
Sha Qingge’s call brought Sha Yuan out of her thoughts. "What did he say to you, Qingge?"

"Ugh!" Sha Qingge blushed. "He said that I’m his woman, and he’ll claim me in the future. I like kissing him, but I don’t have any feelings for him yet because we’ve only met three times so far. Besides, he’s too crazy because he has more than a hundred wives, including Demon God Mingran and Demon God Qingxiu. If he takes me as his wife, I will have to compete with all of them, so I don’t want that."

Sha Yuan caressed her daughter’s head. "Even though you say that, I can see that Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are enjoying their decision to become his wives. They are both demon gods on the same level as your father, and many powerful demons covet them as their wives, but they both reject them all. Besides, I’ve heard that Qiongqi is infatuated with Qi Qingxiu, and he has repeatedly tried to get her here, but his efforts have always met with a dead end."

"Even though Demon God Mingran and Demon God Qingxiu enjoy their status as his wives, that doesn’t mean I will feel the same way, Mother." Sha Qingge sulked with a pout. "I’ve always dreamed of finding my prince charming who loves only me, but I haven’t been able to find one because all the men I know have more than one wife."

"Unfortunately, I can see that he will never let you go, and he will probably eat you after his business with your father is finished." Sha Qingge lowered her head as she was already aware that Zhang Fei would not let her go. "You should go back to your room and rest."
"Yes, Mother." Sha Qingge kissed her mother’s cheek before running away.

After her daughter left, Sha Yuan sat back down and released her soul. She examined her soul, but she found nothing negative within it, which relieved her. She was furious when she remembered that Zhang Fei duplicated her soul and merged the duplicate with her soul. "Tch! How could he do that? I’ve never met a demon that could duplicate souls, let alone a lust demon. Will he really free me and my two children if my husband agrees to join him? If he doesn’t free us, we will be forced to submit to him for the rest of our lives."

Zhang Fei [5] and the others had already returned to Qi Qingxiu’s domain. He sent Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, and Wu Mian back to their domains because they still had to wait a week to go to the Torture Demon Race Domain.
"What are you going to do now, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked.
"I’m going to the Slaughter Blood Domain to meet Shang Luohu."

"I’ll come with you." Qi Qingxiu suddenly remembered something. "Hey, husband, I forgot to tell you that the previous Torture Demon God is still alive, and he will come out to help Ku Shenzu if we attack him."

Zhang Fei [5] remembered Nalan Shizhe once told him that the four former demon gods were still alive, but the former Celestial Demon God had already died after he passed on his final power to Mo Tianshen, so only three remained, including the former Torture Demon God. "What about your ancestor?"

"She came to see me a few years ago, but she was getting weaker, and she wanted to enjoy the end of her life in peace." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Since the former Celestial Demon God is dead, I think you can ask Nalan Shizhe to contact her predecessor to help us."

Zhang Fei [5] declined with a shake of his head. "My mother-in-law once told me that her predecessor doesn’t want to get involved in external affairs, so I won’t bother her. Besides, my father-in-law and Long Wuzhao are willing to help us, so I think that’s enough."

"If the two of them are willing to help us, we’ll easily subdue the Torture Demon Race. That way, the six demon races will be on the same side, and we just need to figure out how to win over the other four."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately took Qi Qingxiu to the Slaughter Blood Domain through the gate.
"Zhang Fei? Demon God Qingxiu? Why are you two suddenly here?" Shang Luohu asked in surprise, as did Shang Zhui, who was standing not far from the asura demon empress.
"We have important information about your husband."
Shang Luohu wrinkled her nose because her husband had lived in seclusion for so many years. "What kind of information is that?"

"A witch demon infiltrated this palace several years ago, but you were unaware of it." Zhang Fei’s answer shocked them. "Sha Mo asked a witch demon named Wu Han to use a potion on your husband, so he’s under her control now."
"What?" Shang Luohu screamed in shock. "Where did you get that information?"
"Sha Yuan." Shang Luohu frowned. "We just came back from her domain, and I did something to her, so I was able to get all this information."
"Are you thinking about pulling Sha Mo over to your side, kid?" Shang Zhui walked towards them.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "I told you two about those shadowy creatures before, but I didn’t know their strength at the time. However, I’ve fought them, and they’re far more powerful than I imagined; even Empress Huo couldn’t defeat them. Moreover, those creatures are just pawns, and the core creature is far more powerful. I haven’t met it yet, but it has already destroyed a large domain with just one small attack. If it invades this Paradise Realm, all domains will definitely be destroyed without a single one remaining."
"Where did you two fight with those shadowy creatures?"

"One of the domains in the Ancient Realm," Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui gasped. Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen, showing them the Cangxuan Domain. "See? That domain is so big, but the core creature destroyed it with just one small attack."

Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui did not listen to Zhang Fei [5]; Instead, they looked at the image on the qi screen with awe. None of the cultivators in the Paradise Realm had ever heard of the Ancient Realm in the past, but he had already gone there, and the image on the qi screen was proof of that, as they had never seen the domain before.

Zhang Fei [5] removed the qi screen. "For now, I want to bring as many cultivators as possible to my side, and they will help me to monitor all the domains so we can take swift action if those shadowy creatures invade this Paradise Realm. As for your husband, I have no solution to recover him, and the only one who can help him recover is Wu Han."
"What exactly does Sha Mo want? Why did he lower his self-esteem by asking a witch demon to do that to my husband?"

"Sha Mo wanted to use your husband to attack the other demon race, but his ultimate goal was to sacrifice him to deal with Mo Shentian." Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui were shocked to hear that. "Even though I can’t help you recover your husband’s condition, I can prevent that from happening to him."
Zhang Fei [5] opened the training space and asked Shang Xueli to come out from inside, surprising Shang Luohu and Shan Zhui.
"Mother." Shang Xueli immediately ran to hug her mother. "I missed you so much."

chapters.title: Chapter 1648: Shang Zhanluo’s Condition
paragraphs: Shang Luohu welcomed her daughter with a warm embrace. Although Zhang Fei [5] had always brought them to a reunion in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain for the past few years, they couldn’t truly enjoy it because the giant Yin-Yang Lotus absorbed their soul power. "I missed you too, Xueli. Are you well?"
"Uhm." Shang Xueli nodded. "Zhang Fei and the others have always treated me well, so I’m completely healthy. They often accompany me to relieve my boredom, so I don’t experience any stress."
"You two can reunite, and I’ll go check on your husband."
"Wait," Shang Luohu stopped Zhang Fei [5]. "You won’t be able to enter my husband’s seclusion place without me, so I’ll take you both there."
"Take us there now, and you two can reunite afterward." Zhang Fei [5] took Qi Qingxiu by the hand, following behind Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli, who looked pleased with their meeting.

Behind them, Shang Zhui examined Shang Xueli, especially her cultivation. His son, Tian Shuixiang, had already told him that Zhang Fei [5] had confined the asura demon princess in a special place, which was beneficial for her. ’Her cultivation has increased quite significantly compared to when she was still living in the Celestial Demon Domain. At first, I thought that he would take her as his wife, but I couldn’t find any trace of his yang qi in her body.’
Soon, they arrived in front of Shang Zhanluo’s room. "By the way, why didn’t you bring my sister-in-law here?"
"I offered Shang Fengxue to bring her back here, but she said that she was too comfortable in my sect, and she was busy training our disciples."

Shang Luohu only shook her head at this, as her sister-in-law had been gone for over five years, and she hadn’t returned since. Fortunately, Shang Zhanluo was busy with his seclusion; otherwise, her departure would have brought trouble. She immediately opened the seal on the door, and they instantly smelled a thick aura of blood from within.

Shang Luohu hurriedly went in to check on her husband, followed by Zhang Fei [5] and the others. They discovered that Shang Zhanluo’s entire body was covered in demon blood, and his aura was quite suffocating for them.
[Quest: Meet the Asura Demon God.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
Shang Zhanluo’s eyes were tightly closed, and he was unaware of their presence.
’What do you think happened to him, Mei?’ Zhang Fei [5] frowned as he observed Shang Zhanluo.
[If possible, you should take a sample of his body part, such as his hair, and I’ll examine it for you, Master.]
"Mother, what happened to my father?" Shang Xueli fearfully asked.
"I don’t know." Shang Luohu looked at Shang Zhui, but he also had no answer for her husband’s condition. "Could this be due to the effects of Wu Han’s potion?"
"That’s possible." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and walked over to Shang Zhanluo. "I need his hair to check."

Qi Qingxiu was confident in her husband’s abilities, but she still prepared herself to face unexpected possibilities. Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui are also the same as her, as Shang Zhanluo’s conditions are too strange.
Zhang Fei [5] quickly pulled a strand of Shang Zhanluo’s red hair, but the asura demon god suddenly opened his eyes. Both of his eyes were bloody dark red, like someone on a rampage.
They took a deep breath when they saw Shang Zhanluo’s expression, especially when he looked at his wife and daughter. However, it didn’t last long, and he closed his eyes again, confusing them.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to their side, and Shang Luohu brought them out of the room before sealing it again.
"What kind of potion did Sha Mo use on my husband? Why is his behavior getting stranger by the day?" Shang Luohu asked with a frown.
Shang Zhui agreed with his empress. "Judging from my emperor’s gaze earlier, he was only focused on you and the princess, and he seemed unaware of the presence of the three of us."
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded. "For some reason, I could sense my husband’s killing intent, and it was directed at both of us."
"Could he have been affected by some kind of berserk potion, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked, feeling strange about Shang Zhanluo’s condition.

"I think so too." Zhang Fei [5] stored Shang Zhanluo’s hair in the system inventory so Mei could examine it directly. "The only way to get a clear answer is we must capture and subdue Sha Mo since we don’t know about Wu Han’s whereabouts. However, he is currently in Ku Shenzu’s domain, and he will leave that domain in a week."
"Didn’t you get that information from Sha Yuan?"

"Sha Yuan’s memories don’t have that, so I’m sure Sha Mo arranged everything himself." Zhang Fei [5] thought of another solution to that problem. "It seems I have to go see Dong Xuanyin, and I’ll ask her to take me to Wu Zu. Since that woman is a witch demon, I’m sure she has the answer."
"How about going to Dong Xuanyin’s place now?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli. "I’ll leave your daughter with you for now, and I’ll pick her up later."
Shang Luohu sighed because Zhang Fei [5] was still not willing to free her daughter. "Alright."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain and took Qi Qingxiu with him, disappearing inside.
"Zhui."
"Yes, Empress."
"Have our men found the location of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain?"
"That domain is two months’ journey from ours, but we won’t be able to defeat Sha Mo without our demon god."

Shang Luohu understood this, but she was furious because Sha Mo conspired with the witch demon race and made her husband’s condition so bad. "Forget it! I’ll wait for information from Zhang Fei first, and I hope Wu Zu can help."
"I think that’s our best option for now, Empress."

"For now, I want to spend my time with my daughter, and I don’t want any disturbances at all. As for those people, you can deal with them as necessary, and you should kill them if they still think about rebelling."
"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui disappeared immediately.
"Do our people really want to rebel, Mother?" Shang Xueli asked in shock. She herself had been away from their domain for hundreds of years, and today was her first time back.

"Yes." Shang Luohu hugged her daughter’s waist and led her away. "As you know, our asura demon race places great importance on strength, and we don’t have a son to succeed your father. Your father has been in that condition for years, and our people started to suspect that something bad had happened to him, so they thought about replacing him."
"Does that include Grandpa Zhui and the four asura guardians?"

"Xueli, Zhui is completely loyal to your father, so I believe he will never rebel." Shang Xueli nodded to her. "The four asura guardians are indeed loyal to your father, but they are not completely loyal either. They have long harbored ambitions to replace your father, especially Shang Dongzhu and Shang Beixuan. If your father doesn’t recover soon, they will truly rebel, and the situation in our race will be in complete chaos. If that happens, you must stay by Zhang Fei’s side, and you will be safe with him."
"But—"

"Don’t argue with me, okay?" Shang Luohu looked at her daughter. "You are our only descendant, so I don’t want you to get involved in such matters, and I want you to always be safe. Without your father, Zhui and I would not have been able to stop the four asura guardians, so you have to understand my decision."
"What about the guardian of the Blood Sea? Won’t it move if the four asura guardians rebel?"

"Speaking of the guardian of the Blood Sea, it completely submits to Zhang Fei." Shang Xueli’s jaw dropped upon hearing this, as the Slaughter Blood Phantom never submitted to anyone, including her father. "I don’t know how he managed to tame it, but I think it has something to do with his identity as a heavenly fox."

Since she had stayed so long in Zhang Fei’s training space, Shang Xueli had long known about her four identities, so she wasn’t surprised by it. "Mother, I think he can defeat the four asura guardians, so we should ask for his help if they really want to rebel."

"Hmm?" Shang Luohu raised an eyebrow. "Zhang Fei fought them a few years ago, Xueli. He defeated Shang Xijiao and drew with Shang Nanzhui, but he couldn’t defeat Shang Beixuan, let alone Shang Dongzhu."
"How high did you feel Zhang Fei’s strength was at that time, Mother?"
"The Celestial Lord Realm."

"I see." Shang Xueli knew that Zhang Fei did not fight to the best of his ability at that time. "Mother, would you believe me if I said that he could match Demon God Mingran and Demon God Shizhe in strength?"
"Is that true?"

"Yes." Shang Xueli nodded. "I’ve seen them spar many times over the years, and Zhang Fei has never lost to them. He does have difficulty facing their abilities, but he has never lost. I don’t know what method he uses to improve his strength, but his strength can increase sharply to the level of a cultivator at the Celestial Venerable Realm, so I’m confident that he can defeat the four asura guardians if he wants to. Furthermore, his speed far surpasses all other cultivators unrelated to him, and none of them are able to match him."
Shang Luohu nodded in understanding. "How’s your speed? You’ve been training with him for years, so I’m curious to see your progress."

sentences.text: Shang Luohu welcomed her daughter with a warm embrace.

Although Zhang Fei [5] had always brought them to a reunion in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain for the past few years, they couldn’t truly enjoy it because the giant Yin-Yang Lotus absorbed their soul power.
"I missed you too, Xueli.
Are you well?"
"Uhm." Shang Xueli nodded.
"Zhang Fei and the others have always treated me well, so I’m completely healthy.
They often accompany me to relieve my boredom, so I don’t experience any stress."
"You two can reunite, and I’ll go check on your husband."
"Wait," Shang Luohu stopped Zhang Fei [5].
"You won’t be able to enter my husband’s seclusion place without me, so I’ll take you both there."
"Take us there now, and you two can reunite afterward." Zhang Fei [5] took Qi Qingxiu by the hand, following behind Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli, who looked pleased with their meeting.
Behind them, Shang Zhui examined Shang Xueli, especially her cultivation.

His son, Tian Shuixiang, had already told him that Zhang Fei [5] had confined the asura demon princess in a special place, which was beneficial for her. ’Her cultivation has increased quite significantly compared to when she was still living in the Celestial Demon Domain.
At first, I thought that he would take her as his wife, but I couldn’t find any trace of his yang qi in her body.’
Soon, they arrived in front of Shang Zhanluo’s room.
"By the way, why didn’t you bring my sister-in-law here?"
"I offered Shang Fengxue to bring her back here, but she said that she was too comfortable in my sect, and she was busy training our disciples."
Shang Luohu only shook her head at this, as her sister-in-law had been gone for over five years, and she hadn’t returned since.
Fortunately, Shang Zhanluo was busy with his seclusion; otherwise, her departure would have brought trouble.
She immediately opened the seal on the door, and they instantly smelled a thick aura of blood from within.
Shang Luohu hurriedly went in to check on her husband, followed by Zhang Fei [5] and the others.
They discovered that Shang Zhanluo’s entire body was covered in demon blood, and his aura was quite suffocating for them.
[Quest: Meet the Asura Demon God.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
Shang Zhanluo’s eyes were tightly closed, and he was unaware of their presence.
’What do you think happened to him, Mei?’ Zhang Fei [5] frowned as he observed Shang Zhanluo.
[If possible, you should take a sample of his body part, such as his hair, and I’ll examine it for you, Master.]
"Mother, what happened to my father?" Shang Xueli fearfully asked.
"I don’t know." Shang Luohu looked at Shang Zhui, but he also had no answer for her husband’s condition.
"Could this be due to the effects of Wu Han’s potion?"
"That’s possible." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and walked over to Shang Zhanluo.
"I need his hair to check."
Qi Qingxiu was confident in her husband’s abilities, but she still prepared herself to face unexpected possibilities.
Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui are also the same as her, as Shang Zhanluo’s conditions are too strange.
Zhang Fei [5] quickly pulled a strand of Shang Zhanluo’s red hair, but the asura demon god suddenly opened his eyes.
Both of his eyes were bloody dark red, like someone on a rampage.
They took a deep breath when they saw Shang Zhanluo’s expression, especially when he looked at his wife and daughter.
However, it didn’t last long, and he closed his eyes again, confusing them.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to their side, and Shang Luohu brought them out of the room before sealing it again.
"What kind of potion did Sha Mo use on my husband?
Why is his behavior getting stranger by the day?" Shang Luohu asked with a frown.
Shang Zhui agreed with his empress.
"Judging from my emperor’s gaze earlier, he was only focused on you and the princess, and he seemed unaware of the presence of the three of us."
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded.
"For some reason, I could sense my husband’s killing intent, and it was directed at both of us."
"Could he have been affected by some kind of berserk potion, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked, feeling strange about Shang Zhanluo’s condition.
"I think so too." Zhang Fei [5] stored Shang Zhanluo’s hair in the system inventory so Mei could examine it directly.
"The only way to get a clear answer is we must capture and subdue Sha Mo since we don’t know about Wu Han’s whereabouts.
However, he is currently in Ku Shenzu’s domain, and he will leave that domain in a week."
"Didn’t you get that information from Sha Yuan?"
"Sha Yuan’s memories don’t have that, so I’m sure Sha Mo arranged everything himself." Zhang Fei [5] thought of another solution to that problem.
"It seems I have to go see Dong Xuanyin, and I’ll ask her to take me to Wu Zu.
Since that woman is a witch demon, I’m sure she has the answer."
"How about going to Dong Xuanyin’s place now?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli.
"I’ll leave your daughter with you for now, and I’ll pick her up later."
Shang Luohu sighed because Zhang Fei [5] was still not willing to free her daughter.
"Alright."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain and took Qi Qingxiu with him, disappearing inside.
"Zhui."
"Yes, Empress."
"Have our men found the location of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain?"
"That domain is two months’ journey from ours, but we won’t be able to defeat Sha Mo without our demon god."
Shang Luohu understood this, but she was furious because Sha Mo conspired with the witch demon race and made her husband’s condition so bad.
"Forget it!
I’ll wait for information from Zhang Fei first, and I hope Wu Zu can help."
"I think that’s our best option for now, Empress."
"For now, I want to spend my time with my daughter, and I don’t want any disturbances at all.
As for those people, you can deal with them as necessary, and you should kill them if they still think about rebelling."
"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui disappeared immediately.
"Do our people really want to rebel, Mother?" Shang Xueli asked in shock.
She herself had been away from their domain for hundreds of years, and today was her first time back.
"Yes." Shang Luohu hugged her daughter’s waist and led her away.
"As you know, our asura demon race places great importance on strength, and we don’t have a son to succeed your father.
Your father has been in that condition for years, and our people started to suspect that something bad had happened to him, so they thought about replacing him."
"Does that include Grandpa Zhui and the four asura guardians?"
"Xueli, Zhui is completely loyal to your father, so I believe he will never rebel." Shang Xueli nodded to her.
"The four asura guardians are indeed loyal to your father, but they are not completely loyal either.
They have long harbored ambitions to replace your father, especially Shang Dongzhu and Shang Beixuan.
If your father doesn’t recover soon, they will truly rebel, and the situation in our race will be in complete chaos.
If that happens, you must stay by Zhang Fei’s side, and you will be safe with him."
"But—"
"Don’t argue with me, okay?" Shang Luohu looked at her daughter.
"You are our only descendant, so I don’t want you to get involved in such matters, and I want you to always be safe.
Without your father, Zhui and I would not have been able to stop the four asura guardians, so you have to understand my decision."
"What about the guardian of the Blood Sea?
Won’t it move if the four asura guardians rebel?"

"Speaking of the guardian of the Blood Sea, it completely submits to Zhang Fei." Shang Xueli’s jaw dropped upon hearing this, as the Slaughter Blood Phantom never submitted to anyone, including her father.
"I don’t know how he managed to tame it, but I think it has something to do with his identity as a heavenly fox."
Since she had stayed so long in Zhang Fei’s training space, Shang Xueli had long known about her four identities, so she wasn’t surprised by it.
"Mother, I think he can defeat the four asura guardians, so we should ask for his help if they really want to rebel."
"Hmm?" Shang Luohu raised an eyebrow.
"Zhang Fei fought them a few years ago, Xueli.
He defeated Shang Xijiao and drew with Shang Nanzhui, but he couldn’t defeat Shang Beixuan, let alone Shang Dongzhu."
"How high did you feel Zhang Fei’s strength was at that time, Mother?"
"The Celestial Lord Realm."
"I see." Shang Xueli knew that Zhang Fei did not fight to the best of his ability at that time.
"Mother, would you believe me if I said that he could match Demon God Mingran and Demon God Shizhe in strength?"
"Is that true?"
"Yes." Shang Xueli nodded.
"I’ve seen them spar many times over the years, and Zhang Fei has never lost to them.
He does have difficulty facing their abilities, but he has never lost.

I don’t know what method he uses to improve his strength, but his strength can increase sharply to the level of a cultivator at the Celestial Venerable Realm, so I’m confident that he can defeat the four asura guardians if he wants to.
Furthermore, his speed far surpasses all other cultivators unrelated to him, and none of them are able to match him."
Shang Luohu nodded in understanding.
"How’s your speed?
You’ve been training with him for years, so I’m curious to see your progress."

chapters.title: Chapter 1649: Meet Wu Zu
paragraphs: Wu Zu, who was sitting in a daze while watching the cauldron in front of her, turned her gaze towards the entrance. "Hmm? Dong Xuanyin and Demon God Qingxiu? Who is that male lust demon?"
"Didn’t I tell you about him when I came here to ask for the Demon Soul Elixir last time? Dong Xuanyin returned the question with a playful smile.
Qi Qingxiu hugged Zhang Fei [5]’s arm. "He is my husband, Zhang Fei."

"Eh?" Wu Zu was shocked to hear that. Qi Qingxiu was famous among the demon races not only for her status as a demon god but also for her shunning of all male demons who tried to propose to her, including Qiongqi. "Is he really your husband? If those people find out you have chosen him as your husband, they will immediately look for him and kill him."
"Do you think I would choose a weak man as my husband?" Wu Zu raised an eyebrow for a moment. "If you think he’s weak, you can try sparring with him, but don’t be disappointed if he defeats you."
"I—" Wu Zu swallowed her words when she felt Zhang Fei [5] had moved behind her, and the one beside Qi Qingxiu immediately disappeared. "An illusion? Since when did you use your technique?"

"The moment Qingxiu said that you shouldn’t be disappointed if you lose to me." Wu Zhu looked back, but Zhang Fei [5] had already disappeared, and she immediately returned her gaze to the front. "I didn’t come here to talk about me, and I came here to ask you about Shang Zhanluo’s condition."
Wu Zu shook her head. "Dong Xuanyin already explained to me regarding Shang Zhanluo’s condition, and I already told her that I couldn’t cure him."
"At least, you can see the condition first and give your opinion about it." Zhang Fei [5] created a qi scree, showing Shang Zhanluo’s condition. "What do you think?"

"Fuck!" Wu Zu screamed as she stood up. Her eyes trembled when she saw Shang Zhanluo’s condition on the qi screen. "Wu Han is truly insane! I don’t know what Sha Mo promised her for she used the forbidden ancient potion on the asura demon god."
"The forbidden ancient potion."

"Yes." Wu Zu waved her hand and created a qi screen, showing a potion. "That’s the Bloodfiend Frenzy Elixir! Wu Han concocted it and gave it to the asura demon god! The effect will make him completely lose reason; he will attack friends and foes when it reaches its peak. The side effect is that his cultivation veins will rupture and turn him into a cripple, and his lifespan will be reduced by more than half."
Zhang Fei [5], Dong Xuanyin, and Qi Qingxiu were shocked. "Can you make an antidote for that elixir?"

"I can concoct the antidote," Wu Zu replied with a nod. "However, I’ll need time to find the ingredients, and some of them are extremely rare even for my kin. Besides, I have a long-standing grudge with the Asura Demon God, so I won’t help him without a good reason."
"Wu Zu, I understand your enmity with Shang Zhanluo, but this universe is facing a serious problem."

Wu Zu frowned at Dong Xuanyin, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately changed the image on his qi screen, displaying those shadowy creatures. "What kind of creatures are those? Why haven’t I seen them before?"

"Because those creatures do not exist in this Paradise Realm." Wu Zu looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "We call them shadowy creatures, and they emerge from the core of the universe. According to someone, those creatures were imprisoned within the core, but something happened and freed them. For now, they only appear in the Ancient Realm, but it does not rule out the possibility that they will invade this Paradise Realm someday."
"Someone? The Ancient Realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Have you ever gone to the Forbidden Land and met merchants there?"
"Yes! I went to the Forbidden Land and bought some items from those merchants several times, but what is their relationship with the Ancient Realm?"

"The Forbidden Land was once part of the Ancient Realm, and the merchants came from that realm once every few hundred years." Wu Zu looked at Zhang Fei [5] as her eyes blinked a few times. "You may not believe me, but that’s the truth. Oh! There’s a beast beside me, and it’s the mount of a member of the Puyang Clan, so I’ll summon it now."
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked around as soon as Zhang Fei [5] summoned him from the beast space. "Eh? This isn’t the Ancient Realm but the Paradise Realm, right?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Wu Zhu, whose jaw had fallen open. "She doesn’t believe that the Ancient Realm exists, so I want to summon you out of my beast space to help explain to her."

"I still find it hard to believe that you can bring me to this realm, Zhang Fei. The qi in this realm is strong, but it is much weaker than the qi in the Ancient Realm, so I’m not surprised that the cultivators in this realm are so weak." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked at Wu Zhu. "A witch demon, huh? Her cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, but she’s too weak compared to me."
Wu Zu scowled at his remark, but she realized that the male beast in front of her was indeed stronger than her, even though their cultivation was equal.

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu smiled mockingly when he saw her expression. "A naive little demon! The Ancient Realm does exist, and one of its portals is located in the Forbidden Land! Unfortunately, the portal is sealed, so no cultivators from this realm can go there, but people from there can come here freely. There is only one person from this realm who can go there, and that person is Zhang Fei."
"Hmm?" Wu Zu looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a frown. "How did you get to the Ancient Realm?"
"I couldn’t go to that realm by myself, and someone took me there."
"Who?"
"What?" Ancient Leiyu Tianlu screamed. "Have you really gone to the Ancient Realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "My real body has already gone to the Cangxuan Domain before, and—"
"You’ve really gone mad!" Ancient Leiyu Tianlu shouted angrily. "I told you not to go there because those shadowy creatures will chase you, but you didn’t listen to me!"
"Hey! Calm down, okay? I wasn’t there alone, and I was accompanied by a void dragon and Guang Zhiyi."
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu’s eyes widened. "What did you say? Did you say Guang Zhiyi accompanied you there? But how—"

"Guang Zhiyi died long ago, but her reincarnation is still alive, and you’ve met her." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu didn’t believe it. "Do you remember the crimson-haired woman who went to the Forbidden Land with me years ago?"
"Feng Yao? Is she really Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] summoned Tian Taiyang and Yin Yue from his soul world.
Wu Zu was shocked when Tian Taiyang and Yin Yue appeared before them. ’Who are these two people? They’re both just souls, right?’

"Oh?" Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was surprised to see the two of them. "The leader of the Silver Moon Clan, and one of the elders of the Golden Sun Clan. I didn’t expect you two to still be alive, and you were with Zhang Fei."
"Hahaha," Tian Taiyang laughed. "It’s been a long time since I saw you, Tianlu. Although I’m still alive now, this is only my soul, and I still need a long time to be able to reform my body."
"Hey, little bird, where is your master?"

Ancient Leiyu Tianlu scowled upon hearing Yin Yue address him as such. "My master and the others are protecting the Puyang Clan from those shadowy creatures, and he sent me here to protect Zhang Fei."
"Tch... Tch..." Yin Yue shook her head. "Guang Zhiyi is by Zhang Fei’s side, so he doesn’t need protection from a weak bird like you."
"You’re the weak one, you dead woman!" Ancient Leiyu Tianlu furiously shouted. "You were powerful in the past, but you have been dead for so long, and I can erase your soul if I want to!"
"Humph!" Yin Yue snorted. "Zhang Fei, please send us back to your soul world."

"Alright," Zhang Fei [5] sent Tian Taiyang and Yin Yue back inside. "You heard it yourself, right? Feng Yao is Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, and she’s beside my real body right now. Besides, we’re traveling through the void, and those shadowy creatures can’t catch up to us, so we’ll be fine. By the way, does the Puyang Clan have a reliable alchemist? I need some alchemy items to concoct the two pills, but those ingredients don’t exist in this Paradise Realm."

"The Puyang Clan has several alchemists, but the best among them is Puyang Kongque. Besides, the Puyang Clan has a vast herb field, and they have a large collection of rare herbs. However, I don’t recommend you go there, especially with those creatures still continuously attacking them. Did you really fight those creatures before?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "I have fought with those creatures in the Cangxuan Domain, and their numbers are enormous. Even though I have used all my strength and advantages, I can only kill a few of them. The core creature is even stronger, and it has already destroyed the domain into dust."

"You must be careful, Zhang Fei. If they find you and kill you, this universe will be doomed." Ancient Leiyu Tianlu sighed. "Please send me back to your beast space, and you can summon me again if you need my help."

chapters.title: Chapter 1650: Searching For Wu Han
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei [5] sent Ancient Leiyu Tianlu into his beast space, Dong Xuanyin immediately asked Wu Zu, "Do you believe me now? Back then, you doubted me when I said that he was different from other demons or evil beasts, but you’ve met him and seen some of his abilities."

"Yeah," Wu Zu looked at Zhang Fei [5] in awe because he had discovered the Ancient Realm that no one else knew about, and he also knew several cultivators from that realm. "I can concoct the antidote, but the ingredients are hard to come by. We probably won’t find it for several months, especially with all the domains now separated from each other, making our search even more difficult. However, the ingredients for the potion and the antidote are almost identical, with only two ingredients different. Wu Han should still have them, and I have the two ingredients for the antidote, so I can concoct it faster if we can find her."
"Do you have a way to find Wu Han?"

Wu Zhu nodded. "I have a way to find her, but the problem is that there are many domains in this Paradise Realm, and the distance between each domain is so far, which will take a lot of time to travel to all of them."
"Haha," Qi Qingxiu laughed. "Why don’t you ask how we found you so quickly?"
"How?"
"Show it to her, husband."

"So, how are we going to look for Wu Han?"

Wu Zu returned to her senses and gave them three talismans. "When you arrive at another domain, you only need to inject your qi into it, and it will light up if there is a witch demon there. Besides, many powerful cultivators live there, and they can protect your kin from harm."
"The problem is, the human race hates my kin, and they will attack us if we move into your domain. Besides, I’ve never seen your domain, so I don’t know the power of your formations."
Zhang Fei [5] closed the other gates, leaving one that would lead them to the Twin Flames Domain. "Go in! We’ll arrive at my domain directly, and you can see all the formations there for yourself."
"Alright."
Wu Zu immediately looked around as soon as they arrived at the Twin Flames Domain. "Who helped you set up all these formations?"

"Liao Hanxue from the Liao Clan of the Sky Pillar Domain and several natural races also helped me." Wu Zu found it hard to believe that the natural races would be willing to help Zhang Fei [5], especially given his identity as a lust demon. She was shocked when he transformed into a nine-tailed heavenly fox, and she was shocked again when he transformed into a human. "I won’t explain too much to you, but I am a human, a lust demon, and a fox beast. "Your sect?"

"Let’s go there."

"A witch demon, huh?"
"Where did you find her, Master? As far as I know, the witch demon race’s numbers are few, and they live in hiding."

"Oh? Are you really offering those two lust demons to move here?"
"As Tian Kui said just now, I offered it to them, but they rejected my conditions. Since they didn’t agree to my conditions, I didn’t bring them here."
"Are you going to bring them here if they agree to your conditions?"

"Items to upgrade demon rank?"

"You don’t need to doubt that," Qi Qingxiu spoke to her. "My husband is a man of his word, and he will protect your race members if he says so. Wu Zu nodded in understanding. "Let’s discuss that matter later, as I still have to discuss it with my race members. For now, we must find Wu Han as soon as possible so I can concoct the antidote, and you can cure Shang Zhanluo."
"Do you still have many of these talismans?" Wu Zu took out dozens more talismans and gave them to Zhang Fei [5]. "I will ask my people to help us so we can find Wu Han faster."

Wu Zu was truly shocked to see those people because they came from all races, including the winged race, making the Moonlit Passion Temple the only sect inhabited by all races. Moreover, they obeyed Zhang Fei [5], making her feel unbelievable.

"Let’s go there."
"Wait." Zhang Fei [5] asked everyone to return and closed the other gate, leaving the one that would lead them to Wu Han’s location. "Let’s go."
Upon arriving at the domain, Wu Zu immediately took out a talisman and activated it. It immediately flew from her hand and headed in a certain direction. "Follow it."

Zhang Fei [5] followed behind Wu Zu along with Qi Qingxiu and Dong Xuanyin. He opened the system map and checked the direction the talisman was flying, finding Wu Han’s name quite far from their location. "That woman is indeed hiding there, but she’s not alone."
Unlike Dong Xuanyin and Qi Qingxiu, who had known Zhang Fei [5] for quite a long time, Wu Zu was confused when he heard that. "How do you know about that?"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Let’s just say that I have a secret method that I can’t reveal to anyone. Even Dong Xuanyin and Qi Qingxiu never knew about it."
Wu Zu looked at Dong Xuanyin and Qi Qingxiu, but both of them shook their heads because Zhang Fei [5] had too many secrets that he kept to himself.
"Do you know the identity of the person who was with Wu Han?"
"A demon beast named Niu Jie."
Wu Zu frowned. "I didn’t expect that she would be with that damn ox! Since he’s with her, I’m going to kill that damn ox today."
